# opencode2dsh **Free OpenCode Zen models, natively inside DSH (DeepSeek Harness).** No API key. No registration. No extra process. [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@opencode2dsh%2Fdsh-plugin)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin) [![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/@opencode2dsh%2Fdsh-plugin)](https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh/blob/master/LICENSE) [![node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%E2%89%A520-brightgreen)](https://nodejs.org) [![DeepSeek Harness](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-plugin-blue)](https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh) English | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)
--- opencode2dsh registers a native DSH `LlmAdapter` that streams directly from [OpenCode Zen](https://opencode.ai/zen)'s **anonymous free lane** — the same models OpenCode's own CLI uses without an account, served to your DSH model picker as a regular provider called `opencode2dsh`. Requests leave your machine looking exactly like traffic from the OpenCode CLI (same user agent, same correlation headers), and the model catalog stays fresh through a three-tier fallback chain. There is nothing to log into and nothing to host. ## Highlights - **Zero credential, zero setup** — the anonymous lane needs no key; install, restart, chat - **Native adapter, no sidecar** — one npm package, no child process, no binary, no local port (the legacy Go sidecar is not part of the published package; see `legacy/`) - **CLI-identical disguise** — requests carry the OpenCode CLI user agent and its session/request/project header set, derived per conversation - **Selectable thinking levels** — reasoning-capable free models expose an effort picker in DSH's model selector (declared ladders where the model metadata provides them, Off/Minimal/Low/Medium/High otherwise); Responses-only `muse-spark-*` models expose only upstream-supported effort levels, and no selection keeps the provider default - **Image input where it is declared** — image attachments are accepted for every model whose [models.dev](https://models.dev) entry lists `image` in `modalities.input`, and refused for the ones that declare `text` only; models.dev being silent falls back to the live-verified vision family - **Live catalog with a fallback chain** — live upstream list ∩ free-by-metadata, falling back to offline cache and a verified static list - **Self-healing** — fast startup retries, periodic refresh, and a written health snapshot for diagnostics - **Proper error surfaces** — upstream failures (rate limit, auth, timeout, transport) arrive in DSH as classified finish reasons, and retries stay owned by DSH ## Install **From the plugin market** (recommended, once this repo is listed there): in DSH open **Settings → Plugin Market**, search `opencode2dsh`, one-click install. **From npm**: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add @opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin ``` **From source** (build the tarball yourself): ```sh git clone https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh.git cd opencode2dsh/packages/plugin pnpm install && pnpm pack dsh plugin --profile web add ./opencode2dsh-dsh-plugin-.tgz ``` **Verify**: restart `dsh web`, open the model picker, and pick a model from the **opencode2dsh** group. Requires DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 0.1.7 or newer with a web profile (the IP 池 settings page rides the 0.1.7 Plugins page contract); Node.js ≥ 20 (already present if DSH runs); outbound HTTPS to `opencode.ai` and `models.dev`. ## Configuration Defaults work out of the box. Override via the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`: ```yaml - id: opencode2dsh name: '@opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin' config: mode: adapter # adapter (default) | sidecar providerId: opencode2dsh refreshSeconds: 300 # catalog refresh cadence ``` | Option | Default | Description | | --- | --- | --- | | `mode` | `adapter` | `adapter`: native LlmAdapter streaming straight from Zen. `sidecar`: legacy local-agent mode, not bundled — build the agent from `legacy/agent` and pass `agentPath`. | | `providerId` | `opencode2dsh` | Provider name shown in DSH. | | `refreshSeconds` | `300` | Live catalog refresh interval. Pricing metadata refreshes every 24 h. | | `agentPath` | auto-resolved | Sidecar only: path to the agent binary. | | `agentArgs` | — | Sidecar only: extra CLI args for the agent. | | `restartDelayMs` / `restartMaxDelayMs` / `maxConsecutiveCrashes` | `1000` / `60000` / `5` | Sidecar only: restart backoff and circuit breaker. | | `firstEventMs` / `bodyIdleMs` / `responsesBodyIdleMs` | `30000` / `120000` / `300000` | Adapter only, plugin 0.3.7+: stream-liveness watchdogs, in ms (integers from `1` to `600000`). Time to the first stream event, mid-response body silence, and the body-idle floor for Responses models (`muse-spark-*`). Increase `firstEventMs` for slow cold starts. Unset keeps the defaults; restart DSH after editing. | ## How it works ``` DSH session │ harness chunks (block-start / text-delta / usage / finish …) ▼ ZenAdapter (registered LlmAdapter) │ pi-ai openai-completions stream (chat models) │ pi-ai openai-responses stream (`muse-spark-*`, Responses-only on Zen) ▼ https://opencode.ai/zen/v1 ← Authorization: Bearer public with CLI-identical headers: user-agent: opencode/… x-opencode-client, x-opencode-session, x-session-affinity, X-Session-Id, x-opencode-request, x-opencode-project ``` - **Session correlation** — session/project ids are SHA-256 derived from the conversation's first user turn (stable per conversation, non-reversible), and each request gets a fresh random id, mirroring the CLI. - **Catalog fallback chain** — S1: live `GET /v1/models`; S2: models.dev pricing metadata decides "free"; S3: a compile-time verified static list. A disk cache (~7-day TTL) covers upstream outages. - **Resilience** — the adapter registers immediately at startup; if the first catalog fetch races your network (VPN/TUN reconnects, DNS), the plugin retries on a short cadence (~1 min) before settling into the periodic refresh. - **Sidecar mode** (`mode: sidecar`, legacy) — spawns a local Go agent (a single-tenant port of [opencode2api](https://github.com/jasonxu114514/opencode2api)) on `127.0.0.1:`, token-authenticated, and registers a standard `llm-pi-ai` route. **Not part of the published package**; build it from `legacy/agent` (`go build ./cmd/agent`) and point `agentPath` at the binary. ## Health & troubleshooting The plugin writes a health snapshot after every refresh round: ``` ~/.opencode2dsh/adapter-status.json ``` ```json { "status": "ready", "total": 64, "exposed": 9, "lastError": "", "writtenAt": "2026-08-29T07:01:54.915Z" } ``` | Symptom | Likely cause & fix | | --- | --- | | `403 FreeTierError` / "OpenCode's free tier can only be used from within OpenCode" | The upstream restricts free-tier clients. The plugin preserves the explanation instead of reporting an invalid API key. Use the supported OpenCode client or an official API service. | | Boot screen shows `Failed to load plugins … list slot "plugins.item" requires options.id`, or the IP 池 entry has no configuration page | Your DSH predates the 0.1.7 Plugins page contract. Upgrade DSH to 0.1.7 (latest recommended). On 0.1.6 and older the page never mounts (it is gated on `configForms.whileServed`) — model routing is unaffected. | | DSH 0.1.7/0.2 cannot start after plugin installation (`pending … settingsScope`) | Upgrade the plugin to 0.3.5. On DSH 0.2, configure IP pooling through the installed opencode2dsh row on the Plugins page. | | Only 3 models | Startup fetch raced your network; retries land within ~1 min. Check `adapter-status.json` for `lastError`. | | `lastError: "fetch failed"` persisting | Outbound HTTPS to `opencode.ai` blocked; check proxy/VPN rules. | | Rate-limit errors in chat (`429 … Endpoint is unavailable`) | The anonymous lane is quota-per-IP and free models are contended. # dsh-proxy-whitelist

> 只让指定的模型渠道走代理，其余全部直连。

DSH 自带的代理支持（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-http-proxy`）读 `HTTPS_PROXY` / `HTTP_PROXY` / `ALL_PROXY` / `NO_PROXY`，启动时装一次、全进程生效：**除了 `NO_PROXY` 里的主机，所有请求都走代理**。那是一份「绕过名单」，方向恰好相反——它没法表达「默认直连，只有这几个主机走代理」。`no_proxy` 再怎么写也写不出白名单。

本插件把方向倒过来：保留 DSH 原来的 dispatcher 作为**直连**路径，只给你列出的主机加一条代理路径，由 dispatcher 在每次请求时按 URL 的 origin 决定走哪条。粒度因此是**每个渠道**（= 每个 `baseURL`），也就是 DSH 已经用来命名 provider 路由的单位。

## 为什么不是「按模型名分流」

模型 id 在请求体里，dispatcher 只看得见 URL。要按模型名分流，必须由拥有请求体的网关来做（例如 new-api 的渠道级 `proxy` 字段）——本插件不做，也不会假装能做；`proxy_status` 工具会明确告诉你某个 URL 的实际判定。

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin add github:lilith1257/dsh-proxy-whitelist
```

也可以在 DSH 里打开 **设置 → 插件 → 添加插件**，填 `github:lilith1257/dsh-proxy-whitelist`。装完重启 DSH。

想改代码就克隆下来装本地路径：

```bash
git clone https://github.com/lilith1257/dsh-proxy-whitelist.git
dsh plugin add "$(pwd)/dsh-proxy-whitelist"
```

## 设置卡片

装好后在 **设置 → 插件 → 代理白名单** 有一个卡片（侧边栏「插件」页里也能打开，同一份配置）：

**1. 勾选渠道。** 卡片会去读 **设置 → 模型** 里已经配好的供应商，列成清单：

```
已配置的渠道                   已选 3 / 3    [拉取渠道]
☑ Command | goat    api.commandcode.ai     64 个模型
☑ sta1n             cdn.sta1n.cn           106 个模型
☑ d1                d1api.xin              1 个模型
```

勾上就走代理，取消就走直连。**不用手打域名。** 新增供应商后点「拉取渠道」刷新。
列表为空时会提示先去 设置 → 模型 配一个供应商。

**2. 填代理地址。** 你的代理客户端 HTTP 端口，例如 `http://127.0.0.1:7890`。

**3. 保存。** 保存后自动重新探测一次，立刻生效（不用重启）。

### 另外几块

- **运行状态** — 从 Host 读实时数据：分流是否生效、当前代理、生效规则、**已分流多少条请求**（走代理 / 直连分别计数）。
- **测试一条 URL** — 填一个完整 URL，用 dispatcher 的**同一个匹配器**回答会走代理还是直连、命中哪条规则。
- **高级：手动写规则**（默认折叠）— 上面勾选覆盖不到的主机（webhook、镜像、兄弟 API）在这里手写。平时不用展开。

### 勾选背后做了什么

一个渠道的 `baseURL` 只是一个主机（`cdn.sta1n.cn`），但它可能还需要跟同一域名的其它主机通信。所以：

- **勾选** 写入精确主机规则 `cdn.sta1n.cn`。
- **如果已有更宽的规则**（比如你手写过 `.sta1n.cn`），勾选状态按「被这条规则覆盖」来显示，不会重复写。
- **取消勾选** 时，如果覆盖它的是宽规则，插件会把它**展开成其它渠道各自的精确规则**，再删掉你取消的这一个 —— 它下面的兄弟渠道继续走代理，不会被静默断掉。

勾选区下方会列出「你手写的、不对应任何供应商的规则」，取消勾选即删除那条。

## 配置文件（等价写法）

不想用卡片就改 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`：

```yaml
- id: proxy-whitelist
  name: dsh-proxy-whitelist
  config:
    enabled: true
    proxy: http://127.0.0.1:7890
    include:
      - .d1api.xin              # 该域名及其所有子域
      - api.commandcode.ai      # 精确匹配这一个主机
      - "*.sta1n.cn"            # 只匹配子域，不含 apex
      - 10.0.0.0/8              # IPv4 网段
    exclude:
      - internal.example.com    # 即使命中 include 也强制直连
```

### 规则语法

| 写法 | 含义 |
| --- | --- |
| `api.example.com` | 只匹配这个主机 |
| `.example.com` | apex + 任意层级子域 |
| `*.example.com` | 只匹配子域，不含 apex |
| `10.0.0.0/8`、`10.1.2.3` | IPv4 网段 / 单个地址 |
| `api.example.com:8443` | 限定端口 |

匹配不区分大小写，忽略末尾的点；**loopback 永远直连**（`localhost`、`127.0.0.0/8`、`::1`、`0.0.0.0`、`169.254.0.0/16`），因为 DSH 自己就靠这些地址跟 Web UI 和本地 MCP 服务器通话。写错的规则会在加载时按原文报出来，而不是被悄悄忽略。

### 安全行为

- **默认不代理**：`include` 为空时一条也不代理，可以先装再配。
- **代理没启动就直连**：地址在使用前探测一次，之后每 30 秒复查；代理客户端关掉时整体降级为直连，而不是让每个模型调用都失败。
- **不写 `process.env`**：环境变量对子进程和所有读它的库都生效，写进去就收不回来了。本插件只替换 undici 的全局 dispatcher，卸载时还原。
- **SOCKS 会被拒绝并说明原因**：undici 只接受 `http://` 与 `https://` 代理，写 `socks5://` 会被告知并保持直连。

## 模型可用的工具

`proxy_status`——报告当前代理、规则、是否已安装，以及某个 URL 会走哪条路：

```
proxy_status({ url: "https://api.commandcode.ai/provider/v1/chat/completions" })
```

## 与 mihomo / Clash 的关系

如果你已经在用 Clash Verge / mihomo 这类规则代理，它们本身就能按域名分流，最省事的做法是让 DSH 全量指向它们、由它们决定直连还是转发（见 README 末尾的对照）。本插件的价值在于：**不装任何外部代理客户端**、规则只属于 DSH 这个进程、随时在设置里改。

## 已知限制

- **代理地址只能写到端口。** `http://127.0.0.1:7890/proxy` 这种带路径的写法会被卡片拒收：undici 的 `ProxyAgent` 只接受 origin，带路径会在加载时抛错——而加载时的异常以前会变成 unhandled rejection，让**下一次 DSH 启动直接失败**，且坏值已经存进配置、用户没有界面改回来。现在卡片在保存前就拒收，路由层还有一道 `try/catch` 兜底降级为直连。
- **代理地址可以是远程的，但那意味着把 API Key 交给它。** 走代理的每个渠道，请求里都带着该渠道的凭证；`checkProxyUrl` 只校验协议与主机名，不限制地址是不是本机。卡片会在「当前代理」一行标出 ⚠ 提示（`isLocalProxy`），但这只是提示，不是拦截——局域网代理、SSH 隧道端口都是合法用法。不想要这个风险就把地址写回 `127.0.0.1`。
- 只覆盖把 `globalThis.fetch` 落到 undici 全局 dispatcher 的调用方（DSH 的 LLM 传输、web 搜索、HTTP MCP 都属于这一类）。**worker 线程有自己的一份 `globalThis`**，要单独安装 dispatcher，本插件不涉及。
- 不是透明代理：不会改写 WebSocket 之外的协议，也不处理 `CONNECT` 以外的隧道语义。
- 与 `dsh-commandcode-goat` 一类自带 proxy 的插件互不干扰：它们用自己的 dispatcher 发自己的请求，本插件只接管没被它们接管的调用。

## 开发

```bash
cd dsh-proxy-whitelist
npm install             # 只有两个直接依赖：undici、@deepseek-ai/schemastery
npm test                # 70 个用例：规则、dispatcher、真代理 + 真 fetch 的端到端、桥接、生命周期
node tests/render.mjs   # 单独跑卡片的无头渲染（中英两套文案）
```

测试全部在本机临时端口上跑，**不出网**：`cdn.sta1n.cn` 这类域名只作为字符串参与规则匹配，从不真的连接。

卡片是无头渲染测试的：用一个小型 React 替身把每个座位的每个视图都渲染一遍，
再断言中英文案都完整。漏一个翻译键会在测试里显示成 `MISSING:xxx`，而不是等
用户打开设置页看到一串英文键名。

## 一个典型场景

三个渠道，三种处境——这正是本插件要解决的形状：

| 渠道 endpoint | 直连 | 走本地代理 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `api.example-a.com` | **失败**（超时） | 200 / 0.7s |
| `cdn.example-b.cn` | 401 / 2.3s | 401 / 0.6s |
| `api.example-c.cn` | 401 / 8.0s | 401 / 0.6s |

401 是正常的（这些端点要鉴权），关键是**能不能连通**和**速度**。对应配置：

```yaml
- id: proxy-whitelist
  name: dsh-proxy-whitelist
  config:
    proxy: http://127.0.0.1:7890
    include:
      - .example-a.com      # 直连不通，必须走代理
      - .example-b.cn       # 能连但要 2s+，走代理快 3 倍
      - .example-c.cn       # 能连但要 8s，走代理快 10 倍
```

先别猜。卡片里的「测试一条 URL」用**同一个匹配器**回答判定，再给一条实测：

```
api.example-a.com (listed -> proxy): HTTP 200 in 582ms
cdn.example-b.cn  (not listed -> direct): HTTP 401 in 7592ms
stats: {"proxied":1,"direct":1}
```

## 和 DSH 自带代理的关系（重要）

`dsh-http-proxy` 如果在启动时就拿到了 `HTTPS_PROXY`，**全进程都已经在走代理**了。本插件接管后，不在 include 里的主机回到**直连**——也就是把「全走」收窄成「只走这几个」。这不是副作用，是它唯一的语义；日志会明确说一遍。如果你要的就是「全走，只有几个例外」，那就继续用 `no_proxy`，不需要本插件。

## 对照：现成方案怎么选

| 你的需求 | 最省事的做法 |
| --- | --- |
| 几个域名走代理，其余直连 | **本插件**（装一个、填 3 行）；或 mihomo 写 `DOMAIN-SUFFIX` 规则 |
| 按模型名 / 渠道精细分流、要统计与重试 | 自建 new-api，渠道 JSON 里填 `{"proxy":"socks5://..."}` |
| 不想装任何东西、只要全局走代理 | 直接设 `HTTPS_PROXY`，DSH 自带支持 |

## License

MIT © dsh-proxy-whitelist contributors。见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。

plugins.description: Time & Timer for DeepSeek Harness: synced clock, lunar date, China holidays, and a 15-minute timer.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-time&timer > Visual clock and timer plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) Web GUI.

在 Harness 的对话界面里内置一个与系统时间同步的可视化时钟：首页显示大号数字时钟（含农历、中国法定节假日与调休），对话进行时在标题栏显示紧凑时间条；两种形态都带一个最多 15 分钟的计时器入口。 ## 功能 ### 两种时钟形态 | 模式 | 出现时机 | 位置与尺寸 | |---|---|---| | **StartMode** | 首页 / 空白会话（Hero 页） | 对话区域左上角，`256 × 64 px` 横向数字时钟卡片 | | **DefaultMode** | 任意对话进行时 | 标题栏左侧工具区（标题旁的 actions 组）最右端，JetBrains Mono 14px | - 时间统一为 24 小时制 `HH:MM:SS`，每秒刷新。 - StartMode 顶部：公历年 `YY/MM/DD`（如 `26/10/18`）+ 节假日 / 休息日徽标（`国庆节·休`、`春节·班`）。 - StartMode 中部：`HH:MM:SS` 作为视觉焦点（HH:MM 30px + 秒 18px），居中偏左。 - StartMode 底部：农历日期，格式 `丙午年.九月初九`（含生肖年干支），默认关闭、可在插件设置中开启。 - DefaultMode：时间条带一层加深底色块（含 1px 内描边），时间与蓝色计时按钮整体成为标题栏里的聚焦区域。 - 两种模式的计时器入口采用同一套蓝色强调： - StartMode：`64 × 24` 矩形按钮； - DefaultMode：`24 × 24` 正方形按钮； - 顶部边缘线均有 1px 白色高光（`inset 0 1px 0 #fff`，高光仅出现在边缘线上），图标颜色 `#27F5F5`。 ### 双时间来源 - 默认采信**系统时间**（浏览器 `Date`）。 - 在插件设置中开启**第三方时间服务器**后，Host 半通过 UDP 向 `ntp.aliyun.com` 查询，Client 按偏移量校正显示；每 5 分钟重新同步一次，失败自动回退系统时间并在设置页显示错误。 - 浏览器无法直接发送 NTP（UDP/123），因此 Host 半注册了 `GET /api/time-n-timer/ntp` 路由；该路由只查询固定的 `ntp.aliyun.com`，不是通用 NTP 代理。 ### 计时器（Timer） - 上限 15 分钟；倒计时档位：`15s / 30s / 1min / 3min / 5min / 10min / 15min`；另有正向计时模式（最多 15:00）。 - 点击任意模式的计时按钮打开对话框，进行模式与时长选择；支持开始 / 暂停 / 继续 / 重置。 - 到点自动打开对话框提示「时间到」，并播放三声提示音。 - 计时进行中按钮带状态点（运行 / 暂停 / 结束）；StartMode 顶部徽标在计时中改为显示剩余时间。 - 计时器状态保存在当前页面内存，刷新页面后重置。 ### 插件设置 `设置 → 通用` 中新增「时间与计时器」两行： 1. **显示农历日期**（默认关闭） 2. **第三方时间服务器**（默认关闭；开启后显示同步状态、偏移量与错误） 设置持久化在浏览器 `localStorage` 的 `dsh.time-n-timer.settings.v1`。 ## 安装 ### 方式一：从 GitHub 克隆后本地安装 ```bash git clone https://github.com/Depar7ure/dsh-time-timer.git ``` 在 Harness 的 **Plugin Manager → 安装本地插件（Install bundle）** 中选择克隆下来的目录，安装后刷新页面即可。 ### 方式二：交给 Harness Agent 安装 把该目录的绝对路径交给 Agent，并说明「安装这个 bundle」；Harness 会通过 `install_bundle` 完成安装（安装后刷新页面）。 > 插件显示名：**Time & Timer / 时间与计时器**。 ## 项目结构 ``` dsh-time-timer/ ├── index.js # Host 半：NTP 查询路由（node:dgram） ├── client.js # Client 半：时钟 / 农历 / 节假日 / 计时器 / 弹窗 / 设置行 ├── cordis.patch.yml # Bundle patch（插入一行 dsh-time-timer） ├── package.json # 包清单（dsh.bundle + dsh.client） ├── locale/ │ ├── en.json # 插件显示名与描述（English） │ └── zh.json # 插件显示名与描述（中文） ├── icon.svg # 插件图标 ├── scripts/check.mjs # 本地清单与语法自检 ├── CHANGELOG.md ├── LICENSE # MIT └── README.md ``` ## 数据说明 - **农历**：内置 1900–2100 标准农历表（支持闰月）。已验证 2026-02-17 = 正月初一、2026-09-25 = 八月十五、2026-10-18 = 九月初九。 - **节假日**：内置 2025、2026 年国务院办公厅放假安排（含调休上班日）；无数据的年份按周末规则回退。普通周六 / 周日显示「周末·休」，调休上班日显示「班」。 - 节假日数据来源：国务院办公厅《关于 2026 年部分节假日安排的通知》（国办发明电〔2025〕7 号）。 ## 开发 ```bash node scripts/check.mjs # 清单、图标、Client 半语法检查 node --check index.js # Host 半语法检查（ESM） ``` 要求：Harness 的 Web 客户端（`dsh.client.platform: web`）；Node.js ≥ 18（Host 半使用 `node:dgram`）。 ## 兼容性与已知限制 - 节假日数据目前覆盖 2025–2026，其他年份仅按周末判定。 - 样式使用 Harness 的主题 token（`--dsw-alias-*`），浅色 / 深色主题均可用；字号与尺寸依赖宿主布局，宿主大版本升级后可能需要重新核对槽位。 - StartMode 通过 `conversation.header.leading` 渲染；DefaultMode 通过 `conversation.session.header.actions` 渲染，空白会话时该槽位不会显示。 - NTP 同步依赖 Host 半与网络可达；离线环境自动回退系统时间。 ## English **dsh-time-timer** is a visual clock and timer for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI. It shows a 256×64 digital clock on the home (blank) session with an optional Chinese lunar date and China holiday badge, and a compact JetBrains Mono clock strip in the header while a conversation is active. Both modes expose a timer launcher (countdown presets from 15 seconds to 15 minutes, plus a stopwatch capped at 15:00). Time is taken from the system clock by default and can optionally be corrected from `ntp.aliyun.com` through a Host-side NTP endpoint. ## License [MIT](./LICENSE) © 2026 Depar7ure

plugins.description: Native Rapid-MLX provider for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — dsh reads model facts from the server instead of your settings.yaml.
plugins.readme_text:
# @raullenchai/dsh-provider

A native [Rapid-MLX](https://github.com/raullenchai/Rapid-MLX) provider for
[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) — so `dsh`
gets its model facts from the server instead of from whatever you typed into
`settings.yaml`.

[![CI](https://github.com/raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

> **Status: published to npm** as
> [`@raullenchai/dsh-provider`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@raullenchai/dsh-provider).
> The end-to-end `dsh` run in [Verified](#verified) was on an M3 Ultra against
> `dsh 0.1.0-rc.7`; `dsh 0.1.0-rc.8` is API-compatible — the `LlmAdapter`
> contract is byte-identical and the only changes are additive — and the
> adapter is re-verified against rc.8 at the protocol and unit-test level.
> DSH is still a developer preview that moves fast, so treat this as tracking
> a moving target, not a frozen compatibility promise.

## What it does for you

DSH can already talk to a local Rapid-MLX server through its generic
`openai-completions` provider. That route works — but it knows nothing about
your model beyond what you hand-wrote:

```yaml
# what the generic route makes you maintain, by hand, per model
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    rapid-mlx:
      baseURL: http://localhost:8000/v1
      defaultContextWindow: 262144      # you looked this up. is it still right?
      models:
        - id: qwen3.6-35b-8bit
          contextWindow: 262144
          reasoningEfforts: {off: none, low: low, medium: medium, high: high}
```

Rapid-MLX's `/v1/models` already publishes all of that and more. This adapter
reads it, so:

**1. Nothing to hand-write, and nothing to re-write when you switch models.**
Swap what `rapid-mlx serve` is running and `dsh` follows. No re-running setup,
no stale numbers.

**2. The reasoning control tells the truth.** Rapid-MLX reports whether a model
actually has a reasoning parser. A model that can't reason no longer shows an
off/low/medium/high selector that does nothing.

**3. Compaction is timed with the capacity that actually fits this Mac, not a
number that drifted.** This is the one that quietly costs you.
`dsh-compaction-basic` asks the provider for the route's capacity and compacts
at `thresholdRatio × capacity` (0.8 by default). The provider prefers the
server's **`max_model_len`** — Rapid-MLX's memory-fitted ceiling (what fits in
unified memory: weights + KV cache), in the vLLM/SGLang-standard field — over
the native `context_window`, and falls back to `context_window` on an older
server that doesn't report it. So compaction is timed to what the machine can
actually hold, not the model's advertised window (which it may not have room
for) and not a hand-written number copied from another model.

## Install

Needs Node ≥ 22.15 (dsh imports Node's Zstd stream API without declaring it)
and a running Rapid-MLX server.

```sh
# From npm:
dsh plugin --profile web add @raullenchai/dsh-provider

# …or straight from source — the package ships plain JS with no build step:
dsh plugin --profile web add github:raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider

export RAPID_MLX_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8000/v1     # optional; this is the default
dsh web
```

Then point the agent at the route:

```yaml
# $DSH_HOME/settings.yaml
agent-default-model:
  provider: rapid-mlx
  model: qwen3.6-35b-8bit
```

Verified: that command installs and activates as a profile layer against
`dsh 0.1.0-rc.7`. To hack on it locally instead, see
[Local development](#local-development).

## Model management (v0.2.0)

Beyond the provider route, the plugin registers five tools and a `/rapid-mlx`
command so the agent can see and manage models without leaving the session.
The split follows which surface actually owns each fact: served-model facts
come from the structured HTTP `/v1/models`; the download cache and pull/remove
are CLI-only, so those — and only those — shell out to `rapid-mlx` through the
harness subprocess seam.

| Tool | Source | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `rapid_mlx_serving` | HTTP `/v1/models` | The model(s) served right now, deduped, with context window, reasoning/tool parsers, MoE/hybrid, and modalities. |
| `rapid_mlx_cached` | `rapid-mlx models --cached` | Downloaded models and their on-disk size. |
| `rapid_mlx_pull` | `rapid-mlx pull <name>` | Download a model (alias or HF repo id). Cancellable; no fixed deadline. |
| `rapid_mlx_remove` | `rapid-mlx rm -y <name>` | Delete a cached model to free disk. |
| `rapid_mlx_health` | HTTP + `rapid-mlx --version` | API up? CLI reachable? Reported as two independent facts. |

`/rapid-mlx` prints a one-shot overview: health, the served model and its facts,
and total cache disk usage.

The CLI is resolved from the `cliCommand` config (default `rapid-mlx` on
`PATH`, or `$RAPID_MLX_CLI`); set it to an absolute path if the binary is not on
the harness's `PATH`. `rapid_mlx_pull`/`rapid_mlx_remove` are the only tools
that change anything on disk, and they run non-interactively (`rm` is forced
with `-y` because the subprocess seam ignores stdin).

## Verified

Against `dsh 0.1.0-rc.7` on an M3 Ultra:

- Installs and **activates as a profile layer** (no "declares no `dsh.bundle`"
  warning; the entry shows up in `dsh --profile headless --dump-config`).
- Registers the `rapid-mlx` route with `ctx.llm` and serves real queries.
- Plain chat, a single tool call, and the multi-step bug-fix task that gates
  Rapid-MLX releases — the last one fixed the bug and made the target repo's own
  test pass, verified independently, in 36 s on `qwen3.6-35b-8bit`.

## Not done yet

Being explicit, because the point of the adapter is to *use* what the server
says and some of it is still only read:

- `recommended_sampling` — should be applied automatically per model.
- `tool_call_parser` — should let `dsh` fail fast on a model that cannot emit
  `tool_calls`, instead of looping.
- `is_hybrid` / `is_moe` / `capabilities` — read, not yet acted on.
- **Memory-aware capacity.** Today `resolveModel()` reports the model's
  *advertised* context window. On a Mac the real ceiling is unified memory, and
  reporting that instead is the biggest remaining win — it needs Rapid-MLX to
  expose a usable-capacity figure first.
- Images are not carried through `stream()` — but they now **refuse** with
  `LlmError(..., 'UNSUPPORTED')` rather than being dropped, per the cookbook.
  Text, reasoning and tool calls are carried.
- The route is registered as `rapid-mlx`. If your `settings.yaml` also declares
  a `rapid-mlx` provider under `llm-pi-ai`, the two compete for one route name
  (`registerAdapter` owns provider exclusivity). Use one or rename ours.

## Conformance with the official adapter contract

Built against
[`docs/cookbook/adding-an-llm-adapter.md`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/main/docs/cookbook/adding-an-llm-adapter.md)
and its "protocol obligations" section. Each item has a test:

| Obligation | How it is met |
|---|---|
| `usage` before `finish`, nothing after `finish` | usage is buffered and flushed at end-of-stream, so a trailing usage-only chunk cannot reorder it |
| Tool-call `arguments` are raw JSON strings end to end | fragments stream as `argumentsDelta` and reassemble unparsed |
| Block indexes in first-seen order, reused per block | verified across a reasoning-then-text response |
| Errors take exactly two sanctioned paths | transport/protocol failures **throw** `LlmError` with a stable code; nothing ends the stream quietly |
| Honor `options.signal` | passed to `fetch` and to the SSE reader; an `AbortError` is re-thrown unchanged, not reclassified |
| A field the provider cannot honor throws `UNSUPPORTED` | image content refuses instead of being narrowed away |
| Config is a schemastery schema with env fallback | `export const Config`, fed from `cordis.patch.yml` via `!!js process.env.RAPID_MLX_BASE_URL` |

`finish.replayState` is not emitted: Rapid-MLX needs no native response ids
or signatures on follow-up calls, so there is nothing lossless to project.

## Three things worth knowing before you edit this

plugins.description: DSH Maestro5 — Lead + L1–L5 difficulty-tier subagents for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). One install adds the Team Lead session mode and a per-tier model configuration page. ｜ DSH 团队模式插件：主控 + 五档难度子智能体，安装即得配置界面。
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH Maestro5 **一个主控 + L1–L5 五档难度子智能体，把「团队」变成 DeepSeek Harness 的默认工作方式。** 安装即获得「团队主控」模式与模型配置界面：主控负责拆任务、按难度与成本选档、并行分派、汇总复核；每个档位的模型都可以在设置页里独立配置。 [English](https://github.com/bigbigtooth/DSH-Maestro5/blob/main/README.en.md) · [中文](https://github.com/bigbigtooth/DSH-Maestro5/blob/main/README.md) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](https://github.com/bigbigtooth/DSH-Maestro5/blob/main/LICENSE) [![DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-0.2.1--rc.2-informational)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) [![release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/bigbigtooth/DSH-Maestro5?label=release)](https://github.com/bigbigtooth/DSH-Maestro5/releases/latest) [![validate](https://github.com/bigbigtooth/DSH-Maestro5/actions/workflows/validate.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/bigbigtooth/DSH-Maestro5/actions/workflows/validate.yml) [![dsh-plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/topic-dsh--plugin-2f6feb)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin) [![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/profile-web%20%7C%20desktop-lightgrey)](#兼容性) > 社区插件，与 DeepSeek AI 无隶属关系，也不是官方项目。 ![在「团队主控」模式下，主控并行派出 L1 / L2 两个子智能体，汇总后给出结果](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bigbigtooth/DSH-Maestro5/main/docs/screenshots/chat-delegation.png)
--- ## 这是什么 **DSH Maestro5** 是一个 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（DSH）Web 插件。装上之后，新任务里会多出一个 **「团队主控」** 模式： - 你说一句任务，**主控**先拆解，再决定「哪些自己做、哪些交给子智能体、交给哪一档」； - 有 **L1–L5 五档难度**子智能体，越往上模型越强、越慢、越贵； - 五档的工具集相同（文件、bash、联网、Office 技能），差异在**模型 / 思考强度 / 人设**，所以任何任务都能交给任何档； - 每一档用哪个 Provider、哪个模型、什么思考强度，都能在 **设置 → 团队模式** 里单独配置，模型列表直接来自你当前 DSH 的模型目录； - 安装插件即自动注册模式、五个档位 preset 和配置页——**不需要手动改任何配置文件**。 ### 为什么值得装 | 痛点 | Maestro5 的做法 | | --- | --- | | 一个模型包办所有任务，简单任务浪费贵模型 | 简单任务派 L1/L2（便宜快），关键交付才上 L4/L5（强而贵） | | 长任务一个上下文越滚越大，越跑越慢越贵 | 子任务在独立上下文里执行，主控只收结果，上下文更干净 | | 多个独立子任务只能串行做 | 主控可以在同一轮并行派出多个子智能体 | | 子智能体「用哪个模型」写死在代码里 | 设置页逐档配置，模型目录变化自动跟随 | | 高风险交付没人复核 | 主控人设要求关键交付再派 L4/L5 独立复核 | --- ## 截图 | 新任务里的「团队主控」模式 | 设置 → 团队模式（逐档配模型） | | --- | --- | | ![模式选择器：团队主控 + L1–L5 档位](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bigbigtooth/DSH-Maestro5/main/docs/screenshots/mode-picker.png) | ![设置页：五档的 Provider / 模型 / 思考强度](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bigbigtooth/DSH-Maestro5/main/docs/screenshots/settings-team-mode.png) | | 安装后出现在插件列表 | 实际分派过程 | | --- | --- | | ![已安装插件里的 DSH Maestro5](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bigbigtooth/DSH-Maestro5/main/docs/screenshots/plugins-installed.png) | 见页面顶部大图：主控并行派出 L1 / L2，6 秒汇总交付 | --- ## 快速开始 ### 环境要求 - **DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1-rc.2` 或同系列 `0.2.x`**（插件声明了 `engines.dsh: >=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0`） - **Web / Desktop profile**：本插件依赖 agent preset 注册表与 Web 设置界面，因此仅在 `web` / `desktop` profile 生效；headless / TUI profile 不适用 - 至少配置一个可用的模型 provider（**设置 → 模型**），否则子智能体没有可用的模型路由 ### 安装 三种方式任选一种，装完都得到同一个 bundle。 #### 方式 A：Web 界面（最直观） 1. 侧栏 **插件（Plugins）** → 右上角 **添加插件 ▾** → **安装第三方插件**； 2. 输入本地目录绝对路径，确认安装； 3. **刷新页面**（`Cmd+R` / `Ctrl+R`）加载浏览器端配置页； 4. 新建任务，模式选择器里应出现 **「团队主控」**。 #### 方式 B：从 GitHub 安装 ```sh # 源码安装（跟随 main 分支） dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:bigbigtooth/DSH-Maestro5 # 或从 Releases 的打包文件安装（固定版本、可离线分发） dsh plugin --profile desktop add https://github.com/bigbigtooth/DSH-Maestro5/releases/latest/download/dsh-maestro5-0.1.0.tgz ``` > 桌面版如果提示找不到 `dsh` 命令，可在菜单栏用 **Manage dsh command** 把它装进 PATH（不同版本入口可能略有差异）。 > 安装完成后**重启 DSH**（bundle 层在启动时组装）；至少刷新页面以加载客户端半。 #### 方式 C：本地目录（开发态） ```sh dsh plugin --profile desktop add /path/to/DSH-Maestro5 ``` 本地目录是 `link:` 安装：源目录就是安装物，**改代码 / 改配置后重启 DSH 即生效，无需重装**。 ### 安装后验证清单 - [ ] 新任务 → 模式选择器出现 **「团队主控」**（旁边还有 `团队·L1` … `团队·L5` 五个档位卡，它们只供子智能体使用，不建议直接选作会话模式） - [ ] **设置 → 团队模式** 能打开，五个档位的 Provider / 模型 / 思考强度都能下拉选择 - [ ] **插件 → 已安装插件** 里出现 **DSH Maestro5**，点开后能看到 `maestro-levels` 行与 6 个 preset 行 - [ ] 发一句「用 delegate_l1 计算 1+1」，能看到主控派出子智能体并汇总结果 ### 设为默认模式（推荐） **设置 → Agent 预设 → 团队主控 → 设为新任务默认**。 > ⚠️ 不要通过编辑 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 去改 `agent-preset-registry` 的默认值：那会让 preset 注册表重启，运行中的会话会丢失 preset 工具。请只用设置界面。 --- ## 使用 选中「团队主控」后，直接描述任务即可。主控会自己判断要不要派、派给谁、派几个。也可以直接指定档位： ```text 用 L1 把这份 CSV 转成 xlsx，保持表头不变。 先让 L2 整理这些素材，再让 L5 写终稿并做一次事实核查。 这件事拆成三份并行：L2 查资料、L3 做表、L4 写结论；最后你汇总并给我一页摘要。 ``` ### 主控怎么工作 1. **拆解**：把任务拆成独立、边界清晰的子任务；简单问答 / 单步操作自己做； 2. **选档**：机械可复核 → L1/L2；推理链长、错误代价高 → L4/L5；默认从最低可行档开始； 3. **分派**：每个子智能体拿到一份**自包含**的任务说明（背景、输入路径、方法、输出格式、落盘路径、验收标准）——它们看不到你的对话； 4. **并行**：互相独立的子任务在同一轮同时派出，而不是串行等待； 5. **复核**：结果回来后对照验收标准检查；关键交付再派 L4/L5 独立复核； 6. **交付**：汇总成结论 + 可直接使用的产物，并说明用了哪几档、产出在哪个文件。 ### 五档难度 | 档位 | 定位 | 默认模型 / 思考强度 | 适合任务 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | **L1 极简执行** | 最便宜最快 | `deepseek-flash` / off | 格式转换、字段提取、简单改写、单步操作 | | **L2 常规执行** | 便宜且快 | `deepseek-flash` / low | 资料整理、摘要、日常写作、模板产出 | | **L3 复杂执行** | 性价比高 | `deepseek-flash` / max | 长文写作、多步脚本、表格分析、多来源整理 | | **L4 难题解决** | 较贵 | `deepseek-v4-pro` / high | 严谨分析、代码实现与调试、关键结论、方案设计 | | **L5 关键任务** | 最贵最慢 | `deepseek-v4-pro` / max | 疑难推理、终审复核、关键决策支持、最高质量交付 | > 表格是**出厂默认值**。你可以在设置页把任意一档换上你配置的任何 provider / 模型（例如 MiniMax、9router 里的模型）。 ### 成本控制建议 - 默认让主控「能用 L2 就不上 L4」； - 大批量同类任务用 L1/L2 并行，比单个高价模型串行更划算； - 只有**错误代价高**的交付才用 L4/L5，并且只让 L5 做终审而不是全程主力。 --- ## 配置每档模型 **入口：设置（Settings）→ 团队模式**（与插件页 **插件 → DSH Maestro5 → 行 `maestro-levels` → Configure** 是同一份配置）。 每一档一行，三个字段： | 字段 | 来源 | 说明 | | --- | --- | --- | | **Provider** | 当前 DSH 可路由的 provider 列表 | 如 `deepseek-official`、`deepseek-account`、`minimaxcode`、`myrouter` —— 名称取自模型目录，悬停可看路由 id | | **模型** | 所选 provider 下实际配置的模型 | 如 `deepseek-flash` / `deepseek-v4-pro` / `MiniMax-M3.1-Flash-Preview` / `TopCoder`…；另有「自定义模型 ID…」兜底 | | **思考强度** | **所选模型自带的 efforts** | DeepSeek：默认 / off / low / high / max；MiniMax：默认 / off / low / medium / high；无思考档的模型只有「默认」 | 交互细节： - 切换 Provider 会自动选中该 provider 的第一个模型并清空思考强度； - 切换模型会重置思考强度（不同模型支持的档位不同）； - 「默认」表示不显式指定，由模型自己的默认思考强度决定。 ### 生效方式（重要） - 点 **保存** → 配置写入当前 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`（`- id: maestro-levels` 的 override），重启后保留； - **保存后需要重启 DSH Desktop**，且只对**新建**的会话生效——DSH 的 preset 在会话创建时固定，已运行的会话保持原配置； - 想恢复出厂默认：把五档改回上表的值保存 + 重启即可。 --- ## 工作原理 ``` ┌──────────────────────────── dsh-maestro5（bundle） ───────────────────────────┐ │ cordis.patch.yml │ │ ├── 根层设置行 maestro-levels（Config.levels 是 volatile，设置页可写） │ │ ├── preset team 主控 Lead（人设 + 全部工具 + 5 个 delegate 工具） │ │ └── preset team-l1…l5 五个档位（人设 + 全套执行工具） │ │ │ │ index.js Host 半：注册 maestroLevels 服务（读 volatile 配置） │ │ client.js Client 半：注册「设置 → 团队模式」页 + 插件行配置页 │ └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ │ 安装时自动注册 ▼ 新会话可选「团队主控」 │ ▼ 主控 Lead ──选档──► delegate_l1 … delegate_l5 │ │ agentOptions = !!js maestroLevels.agentOptionsFor('lN') │ ▼ │ team-lN preset 子智能体（独立上下文） │ │ 完成通知（不轮询） ▼ ▼ 汇总 / 复核 / 交付 ◄────┘ ``` 关键机制： - **安装即注册**：DSH 安装 bundle 时读取 `dsh.bundle.patch`，把设置行与 6 个 preset 插入 profile 层栈； - **配置可持久化**：`maestro-levels` 行的 `levels` 字段标了 `.volatile()`，因此能被设置表单编辑、由 config-editor 写回 profile 的 patch 层； - **模型注入 preset**：主控的 5 个 `delegate-*` 委派工具通过 `!!js ctx.get('maestroLevels').agentOptionsFor('l1')` 在挂载时读取当前配置，把模型写进子智能体； - **浏览器半手写**：`client.js` 是 `window.__ModuleLoader__` 工厂包，注册到 `settings.section` 与 `plugins.row.config` 两个槽位，**不需要打包器**。 --- ## 自定义与开发 ### 目录结构 ``` DSH-Maestro5/ ├── package.json # bundle 清单：dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client（浏览器半）+ engines.dsh ├── cordis.patch.yml # 设置行 maestro-levels + 主控 preset + 5 个档位 preset ├── index.js # Host 半：maestroLevels 服务 ├── client.js # Client 半：设置页 / 插件行配置页 ├── locale/{zh,en}.json # 插件显示名与描述 ├── icon.svg # 插件图标 ├── docs/screenshots/ # README 截图 ├── README.md / README.en.md └── LICENSE ``` ### 本地开发 ```sh # 把本地目录装进 profile（link，改完重启即生效） dsh plu

plugins.description: Flow Next for DeepSeek Harness: task context, native/PTC selection and check evidence. Experimental community preset.
plugins.readme_text:
# Flow Next for DeepSeek Harness

[中文](#中文说明) · [License](LICENSE) · [Compatibility and validation](docs/validation.md)

An experimental **native DSH agent preset**, combining task context, native/PTC interface selection, execution evidence, and stage reports. It preserves the host's permission system and full tool capability selection. It does not add a second model or an autonomous benchmark loop.

This is the standalone distribution of the author's Flow Next 1.8.3 mode. It is independently maintained and is not an official DeepSeek product. It is a separate project from other tools named Flow Next.

## Install

Tested with **DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.2**. The bundle declares this exact host version because DSH's preview APIs change quickly.

Open DSH's **Plugins** page, choose the external bundle installation option, and enter:

```text
https://github.com/sonwe1e/dsh-flow-next.git#v1.8.3
```

The Plugin Manager installs and enables the bundle in the current profile. When DSH requires a restart, restart it, create a new conversation, and choose **Flow Next（试用）** before its first turn. Run `/flow-next status` to check the actual loaded version. Installing files does not migrate an existing conversation.

If you already use an earlier private distribution that registers the `flow-next` preset, disable that bundle before enabling this one; both register the same preset identifier. This release does not modify an existing installation automatically.

The official CLI's `dsh plugin --profile <name> add <spec>` installs a dependency. If using that path, also select the installed bundle in the profile's Plugins page; a dependency on disk alone does not establish activation.

## Use

Give it your ordinary task. It can answer a small question directly or work through repository changes using existing instructions and checks. Complex work can use the following tools and commands without turning every answer into a report:

| Surface | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `flow_select` | Choose native tools or PTC for a later request boundary while retaining full capabilities. |
| `flow_task` | Link native task entries to observed artifacts, checks, gaps, and a next action. |
| `flow_run_check` | Execute one check with explicit inputs and expected names through native execution and permission controls. |
| `flow_check` | Inspect execution observations; retain prospective scope, coverage declarations, and explanations. |
| `flow_stage` | Read a stage report, keeping failures, skips, disabled and unknown results distinct. |
| `/flow-next status` | Show the loaded version, current interface, and switch budget. |
| `/flow-next report`, `task`, `history`, `stage` | Read the relevant retained state without requesting a model response. |

A recorded zero exit, an agent's coverage declaration, and product acceptance remain different claims. The plugin cannot certify semantic correctness, visual quality, or that every relevant test was selected. Historical observations retain their provenance and do not become fresh acceptance merely by resuming a conversation.

## Development

```sh
npm ci --ignore-scripts
npm test
npm pack --dry-run
```

The unit tests exercise the existing state, evidence, coordination, and check mechanisms. The separate installed-host smoke test uses fixed responses and blocks provider dispatch; see [validation](docs/validation.md). There is no claimed general improvement in task success, speed, or cost. Run comparative model trials separately when evaluating those outcomes.

The runtime files are under `lib/` and `modes/`. The root entry registers only Flow Next. The research benchmark panel, personal feedback records, model experiments, and project transcripts are excluded from this distribution. Runtime utility names such as `telemetry.js` describe local parsing helpers; this bundle does not mount the research collector or configure a remote reporting destination. DSH itself retains its own data and telemetry settings.

## Distribution

This package uses the official `dsh.bundle.patch` manifest and a Cordis patch. The repository is tagged `dsh-plugin` for community discovery. Its [custom market index](marketplace/index.json) follows DSH's documented format and pins install sources to Git commits; add the raw index URL under **Plugins → Discover → Add index source** after enabling **Custom plugin markets**.

```text
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sonwe1e/dsh-flow-next/main/marketplace/index.json
```

The index also lists the companion [Ambitious Prompt](https://github.com/sonwe1e/ambitious-prompt) skill bundle. The index is a community-maintained source, with no claim of official review or endorsement. Native mode functionality requires DSH; copying these files into another agent's skills directory does not reproduce the runtime mechanisms.

References: [official plugin bundles](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/bundle/README.md), [official custom market format](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/docs/user/guide/plugin-market.md), [community contribution guidance](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md).

## 中文说明

Flow Next 是 DeepSeek Harness 的原生模式插件，保留原生权限和完整工具能力，增加任务上下文、native/PTC 切换、检查执行证据与阶段报告。它不强制简单任务填写计划或输出报告，检查记录也不自动等于产品验收。

在 DSH 的插件页面安装上面的 Git 地址，启用后新建会话，首轮前选择「Flow Next（试用）」，用 `/flow-next status` 核对版本。当前公开版仅声明与实际验证过的 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 兼容；预览版宿主升级后应重新验证。

本仓库独立整理运行代码和相关回归测试，未发布研究工作区、真实项目会话或个人配置。它不是 DeepSeek 官方产品。源码采用 MIT 许可证；宿主预设快照的来源与原许可证见 [NOTICE.md](NOTICE.md)。

plugins.description: MCP bridge for DSH: Codex dispatches coding tasks to a DSH headless agent over a loopback Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-codex-mcp

A **DSH host plugin** that runs a loopback-only **Streamable HTTP MCP server** inside the DeepSeek Harness process, so **Codex can dispatch coding work to DSH** over MCP — no shell wrapper, no per-call script.

[中文说明](#中文说明) · MIT · zero runtime dependencies

```
Codex CLI
  └─ MCP (Streamable HTTP + Bearer token)      http://127.0.0.1:39391/mcp
       └─ DSH host plugin dsh-codex-mcp        (lives inside the DSH process)
            └─ node <dsh install>/lib/bin.js --profile headless --json
                 └─ DSH reads/writes code, runs commands, streams NDJSON events
```

DSH is still the agent that writes the code. Codex only dispatches the task, reads back a structured result, and re-runs the acceptance command itself.

![dsh-codex-mcp: Codex dispatches to a DSH headless agent over a loopback MCP endpoint](assets/screenshot-1.png)

![Install, check and dispatch from the terminal](assets/screenshot-2.png)

---

## Why a plugin and not a DSH tool

A regular DSH agent tool (`ctx.tools`) is visible only to DSH's own model — Codex cannot see it. To be callable from another agent, the capability has to leave the process. This plugin therefore:

- starts an HTTP MCP endpoint on `127.0.0.1` when the DSH host loads it, and closes it when the plugin unloads (`ctx.effect` returns a disposer);
- speaks the MCP Streamable HTTP transport and legacy JSON-RPC directly — the package deliberately has **no dependencies**, so there is no MCP SDK or `@deepseek-ai/*` package to resolve inside a profile;
- reuses the DSH install that hosts it: it finds `@deepseek-ai/dsh`'s `lib/bin.js` next to `resources/app`, or wherever `DSH_APP_ROOT` / `dshCli` points.

## Features

- **Three MCP tools** — `dsh_env`, `dsh_run`, `dsh_resume`. New sessions and follow-ups both carry the session id back to the caller.
- **Structured results** — final answer, `session`, `cwd`, `exit`, `turn_end`, per-turn token usage, step count, duration; failures also return the stderr tail and a classified reason.
- **Honest failure** — a call is an MCP error when: it timed out, the child exited non-zero, `turn_end` was not `completed`, no `final` event arrived, or the final answer is empty. DSH's own "I'm done" is never taken at face value by the plugin.
- **Process-tree kill** on timeout (`taskkill /T /F` on Windows, process group elsewhere), so no orphaned agents.
- **Concurrency cap** (`maxConcurrentRuns`, default 4) — extra calls fail fast instead of queueing silently.
- **Loopback-only + Bearer token** — token generated on first start (`32` random bytes, `0600`), compared with sha256 + `timingSafeEqual`, path `$DSH_HOME/codex-mcp.token` by default.
- **Bounded NDJSON parsing** — malformed lines are counted, not fatal; event count, line size and stderr tail are all capped.
- **Bilingual tool descriptions** (`locale/en.json`, `locale/zh.json`) so the calling model reads instructions in its own language.

## Requirements

| | |
| --- | --- |
| DSH | Desktop or CLI install whose `@deepseek-ai/dsh` supports `--profile headless --json` |
| Node | `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` (the host's own Node is used) |
| DSH credentials | a model API key already stored in your `~/.dsh` profile (the GUI Models page or the credentials service) |
| DSH profile | a `headless` profile; the desktop profile rejects `--json` and is managed by the desktop app |

## Install

```sh
# from GitHub (recommended)
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:GEB-lab/dsh-codex-mcp

# from a release tarball
dsh plugin --profile desktop add https://github.com/GEB-lab/dsh-codex-mcp/releases/latest/download/dsh-codex-mcp.tgz

# local checkout, for development (changes apply after a host restart)
dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-codex-mcp
```

`dsh plugin` is the DSH plugin command: it forwards to the profile's package manager, then selects the new bundle in `dsh.profile.bundles`. If HMR is on, the plugin loads immediately; otherwise restart DSH.

Check that it came up:

```sh
curl -i http://127.0.0.1:39391/mcp -X POST \
  -H "authorization: Bearer $(cat ~/.dsh/codex-mcp.token)" \
  -H "content-type: application/json" \
  -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"initialize","params":{"protocolVersion":"2025-06-18","capabilities":{}}}'
```

or, without curl:

```sh
node scripts/smoke.mjs                        # protocol + dsh_env only, spends no tokens
node scripts/smoke.mjs --task "reply SMOKE_OK" --cwd /path/to/project
```

The smoke script prints the exact `config.toml` block for your machine.

## Codex configuration

`~/.codex/config.toml`:

```toml
[mcp_servers.dsh_codex]
url = "http://127.0.0.1:39391/mcp"
http_headers = { Authorization = "Bearer <contents of $DSH_HOME/codex-mcp.token>" }
startup_timeout_sec = 30
tool_timeout_sec = 3600
enabled = true
```

`codex mcp list` should then show `dsh_codex … enabled  Bearer token`.

Then, from Codex:

> Use `dsh_run` to have DSH, in `C:\work\proj`, add typed input support to `src/sum.mjs` plus three `node:test` cases; only touch `src/` and `test/`. After it returns, run `node --test test\*.test.mjs` yourself and report the result.

## Tool reference

### `dsh_env()`
No side effects, no tokens spent. Returns JSON: `plugin{name,version,pid,startedAt}`, `mcp{url,token,tokenFile}`, `dsh{cli,version,profile,dshHome,permissionMode,node,nodeVersion}`, `defaults{cwd,timeoutSec}`, `runtime{activeRuns,maxConcurrentRuns}`, and a ready-to-paste `codexConfig` snippet.

### `dsh_run(task, cwd?, timeout_sec?, include_events?)`
Starts a **new** headless session. `task` is sent on stdin (no quoting problems, no argv length limit). On success the text result looks like:

```
[DSH done] turn 1 · steps 1 · 2.9s
session: session-1a2b3c4d-...
cwd: /work/proj
exit: 0 · turn_end: completed
usage: in 469 / out 8 / cacheRead 5760 / total 6237

--- final answer ---
DSH_PLUGIN_OK

--- continue this session ---
dsh_resume({ "session_id": "session-1a2b3c4d-...", "task": "<next task>" })
```

### `dsh_resume(session_id, task, cwd?, timeout_sec?)`
Continues an existing session. It must run in the **same `cwd`** as the original, otherwise DSH refuses before starting (and the plugin says so).

Failure payloads carry the classification (`timed out`, `exit code N`, `turn_end was X`, `no final answer`, `empty final answer`), the stderr tail, event counts, and a next-step hint for the usual causes (missing credentials, wrong profile, unknown session, cwd mismatch, unauthorized).

## Configuration

All keys live under this entry's `config` in `cordis.patch.yml` (bundle default) or in `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml` (your override):

```yaml
- id: dsh-codex-mcp
  name: dsh-codex-mcp
  config:
    port: 39400
    defaultCwd: 'D:\code'
```

| key | default | meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `host` | `127.0.0.1` | bind address; non-loopback is refused unless `allowNonLoopback: true` |
| `port` | `39391` | `0` picks a free port (`dsh_env` reports the real one) |
| `path` | `/mcp` | endpoint path |
| `tokenFile` | `$DSH_HOME/codex-mcp.token` | Bearer token; created when missing |
| `regenerateToken` | `false` | rotate the token on next start |
| `dshHome` | `$DSH_HOME` or `~/.dsh` | child `DSH_HOME` |
| `profile` | `headless` | child DSH profile |
| `permissionMode` | `danger-full-access` | child `DSH_PERMISSION_MODE` |
| `defaultCwd` | host cwd | used when a call omits `cwd` |
| `defaultTimeoutSec` | `3600` | per-call timeout |
| `maxConcurrentRuns` | `4` | parallel headless tasks |
| `dshCli` | auto-detected | explicit path to `…/@deepseek-ai/dsh/lib/bin.js` |
| `nodePath` | auto-detected | explicit Node executable |
| `locale` | `zh` | `en` or `zh` for MCP tool text |
| `includeEvents` | `false` | append the raw NDJSON event tail to results |

`~/`, relative paths and `$DSH_HOME` are expanded; unknown keys are ignored.

## Security model

- Binds `127.0.0.1` by default. Requests whose peer is not loopback are rejected even if you widen the bind, unless you opt in with `allowNonLoopback: true`.
- Every request needs the Bearer token; the endpoint returns `401` with `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer realm="dsh-codex-mcp"` otherwise. Token comparison is constant-time over SHA-256 di

plugins.description: Noema long-term memory plugin for DSH: durable, inspectable agent memory with recall tools and a settings page.
plugins.readme_text:
DSH Noema

Long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness — durable, inspectable agent memory backed by Noema.
Recall Before Work • Import From 9 Agent Tools • Settings-Page Memory Management • Crash Keep-Alive • Hot Reload

npm: @zseven-w/dsh-noema · Tested with DSH 0.2.0-rc.2

English · 简体中文 · 繁體中文 · 日本語 · 한국어 · Français · Español · Deutsch · Português · Русский · हिन्दी · Türkçe · ไทย · Tiếng Việt · Bahasa Indonesia


The Noema Memory settings page — import sources, memory management, and live server status

## Why DSH Noema DSH Noema connects [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) with [Noema](https://github.com/ZSeven-W/noema) — a local-first, non-vector memory system for coding agents — so an Agent keeps durable knowledge across sessions instead of starting every conversation from zero.
### 🧠 Durable Recall Memories persist as inspectable Markdown files under `NOEMA_ROOT` (default `~/.agent-memory/`). `noema_recall` loads relevant context at the start of a session; `noema_search`, `noema_browse`, `noema_catalog`, and `noema_recall_graph` cover lookup, exploration, and auditing. ### 📥 Import From Other Tools `noema_import` reads the memory files of ten other AI coding tools — Codex, Claude Code, opencode, Cursor, Grok, WorkBuddy, Antigravity, Trae, Qoder, Hermes — splits them into sections, and saves each as a durable memory. A content-keyed ledger deduplicates across runs and across tools that share files.
### 🛠️ Settings-Page Management The Noema Memory settings page configures the server command, memory root, budgets, idle/call timeouts, and the guidance section — and a Manage memories card searches, browses, adds, reviews, and deletes stored memories directly. ### 🩺 Keep-Alive The memory server stays up: idle timeout defaults to never, and a keep-alive loop restarts the `noema-mcp` child in the background when it crashes or exits, with a configurable check interval and restart backoff.
### 🔍 Smart Entity Extraction Noema's extraction engine combines jieba word segmentation with high-precision signals — English proper nouns, CJK names and technical terms, quoted topics, and repetition — with stopword and path filters, so the PageIndex topic catalog stays clean. ### ⚡ Hot Reload After the first boot, the plugin never needs a restart again: `pnpm run build` hot-reloads the host plugin through Cordis HMR, and `ppnpm run build:client` hot-swaps the browser bundle over the client-hmr SSE channel.
## Install into DSH ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add @zseven-w/dsh-noema@latest dsh web ``` Or, for local development straight from the source tree: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add link:/path/to/dsh-noema dsh web ``` The `link:` protocol symlinks the profile dependency to this repository, so rebuilds are visible immediately and Cordis HMR can watch the compiled output. The plugin bundles the `noema-mcp` binary through per-platform optional npm packages. To build it yourself instead, run `cargo build --release -p noema-mcp` inside the bundled `noema` submodule, or point the Server command setting at any `noema-mcp` build. ## Memory Tools The model-facing tools mirror the Noema MCP surface: | Tool | What it does | | --- | --- | | `noema_recall` | Recall relevant memories for a query, with a token budget. | | `noema_search` | Full-text search over stored memories. | | `noema_browse` | Browse the PageIndex catalog for a topic or entity. | | `noema_catalog` | Render the full memory catalog as markdown. | | `noema_recall_graph` | Multi-hop recall through links and shared entities. | | `noema_neighbors` | One graph hop from a memory. | | `noema_explain` | Explain why a memory was or was not recalled. | | `noema_remember` | Save a durable fact, decision, constraint, or preference. | | `noema_review_list` | List pending review candidates. | | `noema_review_decide` | Accept, reject, edit, or merge a candidate. | | `noema_forget` | Tombstone or hard-delete a memory. | | `noema_policy_get` / `noema_policy_set` | Read or update the write policy. | | `noema_status` | Server and tenant status: counts, index health, storage root. | | `noema_import` | Import memories from other AI coding tools. | Each tool returns a uniform envelope `{ ok, tool, text }` where `text` carries the full server output. ## Import memories from other tools | Source id | Global files | Workspace files | | --- | --- | --- | | `codex` | `~/.codex/AGENTS.md` + the Codex memory pipeline: `~/.codex/memories/MEMORY.md`, `memory_summary.md`, `rollout_summaries/*.md`, `extensions/ad_hoc/notes/*.md` (`raw_memories.md` skipped — it is the uncurated feed) | `AGENTS.md`, `AGENTS.local.md` | | `claude-code` | `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md`, `~/.claude/CLAUDE.local.md`, `~/.claude/MEMORY.md` | `CLAUDE.md`, `CLAUDE.local.md`, `MEMORY.md` | | `opencode` | `~/.config/opencode/AGENTS.md` | `AGENTS.md` | | `cursor` | `~/.cursor/rules/*.mdc`, `~/.cursorrules` | `.cursor/rules/*.mdc`, `.cursorrules` | | `grok` | `~/.grok/AGENTS.md` + the Grok cross-session memory: `~/.grok/memory/MEMORY.md`, per-project `MEMORY.md`, and `sessions/*.md` summaries | `AGENTS.md` | | `workbuddy` | `~/.codebuddy/CODEBUDDY.md` (WorkBuddy memory file), `~/.workbuddy/AGENTS.md`, `~/.workbuddy/memory.md`, `~/.config/workbuddy/AGENTS.md`, `~/Library/Application Support/WorkBuddy/AGENTS.md` | `AGENTS.md`, `CODEBUDDY.md` | | `antigravity` | `~/.antigravity/AGENTS.md`, `~/.config/antigravity/AGENTS.md`, `~/Library/Application Support/Antigravity/AGENTS.md` (best-effort; no documented global memory store yet) | `AGENTS.md`, `AGENTS.local.md` | | `trae` | `~/.trae/AGENTS.md`, `~/.trae/memory/`, `~/.trae/rules/` (plus the `~/.trae-cn` variants) | `AGENTS.md`, `.trae/rules/` | | `qoder` | `~/.qoder-cn/AGENTS.md`, `~/.qoder-cn/rules/`, the auto-memory roots `~/.qoder-cn/memory/` and `~/.qoder-cn/projects/*/memory/` (plus `~/.qoder` variants) | `AGENTS.md`, `AGENTS.local.md`, `.qoder/rules/` | | `hermes` | `~/.hermes/memories/` (`MEMORY.md` + `USER.md`) and the global `~/.hermes/SOUL.md` | `.hermes.md`, `HERMES.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md` | - The `source` argument selects one tool, or omit it to run every source enabled in settings. - The `path` argument selects the workspace root for project-scoped files (defaults to the session workspace; workspace files only load when the Import workspace files setting is on). - Imports are deduplicated through a ledger at `$DSH_HOME/storages/dsh-noema-imports.json`, keyed by file path +

plugins.description: Time-shifting task delegation for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): plan tasks at leisure, they run unattended off-peak, come back to a report. Human-adjudicated, desktop + web.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-lowtide **Queue tasks when it's busy. They run on their own when it's cheap.** Semi-auto or full-auto, off the model's peak hours and peak prices. A must-have plugin for DeepSeek Harness. **English** | [简体中文](./README.zh-CN.md) | [繁體中文](./README.zh-HK.md) | [العربية](./docs/README.ar.md) | [Deutsch](./docs/README.de.md) | [Español](./docs/README.es.md) | [Français](./docs/README.fr.md) | [Italiano](./docs/README.it.md) | [한국어](./docs/README.ko.md)
--- ![hero](./assets/screenshots/hero.png)

Three tasks waiting in the queue, the price status glowing in the session header, auto-run when your window opens

## Introduction lowtide is a plugin for [DeepSeek Harness (dsh)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh). The problem it solves is plain and perfectly natural: Usually, when you want an agent to do some work, you sit at the computer, send the agent an instruction, wait for the reply, and then review it by hand. But this workflow seems to forget that you have plenty of idle time — and a chance to dodge the peak/off-peak pricing that some models charge. With lowtide installed, the day goes like this: whenever a job crosses your mind during the day, toss it in the queue, glance at it, release it. The tasks pile up until the time you set (say, after 7 PM — that's when DeepSeek is at valley pricing), then run by themselves. Next morning you open the report: keep what went well, send back what didn't. That's all it is. But use it for a week and your working rhythm genuinely slows down — and don't forget, "time is money, efficiency is life"... A few key capabilities: - Four execution strategies: single, iterative, sampling, review — from "one pass is enough" to "run five candidates and I'll pick" - 168 unit tests + 10 end-to-end specs, CI green across ubuntu / windows × node 22 / 24 - One build artifact serves both desktop and web — install once, works on both - Off-peak execution lands in DeepSeek's valley hours: the same batch costs about half of what peak would ## A normal day with an agent might look like this… **Ten minutes before clocking out.** You've finished reviewing code, so you file three tickets for tomorrow: a refactor (iterative, 3 rounds), a weekly report (single), and a design you're unsure about (sampling, 4 candidates). Release them all, shut down, leave. Tomorrow at your desk, the morning report says: the refactor's done, the report's drafted, and four candidate designs sit side by side, each with its cost written out. **Friday night.** Queue a week's worth of chores in one go: dependency cleanup, missing tests, data scripts. Weekends are valley price around the clock. You go out; it works from home. Monday you check the report — retry what failed, merge what's good. **A 10 AM brainwave.** You're mid-conversation with the agent about an urgent bug when you think "hey, update the docs too." The intercept card pops up: running now costs peak price, tonight it's about half — the difference is spelled out. Click "queue for off-peak"; your draft survives untouched, and you go back to the bug. **An always-on server.** You've got a machine running dsh 24/7. Switch to L3 full-auto, then file tasks from anywhere through the API (`POST /ds-lowtide/tasks`). It runs them on schedule and writes the report. Nobody's watching, but the sandbox, the daily budget, and the file locks are all still there. **Deliverables for a client.** Use the review strategy: run once, then automatically open an independent session that tears the result apart through your chosen focus (say, "hunt for data-source errors"). In the morning you don't get a bare result — you get a result plus a critical review. **Living abroad.** You're in San Francisco; DeepSeek's peak is Beijing time, which for you lands in the evening and night before. Settings converts the official hours to your local clock, one click to adopt. You set windows by your own schedule, and the books always stay aligned with the official table. ## How lowtide works ``` ① Intake ② Adjudicate ③ Execute ④ Accept Whenever you have The queue dock When the off-peak When you're back: a moment: one-click groups tasks by window opens: five open the report — from the intercept workspace; triage preflight gates pass, results + diff card, or file a → line by line: → then sandboxed runs → + actual spend ticket (4 strategies) ✓approve ⏸defer one batch per window + money saved ✕drop / approve-all ``` A task's life: `pending-review → queued → preflight → running → done / failed / stale / timeout`, plus `deferred` (postponed) and `dropped` (soft-deleted, restorable). Step two is where lowtide differs from a "fully automated script": **every task must be released by your hand before it runs** (in L2, you release the whole batch at once, 30 minutes before the window). The machine cannot move itself into the run queue. Execution is automated; decisions are not. That's why you can safely be absent. ## A tour of the lowtide interface **The new-task modal.** Four strategies side by side, each with a plain-language hint; rounds, priority, and run mode ride along per task — no trip back to settings. Tasks land as "pending review". Nothing enters the queue without passing you. ![new-task-modal](./assets/screenshots/new-task-modal.png) **Advanced options.** Model, reasoning effort, priority from 0 to 9, fresh session or continue-previous, and the locked-files list — all in one small pane. Locked files, briefly: anything on the list gets sha256-checked before execution, and if it doesn't match what you filed, the task goes stale and refuses to run. Otherwise the file you queued against could be rewritten by another task while waiting, and this one would blindly stomp on it. ![advanced-options](./assets/screenshots/advanced-options.png) **Pick any model.** Batch runs default to the official `deepseek-flash` (DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash; the retired `deepseek-v4-flash` name still routes there at Flash prices), but each task can pick its own model — anything connected to your Harness is in the dropdown, grouped by provider. Private providers work too. Non-official models have no public price table, so the ledger honestly says "price unknown"; add a price override in settings if you want the bookkeeping exact. ![model-picker](./assets/screenshots/model-picker.png) **The window editor.** Multi-segment, overnight, per-weekday — all fine. Underneath is a live 24-hour price band: red for peak, green for valley, and a marker showing where you are right now. Outside UTC+8, one click on "adopt official peak hours" converts Beijing time to your local clock. ![window-editor](./assets/screenshots/window-editor.png) **The settings page.** Window hours, tasks per batch, per-task duration cap, concurrency, daily budget, report history, autonomy level, price overrides — all graphical, no config files. The official pricing rules (including the new all-weekend valley) are explained in human language on the same page. ![settings](./assets/screenshots/settings.png) Three more pieces of UI appear in daily use: the **price pill** (session header — busy/idle, queue size; click it to edit windows), the **peak-hours intercept card** (type at peak, it appears; the price difference is spelled out; your draft survives), and the **execution report** (the morning briefing: savings first, anomalies pinned, candidates awaiting your pick, one-click Markdown copy). ## About lowtide workspaces Every task runs inside a workspace. That single dropdown decides three things. **Which files it can touch.** Tasks run in a sandbox whose boundary is the workspace directory. Pick wrong and at best it can't find the files; at worst it edits something it shouldn't. **Who it queues with.** Tasks in the same workspace run serially (two tasks never fight over one repo); different workspaces run in paralle

plugins.description: One Dark Pro (classic) theme for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: a Settings -> General switcher with a full 156-token override layer, 1:1 colors from the VS Code extension.
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH · One Dark Pro Theme

给 **DeepSeek Harness Web GUI** 的 One Dark Pro（经典版）主题。按 VS Code 扩展 `zhuangtongfa.material-theme 3.20.3` 的主题文件 **1:1 取色**，覆盖 DSH 的整套主题令牌：背景、文字、边框、按钮、状态色、滚动条、Markdown 代码块与 Shiki 语法高亮。

- 在 **设置 → 通用 → 主题** 里切换「One Dark Pro / 原生」
- 只影响**深色外观**；浅色外观保持 DSH 原样
- Markdown 行内代码（`像这样的小方块`）的文字用 One Dark Pro 关键字紫 `#c678dd`、字号与正文一致并跟随「字号大小」设置缩放、半粗（600）
- Markdown 加粗文字用 One Dark Pro 的链接蓝 `#61afef`（深色外观下）
- 选择会被记住（刷新 / 重启 GUI 后仍在；桌面版端口变化时用 cookie 兜底），多窗口同步
- 启动时会自动叠加上主题图层（多次延迟重试 + 每 2 秒轻量校准），不需要手动切换一次
- 不修改 DSH 安装目录的任何文件；卸载即恢复

![One Dark Pro 色板](docs/onedark-palette.png)

> 设计取舍与实现记录见 [PLAN.md](PLAN.md)；仓库：<https://github.com/Cherryxxh/DSH-One-Dark-Pro-Theme>。

---

## 安装

```powershell
# 从 GitHub 安装
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "git+https://github.com/Cherryxxh/DSH-One-Dark-Pro-Theme.git"

# 或者从本地目录安装（目录名可以是仓库根目录）
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "C:\path\to\DSH-One-Dark-Pro-Theme"
```

本仓库的包名是 `dsh-theme-one-dark-pro`，仓库名是 `DSH-One-Dark-Pro-Theme`，两者可以不同。首次安装后如界面未出现设置行，重启一次 DSH（bundle 名册在启动时组装）；之后切换主题不需要重启。

## 使用

1. 打开 **设置 → 通用**，在「外观」「字号大小」下面找到 **主题**。
2. 点 **One Dark Pro**：立即应用配色；如果当前是浅色外观，会自动切到深色。
3. 点 **原生**：撤掉本插件的配色，回到 DSH 默认（外观深浅仍由「外观」那行决定）。
4. 之后在「外观」里手动切浅色，界面就回到 DSH 原生浅色；再切回深色，One Dark Pro 会自动恢复。

## 配色来源

| 项目 | 来源 |
| --- | --- |
| 色值 | VS Code 扩展 `zhuangtongfa.material-theme 3.20.3` 的 `themes/OneDark-Pro.json`（223 个 UI 颜色键 + 271 条语法颜色规则） |
| 浅色面 | DSH `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-theme` 0.2.1-rc.2 的样式表默认值（快照：`tools/reference/dsh-defaults.json`） |
| 许可 | One Dark Pro 扩展为 MIT；本插件只使用色值数据（颜色本身不受版权保护），未复制扩展代码 |

## 覆盖范围

`themes/one-dark-pro.json` 里共 **156 个令牌**：

| 分组 | 令牌 | 代表值 |
| --- | --- | --- |

| 品牌 / 按钮 | `brand-*`、`button-*` | 主按钮 `#404754`（VS Code `button.background`）、悬停 `#4b5263`、按钮文字 `#ffffff` |

| 侧栏 | `specific-sidebar-*` | `#21252b`、`#2c313a`、`#61afef` |
| Shiki 语法 | 11 个 token 色 | 见下表 |
| 主题专属样式（令牌无法表达） | Markdown 行内代码、加粗文字 | 行内代码 `#c678dd`（关键字紫）+ `font-size:1em` + `font-weight:600`；加粗文字 `var(--dsw-alias-link)`（`#61afef` 链接蓝）。均随主题图层注入/移除 |
| 静态色阶（16 个被组件直接引用的步进） | `static-neutral-00/50/100/200/400/700/800/850/1000`、`static-neutral-bluish-00/400/1000`、`static-blue-400/450/500/600` | 白/黑/浅色步进保持中性；卡片/悬停步进 `neutral-850 → #323842`、`neutral-800 → #3e4452`、`neutral-700 → #4b5263`；蓝色换成 One Dark 蓝 |

### 语法高亮映射

| DSH Shiki 令牌 | One Dark Pro 颜色 | VS Code 作用域 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| comment | `#7f848e` | `comment`（原版为斜体） |
| constant | `#d19a66` | `constant.numeric` |
| function | `#61afef` | `entity.name.function` |
| keyword | `#c678dd` | `keyword` |
| link | `#61afef` | `textLink.foreground` |
| parameter | `#e06c75` | `variable.parameter`（JS/TS 规则） |
| punctuation | `#abb2bf` | `punctuation` |
| string | `#98c379` | `string` |
| string-expression | `#56b6c2` | 正则 / 内嵌表达式 |

### 对比度实测（深色面）

| 组合 | 前景 | 背景 | 对比度 | 门槛 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 正文 / 底色 | `#abb2bf` | `#282c34` | 6.57 | 4.5 ✅ |
| 正文 / 抬升面 | `#abb2bf` | `#21252b` | 7.22 | 4.5 ✅ |
| 正文 / 选中面 | `#abb2bf` | `#2c313a` | 6.13 | 4.5 ✅ |

复跑：`node tools/contrast.mjs`（硬性项不达标会以非零码退出）。

## 实现方式（可维护性）

DSH 的 `ctx.theme` 提供两种扩展点。设置里的「外观」行只有 `light / dark / system` 三个硬编码方块，第三方 `register()` 的 theme id 既不进 UI 也不进设置 schema（不持久化），所以本插件走官方认可的第二种：

- `ctx.theme.overrideTokens(source, { token: { light, dark } })` 叠加一层别名令牌；
- 自建一行 `settings.general.item` 做切换；
- 只在**解析后的外观是深色**时叠加图层，浅色时撤掉——因此浅色外观与原生逐像素一致；
- 图层值由 `ui-layout` presenter 写成 body 内联 CSS 变量，切换/卸载时自动回退。

### 目录结构

```
dsh-theme-one-dark-pro/
├── PLAN.md                     # 设计/实施计划
├── README.md                   # 本文件
├── package.json                # bundle + client manifest
├── cordis.patch.yml            # 插入本插件的 loader row
├── index.js                    # Host 半边（空 apply，只为让客户端 bundle 被发现）
├── client.js                   # 构建产物：ModuleLoader bundle
├── src/client.template.js      # 可编辑的运行时源码（含 __TOKENS__ 占位）
├── themes/one-dark-pro.json    # 令牌映射真源（暗色值 + 出处注释）
├── locale/{en,zh}.json         # 插件页展示文案
├── icon.svg                    # 原创图标
├── tools/
│   ├── build.mjs               # 生成 client.js（含覆盖率校验）
│   ├── contrast.mjs            # 对比度审计
│   ├── test-runtime.mjs        # 运行时行为测试（无浏览器）
│   ├── reference/
│   │   ├── dsh-defaults.json   # DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 默认令牌双面值快照
│   │   └── onedark-palette.json# One Dark Pro 色值参考（含语法作用域）
│   └── reference/render-palette.py  # 生成 docs/onedark-palette.png
└── docs/onedark-palette.png    # 色板图
```

### 重建

```powershell
cd <仓库根目录>
node tools/build.mjs        # 改 themes/*.json 或 src/client.template.js 后必须重建
node tools/contrast.mjs     # 对比度审计
node tools/test-runtime.mjs # 运行时行为测试
```

DSH 大版本升级后，如果官方浅色调色板有变，重跑一次默认值提取并更新 `tools/reference/dsh-defaults.json` 再构建即可。

## 已知边界

- **只做深色**：浅色外观完全沿用 DSH 默认（图层在浅色下会被撤掉）。
- **静态色阶只覆盖被组件直接引用的 16 个**：`--dsw-static-neutral-850/800/700` 等被 DSH 组件直接当卡片/悬停底色用，必须一起映射，否则和别的主题插件（如护眼配色）叠加时会被染成土黄/橄榄色。其余未被引用的静态步进与 `--dsw-shadow-*`、字号/字体/圆角令牌不动。
- **8 个组件专用令牌**：`bg-l1`、`bg-layer-4`、`fill-l1/l2/tertiary`、`fill-tsp-secondary`、`label-quaternary`、`separator-primary` 被 DSH 组件引用但当前 ui-theme 样式表未定义；本插件按 One Dark Pro 语义补了值（否则这些位置无主题色）。
- `--dsw-menu-backdrop-filter` 是滤镜不是颜色，保持 DSH 默认。
- 第三方插件里**写死**的颜色无法覆盖（DSH 自带组件没有此问题）。
- 与本 profile 里已安装的 `@xiaotuchu/dsh-theme-eye-care` 同时启用时，两层会按“后叠加逐令牌获胜”混合。建议在其「背景色」行选「原生」或禁用，避免两套配色混搭。
- 本插件不是 VS Code 官方或 One Dark Pro 作者发布的项目，名称仅用于说明配色来源。

## 卸载

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-theme-one-dark-pro
```

卸载或选「原生」后界面立即恢复 DSH 默认，插件不改动 DSH 自身文件。

## 许可

插件代码 MIT。One Dark Pro 配色来自 MIT 许可的 VS Code 扩展（© Zhuang TongFa / Binaryify 等），本仓库仅使用颜色数据。
