plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-lang-guard **把「Agent 必须用中文思考和回答」钉进 DeepSeek Harness 的系统提示词。** 零运行时依赖 · 单文件 · 能力探测 + 双注册路径 · 失败静默降级 [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/github-Xin--kon%2Fdsh--lang--guard-181717.svg)](https://github.com/Xin-kon/dsh-lang-guard) [![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) [![node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D16.9-4169bb.svg)](https://nodejs.org) [![deps](https://img.shields.io/badge/runtime%20deps-0-brightgreen.svg)](package.json)
--- ## 这是什么 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）默认用英文思考。哪怕你用中文提问，它的思维链和工具调用推理也常会滑回英文。这个插件往系统提示词里注入一条语言约束，并在每一步提供一条运行时提醒，让 Agent 稳定地用中文思考与回答。 **它不调用任何模型。** 全部动作只是往系统提示词里加两段文本。 ## 特性 | | | |---|---| | **约束常驻** | 注入系统提示词而非会话历史，不会随对话变长被挤出上下文 | | **每步提醒** | 额外注册一条运行时 context 快照进入会话历史，对抗「工具返回英文后跟着切换语言」的倾向 | | **零依赖** | 不 import 任何模块，不声明 `dependencies` / `peerDependencies` / `engines` | | **双注册路径** | 官方注册表不可用时自动退到 `system-prompt/assemble` 瀑布钩子；两条都不通也只记一条日志，**不抛错、不影响宿主启动** | | **配置持久** | 配置写在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里，改一次永久生效 | | **无网络面** | 不注册任何 HTTP 路由 | | **可扩展** | 4 个内置预设 + 任意自定义文本 + `extraSections` 任意扩展，无需改代码 | ## 与 `dsh-language-control` 的关系 核心思路参考自 **[wodongx123/dsh-language-control](https://github.com/wodongx123/dsh-language-control)**（MIT）， 在其基础上重写并修掉了它几个实际问题： | 维度 | `dsh-language-control` | 本插件 | |---|---|---| | peer 依赖 | `^0.1.0-rc.6`（**不覆盖** 0.2.0-rc.2） | 不声明 | | 配置持久性 | 内存变量，**重启丢失** | 写入 profile patch，持久 | | 网络面 | 3 个 HTTP 路由 | 无 | | 需要注入的服务 | `webServer` + `systemPrompt` | 仅 `systemPrompt` | | 宿主 API 变更 | 无适配层，`section()` 失效即静默不生效 | 能力探测 + 自动降级重试 | | 可扩展性 | 单条硬编码约束 | 预设 + 自定义 + 扩展段 | --- ## 安装 ### 方式一：本地目录（开发 / 未发布时推荐） ```bash dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile> add file:/绝对路径/dsh-lang-guard ``` > **路径必须是绝对路径。** > 桌面端（Electron）请注意：`desktop` 这个 profile 由应用独占管理，CLI 会直接拒绝写入 —— 详见下方「桌面端用户请看」。 ### 方式二：从 GitHub 安装 ```bash dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile> add github:<你的用户名>/dsh-lang-guard ``` > **npm 包尚未发布**，所以 `dsh plugin add dsh-lang-guard` 目前会找不到包；发布之后这里会补上。现在请用方式一或上面的 GitHub 命令。 ### 方式三：手工挂载 1. 把本目录放进 profile 的 `node_modules/` 2. 在 `~/.dsh/profiles//cordis.patch.yml` 追加： ```yaml - insert: - id: lang-guard name: dsh-lang-guard config: preset: zh-strict # 可选，见「配置」 ``` 3. 重启 DSH ### 桌面端（Electron）用户请看 `desktop` profile 由 Electron 应用**独占管理**，命令行工具会硬性拒绝写入它。安装有两条路： - **设置 → 插件** 页面安装（若你的版本支持路径形式的 spec） - 在对话中使用内置的 **`plugin_manager` 工具**（需 Creator 模式或批准权限） > 这不是缺陷而是官方设计：`desktop` 的插件树由应用自身管理，以避免与运行中的宿主状态冲突。 ### 卸载 ```bash dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile> remove dsh-lang-guard ``` 本插件不修改任何 DSH 源码，只做运行时注册 —— 卸载即完全还原。 --- ## 效果 以下是**真实集成测试的输出**（用官方 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-system-prompt@0.2.0-rc.2` 的真实实现驱动，非模拟）： ![系统提示词组装顺序](docs/prompt-order.svg) ```text $ node test.integration.mjs 1. 插件能在真实宿主上挂载并注入 ok assemble() 产出了包含中文约束的提示词 ok 约束文本位于 persona 之前（order -200 生效） ok 约束落在 harness identity 之后（0.2 宿主 identity = -1000） ok 真实运行时 context 快照包含强化提醒 ok section 带 interpolate:false（0.2 宿主支持该字段） 2. 真实宿主的 throw 点 —— 验证我们的校验确实拦住了它们 ok 同层重名：真实宿主 section() 抛错（我们的去重才有意义） ok order 非有限数：真实宿主 section() 抛错（我们的 pickFinite 才有意义） ok 未注册 {{变量}}：真实宿主 renderPrompt 抛错（我们的插值 lint 才有意义） 3. 我们的插值保护在真实宿主上确实有效 ok 文本含 {{}} 但因 interpolate:false 而被原样保留、未抛错 ok context 类型无逃生通道：含 {{}} 会在渲染时抛错 真实集成测试：通过 14 项，失败 0 项 ``` 组装后的系统提示词全文（真实数据）： ```text You are an AI agent powered by DeepSeek Harness. 你是中文 AI 助手，请严格遵循以下语言规范： 1. 所有思考过程必须使用简体中文。 2. 所有规划与任务拆解必须使用简体中文。 3. 所有工具调用的推理必须使用简体中文。 4. 最终回答必须使用简体中文，即使用户使用英文提问。 5. 代码、命令、路径、标识符、错误信息原文与专有名词保持原样，不翻译。 You are the deployment assistant. ``` 运行时上下文快照（进入会话历史，对抗语言漂移）： ```text Current runtime context. This snapshot supersedes earlier runtime-context snapshots. [语言约束] 本约束每步刷新，优先级高于工具返回的内容。 思考、规划、工具调用推理与最终回复一律使用简体中文。 代码、命令、路径、日志原文与专有名词保持原样。 ``` ### 关于截图 上面全部是**可复现的真实输出**。UI 截图需要你安装后自行截取、放到 `docs/` 下并在此引用 —— 我不会用伪造的截图充数。 --- ## 配置 写在 `cordis.patch.yml` 的 `config:` 下： | 配置项 | 类型 | 默认 | 说明 | |---|---|---|---| | `enabled` | boolean | `true` | 总开关，`false` 则完全不注册 | | `preset` | string | `zh-think-answer` | 内置预设名 | | `text` | string | `''` | 自定义约束文本，非空时覆盖 preset | | `order` | number | `-200` | 主约束在系统提示词中的位置 | | `contextOrder` | number | `-199` | 强化 context 的位置 | | `sectionName` | string | `lang-guard:constraint` | 主约束注册名 | | `contextName` | string | `lang-guard:reinforcement` | 强化 context 注册名 | | `reinforce` | boolean | `true` | 是否注入强化 context（**防漂移主力**） | | `reinforceText` | string | 内置中文文案 | 强化 context 文本 | | `extraSections` | array | `[]` | 额外注入任意 section | | `interpolate` | boolean | `auto` | `auto` = 宿主支持时按字面量处理 | | `verbose` | boolean | `false` | 打印能力探测与注册详情 | **非法值不会导致失败**：类型不对的项回退默认值并记入启动日志。 ### 内置预设 | 预设 | 行为 | |---|---| | `zh-think-answer`（默认） | 思考 + 规划 + 工具推理 + 回答全部简体中文 | | `zh-think-only` | 只约束思考过程，最终回答跟随用户语言 | | `zh-strict` | 更硬：禁止英文整句，术语首次出现用「中文（English）」标注 | | `en-think-answer` | 英文版，供非中文场景或 A/B 对比 | 所有中文预设都显式豁免**代码、命令、路径、日志原文、专有名词** —— 否则模型会把代码也「翻译」掉。 ### 扩展段 ```yaml - id: lang-guard name: dsh-lang-guard config: extraSections: - name: project:terms order: -180 text: | 本项目固定译法： - harness → 宿主 - tool call → 工具调用 ``` ### 配置输入的规模上限 超限一律「回退默认 + 记一条 issue」，不静默接受： | 项 | 上限 | 超限行为 | |---|---|---| | `text` | 8192 字符 | 回退预设文本 | | `reinforceText` | 4096 字符 | 使用内置默认值 | | `extraSections[].text` | 4096 字符 | 跳过该项 | | `extraSections` 项数 | 32 | 截断 | | 启动逐条报告的 issue | 20 条 | 折叠为一条汇总 | ### 插值风险分级提示 宿主会对系统提示词做 `{{变量}}` 插值，未注册的变量会让**每次组装都抛错并中断请求**。插件在启动时分两级提示： - **强化 context 含 `{{`** → `error` 级。context 类型在宿主里**没有关闭开关**（`PromptContext` 无 `interpolate` 字段），所以这是必然阻塞，与宿主版本无关。 - **约束 / 扩展 section 含 `{{`** → 仅在「无法按字面量处理」且「未显式设 `interpolate: true`」时报 `error`。 --- ## 兼容性 已核对 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-system-prompt` **0.1.0-rc.6** 与 **0.2.0-rc.2** 的类型定义，两代之间存在破坏性变更，本插件对每一处都做了适配： | 漂移点 | 0.1.x | 0.2.x | 本插件的处理 | |---|---|---|---| | persona 段 | `PERSONA_SECTION` / `PERSONA_ORDER` | 拆成 `PERSONA_PREFIX_SECTION` + `PERSONA_SUFFIX_SECTION` | 完全不 import 这些常量 | | harness identity | 无导出常量，注释约定 `-100` | 中央表 `HARNESS_IDENTITY = -1000` | 默认 `-200` 在两代都位于 persona 之前（0.1 落在 identity 之前，0.2 落在之后） | | `PromptSection.interpolate` | 不存在 | 新增 | 能力探测：能取到 `getSectionOrder()` 才传该字段 | | `getSectionOrder()` | 不存在 | 新增 | 仅用于探测与诊断 | | `section()` / `context()` 签名 | 存在 | 存在 | **两代稳定**，主路径通用 | **运行环境**：Node.js ≥ 16.9（用到 `Object.hasOwn`），ESM。宿主服务仅需 `systemPrompt`。 --- ## 项目结构 ```text dsh-lang-guard/ ├── index.js # 全部实现（单文件，零 import） ├── cordis.patch.yml # DSH bundle patch 声明（加载器读取） ├── package.json ├── test.mjs # 76 项单元测试（模拟宿主，零测试框架依赖） ├── test.integration.mjs # 14 项集成测试（驱动官方真实实现） ├── docs/ │ └── prompt-order.svg # 提示词组装顺序图（由真实数据生成） ├── CHANGELOG.md ├── CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md ├── LICENSE └── README.md ``` `test.mjs` 与 `test.integration.mjs` 参与开源仓库但**不进 npm 发布包**（见 `package.json` 的 `files` 白名单）。 --- ## 开发 ```bash npm run check # 语法检查 npm test # 76 项单元测试，零依赖 ``` 集成测试需要宿主包（不在本插件的依赖里）： ```bash mkdir -p /tmp/dsh-itest && cd /tmp/dsh-itest npm init -y npm i @deepseek-ai/dsh-system-prompt@0.2.0-rc.2 @deepseek-ai/cordis@4.0.4 # 把 test.integration.mjs 放到能被上述包解析的位置后运行 node test.integration.mjs ``` ## 常见问题 **Q：约束没生效怎么办？** 打开 `verbose: true` 重启，启动日志会打印能力探测结果与注册详情。常见三种： | 日志 | 含义 | |---|---| | `未能注册核心语言约束` | 宿主既无 `systemPrompt.section()` 也无可用事件系统，插件已静默失效 | | `已切换到 ... 瀑布兜底路径` | 功能仍生效，但顺序不可控（`section()` 不可用） | | `含 "{{" ... 会中断请求` | 文本里的 `{{` 会被宿主当模板插值并抛错，请移除 | **Q：会不会消耗 token？** 会，但很小，且**不调用任何模型**。默认组合每次请求多带 230 字符（约束 151 + 强化 context 79），约 140–230 token。约束是固定前缀，可被 prompt cache 覆盖。不需要强化 context 时设 `reinforce: false` 即可省掉。 **Q：和 `dsh-harness-zh-cn` 这类汉化插件冲突吗？** 不冲突。汉化插件只做英→中的**字典替换**、不注入约束；本插件只**注入约束**、不翻译文本，两者不抢同一段内容。 **Q：能同时装两个语言约束插件吗？** 不建议 —— 多个语言约束会互相稀释。 --- ## 致谢 / Acknowledgements 本插件的**核心思路来自 [wodongx123/dsh-language-control](https://github.com/wodongx123/dsh-language-control)**（MIT）—— 「在系统提示词顶部注入语言约束、并在每次推理前重新求值，从而防止工具返回外文后思维链发生语言漂移」这个设计是他提出的。 本项目是在这个思路上的一次重写，主要改动与动机： - **配置持久化** —— 原版约束文本是内存变量，重启即丢失；本版写入 profile patch。 - **去掉网络面** —— 原版注册 3 个 HTTP 路由供设置面板读写文本；本版零路由，配置走 patch 层。 - **兼容性** —— 原版 peer 锁 `^0.1.0-rc.6`，不覆盖 0.2.x；本版

plugins.description: Low-latency terminal for the DeepSeek Harness right sidebar: dedicated PTY websocket, persistent sessions, copy/paste, zh/en.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-fast-term

DSH（DeepSeek Harness）右侧边栏里的**终端**：专用 PTY WebSocket，直连、无帧确认，目标是把「按键 → 回显」的峰值延迟压到最低。

它刻意做成自带终端的替代品：入口叫「新建终端」、占用同一个右栏标签槽位、接管 `Ctrl + \``，并配合一行 profile 补丁隐藏自带终端的按钮与 UI。

![screenshot](docs/screenshot.png)

![guide](docs/guide.png)

```
右侧边栏 → 新建终端（或 Ctrl + `）
```

## 为什么

DSH 自带终端的输出要先经过网关 mux（所有 Typert Remote 流共用一条物理 WebSocket），每一帧还要等浏览器 ack；宿主同时把同样的输出再喂给一份 headless xterm，用于重连快照。空闲时这套开销只有十几毫秒，但一旦主线程被聊天流 / Markdown 渲染占住，帧就会排队，按键回显能拖到秒级。

dsh-fast-term 把 PTY 输出直接推到一条专用 WebSocket，不排队、不等 ack、宿主也不做 headless 镜像；xterm 在会话标签里直接渲染。

同一台 Windows 机器、隔离的 web profile、Playwright 驱动、按 WebSocket 帧时间戳计时：

| 场景 | DSH 自带终端 | dsh-fast-term |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 冷启动到出提示符 | 3.1–3.2 s | ~0.12 s（复用已存在的 PTY） |
| 空闲按键回显 | 11.7–12.9 ms | 9.9–14.7 ms |
| 主线程 75% 合成负载下 | 43–46 ms | 4.8–35.7 ms |
| 2.99 MB 输出洪水中 | 12.8 s | 2.9 s |

> 数字来自隔离 profile 的对照实验；真实使用时如果聊天记录很大，渲染线程仍然会拖慢任何 web 终端——这是浏览器单线程的代价，不是传输层的。

## 功能

- 会话级右侧栏标签，位置与自带终端一致（`sidebar.right.pane.tab` 槽位）
- `Ctrl + \`` 新建终端（快捷键 id `fastterm.new`；隐藏自带终端后不会有冲突）
- 入口卡片与自带终端同款：图标、标题、描述、`Ctrl + \`` 提示，带 shell 下拉菜单（PowerShell / cmd / 可发现的其它 shell），选择会被记住
- 标签标题显示实际 shell（`powershell.exe`、`cmd.exe`…），双击可重命名，名字保存在宿主端（刷新页面、切换标签都不丢）
- 终端配色跟随 DSH 主题（浅色 / 深色 / 跟随系统），字体与字号读主题令牌，和自带终端一致
- 中英双语（跟随 DSH 语言设置）
- 每个标签一个独立 PTY；标签切换、页面刷新后自动重连并回放快照，PTY 不随标签卸载退出（`keepMounted`）
- 新标签的工作目录 = 会话工作目录（读 `workingDirectory` 投影）
- 关闭标签会结束对应 PTY（`sidebarRight.registerCloseHandler` + `POST /api/dsh-fast-term/close`）
- Windows 默认 PowerShell：pwsh → Windows PowerShell → ComSpec 依次回退，可用 `DSH_FAST_TERM_SHELL` 覆盖
- 过滤 xterm 的 Device Attributes 应答，避免 PowerShell 把 `[?1;2c` 当输入回显
- 外部输入开关：默认只读，只有终端界面本身可以输入；点终端右上角的「只读」胶囊才会允许其它进程（含 Agent）通过 WebSocket 写入，可另配命令白名单
- 复制粘贴：选中后 `Ctrl+C` 或 `Ctrl+Shift+C` 复制（没有选中时 `Ctrl+C` 仍是 SIGINT），`Ctrl+V` 粘贴；`Ctrl+Shift+V` 走浏览器原生粘贴；右键菜单提供复制 / 粘贴 / 全选，复制成功会在底部提示字数

## 安装

```
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-fast-term
```

也可以在「设置 → 插件市场」里搜索 `dsh-fast-term`。本地开发时直接装目录：

```
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "file:D:/Projects/dsh-fast-term"
```

安装或更新后需要重启 DSH 宿主（右侧栏的客户端半在刷新页面后生效）。注意 `file:` 依赖在 pnpm 里是拷贝而不是软链，改了 `lib/` 之后要重新 `add` 一次（或手动把 `lib/index.js`、`lib/client.js` 覆盖到 profile 的 `node_modules/dsh-fast-term/lib/`）。

## 替代自带终端

想让「新建终端」按钮和终端 UI 完全由本插件接管，在 profile 的补丁层里关掉自带终端 UI（`C:\Users\<你>\.dsh\profiles\desktop\cordis.patch.yml`）：

```yaml
- id: ui-sidebar-terminal
  name: "@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar-terminal"
  disabled: true
```

重启后：右栏「开始」页只剩「工作区文件」和「新建终端」，`Ctrl + \`` 打开的是本插件；关掉的是自带终端的**界面**，终端服务（`webTerminals` / `dsh-api-terminal-controller`）仍在，其它插件的终端不受影响。

不想替代、想并存也可以——删掉这三行即可，两个终端会各占一张卡片（自带终端仍显示为 `New terminal`）。

## 使用

1. 打开右侧边栏
2. 点「新建终端」，或直接按 `Ctrl + \``；点标题旁的箭头可以选择 shell
3. 直接输入命令即可；双击标签标题可以重命名；关闭标签 = 结束该 PTY
4. 终端右上角的胶囊显示当前输入权限：`只读` 表示只有这个界面能输入；点一下变成 `可输入`，其它程序或 Agent 才能通过 WebSocket 向该 PTY 写入；再点一下恢复只读
5. 鼠标选中文本后 `Ctrl+C`（或 `Ctrl+Shift+C`）复制、`Ctrl+V` 粘贴；也可以右键打开菜单（复制 / 粘贴 / 全选）。没有选中时 `Ctrl+C` 照常发送 SIGINT

Windows 下进程的环境变量在启动那一刻就固定了，宿主连续跑很久时终端会一直用旧的 `PATH`（新装的 CLI 找不到）。本插件在创建 PTY 前会从注册表重读 `Path`（HKLM + HKCU，展开 `%VAR%`，5 秒缓存），所以改完 PATH 不用重启宿主，新开一个标签就能拿到；宿主运行时额外追加、且仍在磁盘上的目录也会保留。

## 只读接口与输入开关

宿主进程提供三个只读 HTTP 接口，供脚本或 Agent 查看终端状态（仅回环 + Origin 校验）：

| 接口 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /api/dsh-fast-term/list` | 列出终端：`id` / `title` / `shell` / `pid` / `exited` |
| `GET /api/dsh-fast-term/buffer?id=<id>&tail=8000&plain=1` | 返回该终端输出缓冲的尾部；省略 `id` 取最近一个；`plain=0` 返回带 ANSI 转义的原始 PTY 流 |
| `GET /api/dsh-fast-term/screen?id=<id>&cols=120&rows=40` | 用缓冲区重放一帧**可见画面**，返回按行拆好的文本（`text`）；省略 `cols`/`rows` 用该终端最近一次尺寸 |

输入开关保存在 `~/.dsh/fast-term.json`，也可通过接口读写：

| 接口 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /api/dsh-fast-term/config` | 读取 `{allowExternalInput, allowedCommands}` |
| `POST /api/dsh-fast-term/config` | 改开关，例如 `{"allowExternalInput":true,"allowedCommands":["echo","git status"]}` |

`allowExternalInput` 为 `false`（默认）时，只有终端界面自己的连接（attach 时声明 `writer: "ui"`）可以输入；其它 WebSocket 客户端发来的 `input` 会被拒绝并收到 `{"type":"denied","reason":"read-only"}`。打开后，`allowedCommands` 非空则按**整行**前缀匹配（大小写不敏感，回车才提交）：不在白名单里的行被丢弃并返回 `{"type":"denied","reason":"command-not-allowed","detail":"<行>"}`；留空表示不限制。

`plain=1`（默认）会去掉转义序列并统一换行为 `\n`，适合直接阅读；它不是终端模拟器，不会还原光标移动，所以 `PSReadLine` 之类的逐键重绘会留下重复片段。要看光标定位重画的全屏 TUI（btop、vim、tmux 状态栏），用 `screen`：宿主用 `@xterm/headless` 把缓冲重放成 120×40 的屏幕，再按行输出纯文本，得到的就是用户此刻看到的画面。

```bash
curl "http://127.0.0.1:PORT/api/dsh-fast-term/list"
curl "http://127.0.0.1:PORT/api/dsh-fast-term/buffer?id=<id>&tail=4000"
curl "http://127.0.0.1:PORT/api/dsh-fast-term/screen?id=<id>&cols=120&rows=40"
```

重放只读取缓冲区，不会向 PTY 写入任何内容；若缓冲已超过 4 MiB、最旧输出被丢弃，重放结果可能缺少早期状态（响应里的 `truncated` 会标记这一点）。

## Agent 读取（工具）

宿主还会注册一个 Agent 工具 `dsh_fast_term_read`：Agent 读边栏终端不必再依赖会话的权限档。工具调用跑在插件宿主进程内，不经过会话的文件沙箱，所以输入框设成 `workspace-write` 还是 `danger-full-access` 都能读（也绕开沙箱初始化失败时工具全挂的情况）。

| 参数 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| `list` | `true` 时只列出终端：`id`、标题、shell、缓冲字节数、是否已退出 |
| `id` | 终端 id（取自 `list`）；省略时读最近打开的那个 |
| `tail` | 返回末尾多少个字符，默认 8000（200–200000） |
| `screen` | `true` 时按 120×40 屏幕行渲染（全屏 TUI 用），默认返回去掉转义序列的纯文本 |

工具只读缓冲，不会向 PTY 写入；要让 Agent 替你敲命令，仍需在界面里点开 `可输入` 胶囊。

## 安全

- 页面与宿主不同源时（桌面版页面是 `dsh-app://app`）从 `__DSH_TRANSPORT__.streamBaseUrl` 解析宿主地址，只连接回环地址；Web 端仍用当前页面地址
- WebSocket 与只读路由只接受 loopback（`127.0.0.1` / `::1` / `::ffff:127.0.0.1`），并校验 Origin 的 host 与请求 host 一致；本机进程仍可直接读取（其本就能 attach 该 PTY）
- 终端进程以当前用户身份、无沙箱运行（与系统终端一致），不要在不可信页面同源环境里暴露该端口

## 已知限制

- Windows 优先支持；POSIX 走 `$SHELL -l`
- 重连快照上限 4 MiB，超出后丢弃最旧输出
- 依赖 DSH 的 `sidebarRightTabs` 与 `sidebar.right.pane.tab` 槽位（在 0.2.1-rc.2 上验证）
- 重命名保存在宿主进程内存里：DSH 宿主重启后会回到 shell 名
- 复制 / 粘贴默认走 `navigator.clipboard`；若运行环境拒绝剪贴板权限，复制会提示失败（检查权限后重试），粘贴可用 `Ctrl+Shift+V` 的原生通道
- 自带终端的「缺失 / 重连 / 只读」状态条还没有逐像素复刻，当前只用终端内的一行文字提示退出与错误
- 替代自带终端依赖 `ui-sidebar-terminal` 这个 bundle id；DSH 升级改名时补丁会失效（终端本身仍可用）

## 开发

```
npm install
node build.mjs          # src/client.js → lib/client.js；src/host.js → lib/index.js（内联 @xterm/headless）
node --check lib/index.js
dsh plugin --profile web add "file:D:/path/to/dsh-fast-term"
```

- `src/host.js` → `lib/index.js`（宿主半）：`ctx.subprocess.spawnTerminal` 起 PTY，`webServer.registerUpgrade` 挂 `/api/dsh-fast-term/ws`，按 `sessionId/tabId` 维护常驻会话与回放缓冲；`GET /screen` 用打包进来的 `@xterm/headless` 重放画面
- `src/client.js` → `lib/client.js`（浏览器半）：xterm.js + FitAddon，注册右侧栏标签与三个槽位；打包时用 `window.__ModuleLoader__.load` 包装，`react` 外置
- 发布走 **staged**：`.github/workflows/publish.yml` 里是 `npm stage publish`（OIDC trusted publisher，只授权了提交、没授权直发），CI 跑完版本还在暂存区，要到 npmjs.com 的 Staged Packages 页（或 `npm stage approve <id>`）用 2FA 批准才真正上线；批准前 `npm i dsh-fast-term@<version>` 装不到

## English

`dsh-fast-term` is an in-layout terminal for DSH's right sidebar, built as a drop-in replacement for the built-in terminal. It spawns a real PTY through DSH's `subprocess` service and streams raw output over a dedicated WebSocket (`/api/dsh-fast-term/ws`), bypassing the shared Typert gateway mux and frame acknowledgements. Sessions persist across tab switches and page reloads (`keepMounted` + replay buffer), closing a tab terminates its PTY, and new tabs start in the session working directory.

The UI mirrors the built-in terminal: the same guide card with a shell picker (the choice is remembered), tab titles showing the actual shell with double-click rename persisted on the host, colors and fonts taken from the DSH theme (light, dark, or system), and zh/en localization. It takes over `Ctrl + \`` and, with a one-entry profile patch disabling `ui-sidebar-terminal`, hides the built-in terminal's button and UI entirely.

Text can be copied out of the terminal: select and press `Ctrl+C` or `Ctrl+Shift+C` (plain `Ctrl+C` without a selection still sends SIGINT), paste with `Ctrl+V`, or use the right-click menu for copy, paste and select-all. `Ctrl+Shift+V` keeps the browser's native paste path; a short toast reports how many characters were copied.

Measured on Windows: cold prompt 0.12 s vs 3.1 s native, flood-echo 2.9 s vs 12.8 s native.

Read-only endpoints let scripts (or an agent) inspect terminals: `/list`, `/buffer` (raw or stripped tail), and `/screen`, which replays the buffer through a bundled headless terminal and returns the visible 120×40 frame as text — enough to read full-screen TUIs such as btop or vim without touching the P

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 插件：读取本地视频或网页链接，返回带时间轴的逐字稿与关键帧图片，供模型逐帧查看。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-video-kit

给 **DeepSeek Harness** 装上"看视频"的能力：一次工具调用，把本地视频或网页链接变成**带时间轴的逐字稿** + **一组关键帧图片**，模型可以直接逐帧看。

bilibili / 腾讯视频 / YouTube 等站点链接交给 yt-dlp；字幕外的内容用 Paraformer 中文语音识别补齐；关键帧用 ffmpeg 抽，返回绝对路径，配合内置的 `read_image` 就能真看图。

---

## 三个工具

| 工具 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `video_read` | 读一个视频：返回 `transcript`（时间轴逐字稿）、`frames`（关键帧绝对路径）、`outdir`、`duration` |
| `video_discover` | 先找后读：在抖音 / 小红书 / 公众号 / B站按关键词找候选视频，返回标题与 URL，再交给 `video_read` |
| `video_kit_setup` | 体检 / 安装运行时依赖与 ASR 模型（`check=true` 只体检） |

典型用法（对模型说）：

```
用 video_read 读 D:\videos\demo.mp4，每 10 秒抽一帧
```

模型拿到返回后会自己调 `read_image` 逐帧查看，再结合逐字稿回答。

---

## 检索需要登录的平台（video_discover）

抖音、小红书、公众号都不给未登录的搜索结果，而且**新版权 Chromium 不允许对默认浏览器 profile 开远程调试端口**。所以这里的做法是：插件维护一个自己的浏览器 profile，你在弹出的窗口里登录一次，登录态（DPAPI 加密的 cookie）留在那个目录里长期复用。插件从不接触你的账号密码。

三步：

```
video_discover action=login  platform=douyin     # 弹出窗口，你扫码/输验证码登录
video_discover action=status                      # 确认 douyin: 已登录
video_discover action=search platform=douyin query="数字人 教学"
```

返回的 `items[].url` 直接喂给 `video_read` 即可转写抽帧。

- 登录态一般 7–30 天失效，失效了重复一次 `action=login`
- 未登录时不会崩，会返回 `loggedIn=false` 加 `warning`
- 只读列表页，不点赞、不评论、不发布；默认单次检索不做并发
- `platform=bilibili` 不需要登录，可用来验证 CDP 链路是否通
- 浏览器 profile 目录：`~/.dsh/toolkits/video-kit/browser`；端口默认 9333（`VIDEO_CDP_PORT` 可改）

---

## 安装

### 方式一：脚本（推荐）

```powershell
# 解压后进入 dsh-video-kit 目录
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\install.ps1
```

脚本会做五件事：铺文件到 `~/.dsh/local-plugins/`、同步进 `profiles/<profile>/node_modules/`、登记 `file:` 依赖、在 **profile 补丁层**写入挂载块、最后跑一次依赖体检。

可选参数：

| 参数 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `-Profile <名字>` | 目标 profile，默认 `desktop` |
| `-NoPatch` | 只铺文件，不写挂载（你想手工挂） |
| `-WhatIfOnly` | 只打印计划，不改任何东西 |

### 方式二：手工（三步）

1. 把整个目录复制到 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\local-plugins\dsh-video-kit`
2. 再把同一份复制到 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop\node_modules\dsh-video-kit`
3. 在 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop\cordis.patch.yml` **末尾**追加：

```yaml
# 本地插件：视频读取工具（video_read），进程级挂载
- insert:
    - id: tool-video-kit
      name: "dsh-video-kit"
```

并在同目录 `package.json` 的 `dependencies` 里加一行 `"dsh-video-kit": "file:../../local-plugins/dsh-video-kit"`（防止包管理器清理 node_modules）。

### 方式三：作为依赖安装

```powershell
cd %USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop
pnpm add file:../../local-plugins/dsh-video-kit
```

装完仍需在 `cordis.patch.yml` 写挂载块（同上）。

---

## 装完必须做两件事

1. **完全退出并重新打开 DeepSeek Harness** —— 插件在进程启动时加载，热改不生效。
2. **新开一个会话** —— 已有会话的工具表在建立时就冻结了，不会热更新。这是最容易被误判成"插件没装上"的原因：同一个进程里，老会话看不到 `video_read`，新会话立刻就有。

---

## 参数

| 参数 | 类型 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `source` | string | 必填 | 本地视频绝对路径，或 http(s) 视频链接 |
| `every` | number | 20 | 每隔多少秒抽一帧；短视频会自动加密到 2 秒 |
| `maxframes` | number | 24 | 最多抽多少帧 |
| `copyTo` | string | — | 把关键帧与逐字稿复制到这个目录，**返回复制后的路径** |
| `timeoutMs` | number | 900000 | 整体超时；10 分钟视频约需 1–3 分钟处理 |

### `copyTo` 什么时候必须用

DSH 给模型看图时，会把图片复制一份到 `~/.dsh/attachments/`。**如果当前会话的文件策略是 `workspace-write`，这个目录在工作区之外，写不进去**，于是页面会显示"图片无法预览"——文件其实是好的。

传一个**工作区内的绝对路径**即可绕开：

```
用 video_read 读 D:\videos\demo.mp4，copyTo 传 C:\Users\你\工作区\.frames
```

---

## 数据目录

模型和产物不随包分发（模型 227 MB），统一放在：

```
%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\toolkits\video-kit\
  models\asr-paraformer-zh\model.int8.onnx   227 MB
  models\silero_vad.onnx                     1.7 MB
  videos\<视频名>\frames\*.jpg
  videos\<视频名>\transcript.txt
```

可用环境变量 `VIDEO_KIT` 改位置。

首次调用 `video_read` 若模型缺失会自动下载；想提前装好：

```powershell
python "%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\toolkits\video-kit\bin\setup.py"          # 安装
python "%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\toolkits\video-kit\bin\setup.py" --check  # 只体检
```

Python 依赖（`imageio-ffmpeg`、`yt-dlp`、`sherpa-onnx`、`websocket-client`）由脚本 `pip install --user` 装，不需要管理员权限，也不需要系统装 ffmpeg。

---

## 故障排查

| 现象 | 原因 | 解决 |
|---|---|---|
| **DSH 启动即崩：`Unexpected token '\uFEFF' ... is not valid JSON`** | `package.json` 被写成了带 BOM 的 UTF-8（PowerShell 5.1 的 `Set-Content -Encoding UTF8` 就是这个行为） | 用无 BOM 编码重写 `profiles/<profile>/package.json`；本安装器 1.1.1 起已强制无 BOM 并自检 |
| 新会话没有 `video_read` | 插件没加载 | 看 `~/.dsh/toolkits/video-kit/plugin-loaded.txt` 有没有本次启动的时间；没有就检查挂载块 |
| 老会话没有，新会话有 | 会话工具表冻结 | 正常行为，用新会话 |
| `register-error.txt` 出现 | 注册抛错 | 把文件内容发出来，一般是对应工具名已被占用 |
| 图片无法预览 | 附件缓存目录不可写 | 用 `copyTo` 指到工作区内 |
| `python 执行失败` | 没装 Python 或不在 PATH | 装 3.8+ 并确认 `python -V` 可用 |
| 转写为空 | 视频无音轨 / 纯音乐 | 正常，看帧即可 |
| 模型下载失败 | 网络 | 手动下 `model.int8.onnx` 与 `tokens.txt` 放进 `models\asr-paraformer-zh\` |

日志类标记文件都在数据目录：`plugin-loaded.txt`、`register-ok.txt`、`register-error.txt`。

---

## 卸载

```powershell
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\uninstall.ps1
# 连 230 MB 模型一起删：
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\uninstall.ps1 -PurgeData
```

---

## 目录结构

```
dsh-video-kit/
  index.js              插件入口（两个工具的注册与实现）
  cordis.patch.yml      bundle 形式的挂载声明
  bin/
    watch_video.py      下载 → 转写 → 抽帧
    discover.py         接管已登录浏览器，按关键词找候选（抖音/小红书/公众号）
    setup.py            依赖体检/安装
  extras/               研究辅助脚本（B站 WBI 搜索、CDP 嗅探等，插件不依赖）
  install.ps1
  uninstall.ps1
  README.md
  INSTALL.zh-CN.md
  LICENSE
```

---

## 许可

MIT。模型与第三方工具的许可各自遵循其上游（Paraformer / Silero VAD / ffmpeg / yt-dlp）。

plugins.description: Time-shifting task delegation for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): plan tasks at leisure, they run unattended off-peak, come back to a report. Human-adjudicated, desktop + web.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-lowtide **Queue tasks when it's busy. They run on their own when it's cheap.** Semi-auto or full-auto, off the model's peak hours and peak prices. A must-have plugin for DeepSeek Harness. **English** | [简体中文](./README.zh-CN.md) | [繁體中文](./README.zh-HK.md) | [العربية](./docs/README.ar.md) | [Deutsch](./docs/README.de.md) | [Español](./docs/README.es.md) | [Français](./docs/README.fr.md) | [Italiano](./docs/README.it.md) | [한국어](./docs/README.ko.md)
--- ![hero](./assets/screenshots/hero.png)

Three tasks waiting in the queue, the price status glowing in the session header, auto-run when your window opens

## Introduction lowtide is a plugin for [DeepSeek Harness (dsh)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh). The problem it solves is plain and perfectly natural: Usually, when you want an agent to do some work, you sit at the computer, send the agent an instruction, wait for the reply, and then review it by hand. But this workflow seems to forget that you have plenty of idle time — and a chance to dodge the peak/off-peak pricing that some models charge. With lowtide installed, the day goes like this: whenever a job crosses your mind during the day, toss it in the queue, glance at it, release it. The tasks pile up until the time you set (say, after 7 PM — that's when DeepSeek is at valley pricing), then run by themselves. Next morning you open the report: keep what went well, send back what didn't. That's all it is. But use it for a week and your working rhythm genuinely slows down — and don't forget, "time is money, efficiency is life"... A few key capabilities: - Four execution strategies: single, iterative, sampling, review — from "one pass is enough" to "run five candidates and I'll pick" - 168 unit tests + 10 end-to-end specs, CI green across ubuntu / windows × node 22 / 24 - One build artifact serves both desktop and web — install once, works on both - Off-peak execution lands in DeepSeek's valley hours: the same batch costs about half of what peak would ## A normal day with an agent might look like this… **Ten minutes before clocking out.** You've finished reviewing code, so you file three tickets for tomorrow: a refactor (iterative, 3 rounds), a weekly report (single), and a design you're unsure about (sampling, 4 candidates). Release them all, shut down, leave. Tomorrow at your desk, the morning report says: the refactor's done, the report's drafted, and four candidate designs sit side by side, each with its cost written out. **Friday night.** Queue a week's worth of chores in one go: dependency cleanup, missing tests, data scripts. Weekends are valley price around the clock. You go out; it works from home. Monday you check the report — retry what failed, merge what's good. **A 10 AM brainwave.** You're mid-conversation with the agent about an urgent bug when you think "hey, update the docs too." The intercept card pops up: running now costs peak price, tonight it's about half — the difference is spelled out. Click "queue for off-peak"; your draft survives untouched, and you go back to the bug. **An always-on server.** You've got a machine running dsh 24/7. Switch to L3 full-auto, then file tasks from anywhere through the API (`POST /ds-lowtide/tasks`). It runs them on schedule and writes the report. Nobody's watching, but the sandbox, the daily budget, and the file locks are all still there. **Deliverables for a client.** Use the review strategy: run once, then automatically open an independent session that tears the result apart through your chosen focus (say, "hunt for data-source errors"). In the morning you don't get a bare result — you get a result plus a critical review. **Living abroad.** You're in San Francisco; DeepSeek's peak is Beijing time, which for you lands in the evening and night before. Settings converts the official hours to your local clock, one click to adopt. You set windows by your own schedule, and the books always stay aligned with the official table. ## How lowtide works ``` ① Intake ② Adjudicate ③ Execute ④ Accept Whenever you have The queue dock When the off-peak When you're back: a moment: one-click groups tasks by window opens: five open the report — from the intercept workspace; triage preflight gates pass, results + diff card, or file a → line by line: → then sandboxed runs → + actual spend ticket (4 strategies) ✓approve ⏸defer one batch per window + money saved ✕drop / approve-all ``` A task's life: `pending-review → queued → preflight → running → done / failed / stale / timeout`, plus `deferred` (postponed) and `dropped` (soft-deleted, restorable). Step two is where lowtide differs from a "fully automated script": **every task must be released by your hand before it runs** (in L2, you release the whole batch at once, 30 minutes before the window). The machine cannot move itself into the run queue. Execution is automated; decisions are not. That's why you can safely be absent. ## A tour of the lowtide interface **The new-task modal.** Four strategies side by side, each with a plain-language hint; rounds, priority, and run mode ride along per task — no trip back to settings. Tasks land as "pending review". Nothing enters the queue without passing you. ![new-task-modal](./assets/screenshots/new-task-modal.png) **Advanced options.** Model, reasoning effort, priority from 0 to 9, fresh session or continue-previous, and the locked-files list — all in one small pane. Locked files, briefly: anything on the list gets sha256-checked before execution, and if it doesn't match what you filed, the task goes stale and refuses to run. Otherwise the file you queued against could be rewritten by another task while waiting, and this one would blindly stomp on it. ![advanced-options](./assets/screenshots/advanced-options.png) **Pick any model.** Batch runs default to the official `deepseek-flash` (DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash; the retired `deepseek-v4-flash` name still routes there at Flash prices), but each task can pick its own model — anything connected to your Harness is in the dropdown, grouped by provider. Private providers work too. Non-official models have no public price table, so the ledger honestly says "price unknown"; add a price override in settings if you want the bookkeeping exact. ![model-picker](./assets/screenshots/model-picker.png) **The window editor.** Multi-segment, overnight, per-weekday — all fine. Underneath is a live 24-hour price band: red for peak, green for valley, and a marker showing where you are right now. Outside UTC+8, one click on "adopt official peak hours" converts Beijing time to your local clock. ![window-editor](./assets/screenshots/window-editor.png) **The settings page.** Window hours, tasks per batch, per-task duration cap, concurrency, daily budget, report history, autonomy level, price overrides — all graphical, no config files. The official pricing rules (including the new all-weekend valley) are explained in human language on the same page. ![settings](./assets/screenshots/settings.png) Three more pieces of UI appear in daily use: the **price pill** (session header — busy/idle, queue size; click it to edit windows), the **peak-hours intercept card** (type at peak, it appears; the price difference is spelled out; your draft survives), and the **execution report** (the morning briefing: savings first, anomalies pinned, candidates awaiting your pick, one-click Markdown copy). ## About lowtide workspaces Every task runs inside a workspace. That single dropdown decides three things. **Which files it can touch.** Tasks run in a sandbox whose boundary is the workspace directory. Pick wrong and at best it can't find the files; at worst it edits something it shouldn't. **Who it queues with.** Tasks in the same workspace run serially (two tasks never fight over one repo); different workspaces run in paralle

plugins.description: Antigravity subagent for DeepSeek Harness: run Google Antigravity CLI (agy) as a one-shot coding subagent (subagent_antigravity), including Gemini 4 Argon.
plugins.readme_text:
---
description: "Antigravity subagent: drive the official Google Antigravity CLI (agy) as a one-shot coding subagent in DeepSeek Harness (subagent_antigravity), including Gemini 4 Argon on an Antigravity subscription."
kind: "package-bundle"
---

# dsh-subagent-antigravity

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-subagent-antigravity?label=npm)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-subagent-antigravity) [![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/dsh-subagent-antigravity)](https://github.com/PipeDream941/dsh-subagent-antigravity/blob/main/LICENSE)

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

Adds an **Antigravity subagent** to DeepSeek Harness (DSH): a parent session can
call `subagent_antigravity` to run the official Google Antigravity CLI (`agy`) as
a fresh coding agent inside the parent workspace — it edits files, runs commands,
and returns only its final answer.

It has the same shape as the official Codex subagent (`subagent_codex`) and the
Claude Code subagent (`subagent_claude_code`), but the backend is Antigravity, so
it needs **no separate Gemini API key**: it uses your signed-in Antigravity Google
account subscription and can drive **Gemini 4 Argon** (`gemini-4-argon-low/medium/high`).

> Community plugin; not affiliated with Google. The Antigravity CLI is Google's
> official CLI — this plugin only drives it from DSH.

## Why this plugin exists

- **Gemini CLI cannot use Gemini 4 yet.** Gemini CLI 0.64 tops out at
  `gemini-3.8-flash` / `gemini-3.1-pro-preview`; the Gemini 4 support request
  (google-gemini/gemini-cli#29689) is still open, and Gemini 4 is not a public API
  model. Gemini 4 Argon is currently offered through Antigravity for Google AI
  Pro / Ultra subscribers, and `agy models` lists what your account can use.
- So "call Gemini 4 like Codex" means driving the **Antigravity CLI**, not the
  Gemini CLI. (A sibling plugin, `dsh-subagent-gemini`, covers the Gemini CLI
  route and will support Gemini 4 once Google ships it there.)

## How it works

```
parent session (DeepSeek model)
   │  calls tool subagent_antigravity({ description, prompt })
   ▼
DSH subagent seam (ctx.subagents)
   │  provider: antigravity (registered by this plugin)
   ▼
run layer: spawn agy --print --output-format stream-json
   │  parse NDJSON events (init / step_update / result), keep the final answer
   ▼
agy (separate process, parent cwd, your Antigravity sign-in and subscription)
   │  uses Antigravity's own tools (files, terminal, browser, MCP …)
   ▼
final answer → parent conversation
```

One delegation = one fresh process, one turn, final answer only. The child's
reasoning, tool traffic and stderr never enter the parent conversation; failures
return fixed stage/category diagnostics instead of raw stderr or credentials.

## Requirements

| Dependency | Version / notes |
|---|---|
| DeepSeek Harness | `0.2.1-rc.2` series (`ctx.subagents` + `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent`) |
| Node.js | `^22.19.0` or `>=24` |
| Google Antigravity CLI (`agy`) | official CLI, 1.4+; `agy --version` must answer |
| Antigravity account | signed in through the Antigravity app or CLI (AI Pro / Ultra for Gemini 4 Argon) |

Install the official CLI:

```bash
# macOS / Linux
curl -fsSL https://antigravity.google/cli/install.sh | bash
# Windows (PowerShell)
# irm https://antigravity.google/cli/install.ps1 | iex

agy --version      # expect 1.4.2+
agy models         # lists the models your account can use (incl. gemini-4-argon-*)
```

Sign-in is shared across local Antigravity surfaces; if the app is already signed
in, `agy` normally works directly. Otherwise run `agy` once and complete the
Google sign-in. Enterprise accounts can use `AGY_ADC_AUTH=true` with
`gcloud auth application-default login`, or the `GEMINI_API_KEY` mode (note: an
API key cannot reach Gemini 4 unless that key itself is entitled).

## Install the plugin

**From the DSH plugin market (recommended):** search for
`dsh-subagent-antigravity`, install and enable it.

**From the command line:**

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-subagent-antigravity
```

Then add the package to that profile's `package.json` → `dsh.profile.bundles`
and restart (or let the profile recompose):

```json
"dsh": {
  "profile": {
    "bundles": ["…", "dsh-subagent-antigravity"]
  }
}
```

Once enabled, every agent sees the global tool `subagent_antigravity` (a running
session picks it up on its next request).

## Usage

```json
{
  "name": "subagent_antigravity",
  "arguments": {
    "description": "Fix login timeout",
    "prompt": "In the workspace, raise the login request timeout from 5s to 15s, run the related tests, and reply only with what you changed and the test result."
  }
}
```

- `description` — 3–5 word task name;
- `prompt` — a **self-contained** task; the child cannot see the parent conversation.

## Configuration

Override the `subagent-antigravity` entry's `config` in a profile patch:

| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `providerName` | `antigravity` | name registered on `ctx.subagents`; unique per profile |
| `command` | empty (auto-detect) | path to `agy`; empty searches `PATH`, `~/.local/bin`, `/opt/homebrew/bin`, `/usr/local/bin`, … |
| `model` | `gemini-4-argon-medium` | fixed model; `agy models` lists the live catalogue (`gemini-4-argon-*`, `gemini-3.8-flash-*`, `claude-*-5-5-*`, …) |
| `effort` | empty | `low` / `medium` / `high` / `xhigh` / `max` |
| `mode` | empty | `accept-edits` / `auto` / `plan` (read-only) |
| `skipPermissions` | `true` | pass `--dangerously-skip-permissions` so an unattended child can edit/run; with `false`, headless cannot prompt and write tools are auto-denied |
| `sandbox` | `false` | pass `--sandbox` (the CLI's terminal sandbox) |
| `timeoutMs` | `900000` (15 min) | overall wall-clock budget per delegation |
| `disposeGraceMs` | `5000` | SIGTERM→SIGKILL escalation grace |
| `env` | `{}` | extra child environment variables |
| `extraArgs` | `[]` | extra CLI arguments for forward compatibility |

Example — Gemini 4 Argon High, read-only:

```yaml
- id: subagent-antigravity
  config:
    model: gemini-4-argon-high
    mode: plan
    skipPermissions: false
```

## Security and permissions

- The default `skipPermissions: true` is **unattended**: the child may edit files
  and run commands without a human approval prompt. That is what makes delegated
  coding tasks possible; use it in trusted workspaces and review `git diff`.
- For read-only delegation use `mode: plan` with `skipPermissions: false`; headless
  mode cannot prompt, so write attempts are auto-denied and reported as a
  `permission` failure instead of silently continuing.
- The child is a separate process: DSH's subprocess seam scrubs credential-like
  variables from the parent environment; only `env` entries are forwarded.
- No telemetry. No credential is read, logged or returned by this plugin; the
  Antigravity sign-in is managed by the CLI itself.

## Troubleshooting

| Symptom | Fix |
|---|---|
| `Antigravity CLI (agy) was not found` | run the official install script and verify `agy --version` |
| diagnostic `category: auth` | not signed in: run `agy` once and complete the Google sign-in |
| diagnostic `category: permission` | headless cannot prompt: keep `skipPermissions: true` or use `mode: plan` |
| diagnostic `category: quota` | the model has no quota/rate left for this account right now |
| diagnostic `category: timeout` | raise `timeoutMs` or split the task |
| want to verify the machine | `npm run smoke` in the plugin checkout (one small Antigravity request) |

## Compatibility and development

- Unit tests: `npm test` (34 cases: config normalization, CLI discovery, and the
  run layer's event parsing, timeout, cancellation, permission and failure mapping);
- End-to-end self-check: `npm run smoke` (real `agy` + Gemini 4 Argon, expects PONG);
- No private DSH packages are imported (only `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` for config
  validation), so the run layer is unit-testable outside the host;
- Reference implementation: official `@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-codex` (the
  one-process-per-run, one-turn, final-answer, safe-diagnostics contract).

## Uninstall

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop rem

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 待办清单插件：列表 / Markdown 双视图，自动补齐创建时间、提醒时间与提醒模式
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-todo

DeepSeek Harness 插件：在侧栏加一个**待办清单**面板，支持**列表视图**与 **Markdown 视图**切换；新建条目时自动补齐**创建时间、提醒时间与提醒模式**。

面板、agent 工具和 Markdown 视图共用同一份 Host 端数据与同一组服务方法，不存在两套逻辑。

社区介绍与讨论见 [DSH Show Your Plugins!](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/10226)。本项目为**非官方**社区插件，独立维护，未经 DeepSeek 官方审核。

## 安装

```sh
# npm（推荐，支持版本解析与更新）
dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile> add @mappedinfo/dsh-todo

# 或直接从仓库装最新 main
dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile> add github:Mappedinfo/dsh-todo
```

也可以在 DSH 的插件页用 Add 填入同一个地址。`<你的 profile>` 是 profile 名（例如 `web`）；Electron 桌面版的 `desktop` profile 由应用自身管理。

装完侧栏出现待办图标。数据落在 `~/.dsh/dsh-todo/state.json`，用 `stateFile` 配置项可改路径。

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` 是唯一的运行期依赖，用来注册 `todo_board` 工具；它取不到时插件照常提供面板与 RPC，只记一条 warn 日志。

---

## 界面

**侧栏**多一个待办图标，点击后在主区域打开面板。

### 返回对话

面板左上角有「← 返回对话」。点侧栏待办图标会切走当前会话，这个按钮直接把你送回对话，接着干活。

### New Session 行的待办入口

新建会话那一行的右侧（workspace / preset 控件之后）会有一个 `待办 N · 今日 M` 的紧凑按钮，点一下打开完整面板。

> 宿主的「Workspace files / New terminal / Browser」三个快捷操作是内置组件，不经槽位；插件能用的位置是 `conversation.hero.options`，也就是这一行里留给插件的座位。

### 侧栏底部入口

侧栏底部、Settings 旁边会有一个待办入口，展开侧栏时显示未完成计数。不受会话影响，start 页面也可见。

### 输入框下方的待办条（默认关闭）

输入框下方可以显示一条待办摘要。**默认关闭**：那一行已经有 activity、用量和上下文指示器，再放一条在窄窗口里会非常拥挤。需要的话在设置里打开。

### 列表视图

- 顶部输入框回车即新建；**新建时自动写入创建时间、提醒时间、提醒模式**
- 筛选：全部 / 待办 / 今天 / 已完成
- 每行显示复选框、标题，以及创建时间、提醒模式与提醒时刻、截止时间、优先级、标签等标签
- 点任意一行展开编辑器：标题、备注（支持 Markdown）、提醒模式、提醒时间、提前分钟、截止时间、优先级、标签
- 逾期、今日到期、待提醒、已提醒分别用不同状态色标出

### Markdown 视图

- **预览**：整份清单渲染成 Markdown，任务项的复选框可以直接点，完成状态立刻写回列表
- **源码**：直接编辑 Markdown 文本，点「已写回清单」解析回条目
- 「复制」把当前 Markdown 放进剪贴板

两个视图切换的是**同一份数据**：列表新建的条目立刻出现在 Markdown 里，Markdown 里改的标题与勾选状态保存后也立刻反映到列表。

### 自动创建的三个时间字段

| 字段 | 来源 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 创建时间 `createdAt` | 建条目那一刻 | 永远存在 |
| 提醒时间 | 按提醒模式计算 | `once` = 现在 + 提前量；`daily` = 每日时刻；`lead` = 截止时间 − 提前分钟 |
| 提醒模式 | 配置默认值 `defaultReminderMode` | `none` / `once` / `daily` / `lead` |

默认提醒时间会向上取整到最近的 5 分钟刻度；`once` / `lead` 模式下它同时作为截止时间的默认值。三个字段都可以在编辑器里改，改成其他模式时会自动补齐该模式需要的字段（例如切到「每日」但没填时刻时补默认时刻）。

提醒模式：

| 模式 | 含义 | 下次提醒 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `none` | 不提醒 | — |
| `once` | 一次性提醒 | 指定的那个时刻 |
| `daily` | 每日提醒 | 下一个 `HH:mm` |
| `lead` | 截止前提醒 | 截止时间 − 提前分钟 |

## agent 工具

模型通过 `todo_board` 操作同一份清单：

```
action: list | add | update | toggle | remove | clear_done | markdown
title / id / done / note / mode / remind_at / remind_time / lead_minutes / due / priority / tags
```

工具与面板调用的是同一个 Host 方法，所以状态变化与失败原因一致。`add` 不带 `mode` / `remind_at` 时同样走「自动创建时间 + 提醒时间 + 提醒模式」这条路径。

## 数据

- 默认落在 `~/.dsh/dsh-todo/state.json`（单个 JSON，`version: 1`），写入用「临时文件 + rename」原子替换，失败不影响交互
- 文件缺失或损坏时回落到空清单，不会阻塞宿主启动
- 用 `stateFile` 配置项可以改路径

## 配置

写在 `cordis.patch.yml` 的 `config` 里：

| 键 | 默认 | 含义 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `stateFile` | `null` | 状态文件路径；`null` 表示 `~/.dsh/dsh-todo/state.json` |
| `defaultReminderMode` | `once` | 新建条目的默认提醒模式 |
| `defaultReminderDelayMinutes` | `60` | `once` / `lead` 模式默认提前多少分钟 |
| `defaultReminderTime` | `'09:00'` | `daily` 模式的默认每日时刻（本地 `HH:mm`） |
| `reminderGranularityMinutes` | `5` | 默认提醒时间向上取整的刻度，`0` 表示不取整 |
| `defaultLeadMinutes` | `10` | `lead` 模式的默认提前分钟 |
| `reminderScanSeconds` | `30` | 提醒扫描间隔（秒） |

## 提醒怎么呈现

提醒到点后，插件在 Host 记账（`remindedAt`）并在面板上出现「待提醒」标记与一次顶部提示，条目上显示「已提醒」。**插件不代替用户操作**：不注入会话、不打断正在跑的 turn，也不自动勾选或延后任何条目。

## 结构

| 文件 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `index.js` | Host 入口：`inject`、存储加载、RPC 路由、按 Agent 挂载工具、提醒扫描 |
| `store.js` | 数据模型、提醒时间计算、原子持久化、快照视图模型 |
| `markdown.js` | Markdown 生成与解析（双向，保留 id / 备注 / 提醒设置） |
| `rpc.js` | 浏览器 → Host 的 JSON RPC 前缀路由 |
| `tools.js` | `todo_board` agent 工具 |
| `client.js` | 面板：侧栏图标 + 主区域列表 / Markdown 双视图、主题令牌样式 |
| `scripts/smoke.mjs` | 纯逻辑自检（不依赖 DSH 运行时） |

## 自检

```bash
node scripts/smoke.mjs          # 14 项：自动时间/提醒、模式切换、提醒扫描、Markdown 往返、持久化
node scripts/client-smoke.mjs   # 10 项：用桩 loader 真正执行 client.js 的 factory 与渲染
node --check client.js          # 浏览器半边的语法
```

`client-smoke.mjs` 会执行 bundle 的 `factory` 与 `apply`，断言两个槽位注册（`sidebar.panellist:todo` / `main:todo`）、zh/en 语言包、样式只用主题令牌、列表视图与 Markdown 预览 / 源码两种模式各自渲染出什么，以及卸载时全部清理干净。

## 显示位置设置

**Settings → 插件 → 待办清单** 可以分别开关三处入口，改动即时生效：

| 开关 | 默认 | 位置 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 新建会话行待办入口 | 开 | New Session 行右侧，workspace / preset 控件之后 |
| 侧栏底部待办入口 | 开 | Settings 旁边，展开侧栏时显示计数 |
| 输入框下方待办条 | **关** | 和 activity / 用量 / 上下文指示器同一行 |

选择保存在 `prefs.surfaces`，跟着 `state.json` 一起持久化。

## 从源码开发

插件没有构建步骤，克隆后直接链接进 profile 即可：

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Mappedinfo/dsh-todo.git
cd dsh-todo
dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile> add "$PWD"
```

本地开发时 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` 可能不在解析路径里（它随 DSH 安装或源码检出提供）。可以指向本地 DSH 源码检出：

```bash
mkdir -p node_modules/@deepseek-ai
ln -sfn <dsh 源码检出>/packages/core/tools node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools
```

不建这个链接也只会失去 `todo_board` 工具，面板与 RPC 不受影响。`node_modules/` 已被 `.gitignore` 排除。

从 npm 或 GitHub 正常安装时，这个依赖由包管理器装上，不需要手工链接。

装好后侧栏即出现待办图标。页面通过模块图热更新拿到新的浏览器模块，通常不必刷新；若图标没出现，刷新一次即可。

## 实现取舍

- **RPC 走 `ctx.webServer` 前缀路由**而不是 `ctx.connection.rpc.handle()`：后者自 DSH 0.1.5 起内部通过 connection 自己的 `ctx` 取 `webServer`，插件调用会抛 `cannot get property "webServer" without inject`。因此 `inject` 里必须同时声明 `connection` 与 `webServer`。
- **样式只用 `--dsw-alias-*` 主题令牌**，不引入任何 Harness Client 包（如 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives`），因此浅色/深色自动跟随宿主。
- **样式表随面板挂载**：插件 bundle 的 `factory` 只拿到 `require`；`styles` / `host` / `console` 是**动态 Client runner** 的 builtin，在 `window.__ModuleLoader__` bundle 里并不存在。早期版本调用 `styles.insert()` 抛 `ReferenceError: styles is not defined`，使整个 web boot 卡在 `@mappedinfo/dsh-todo: loading`。现在改成面板树里的 `<style>` 元素，随组件卸载由 React 移除；`scripts/client-smoke.mjs` 刻意不提供这些 builtin 来挡住这类回归。
- **时间运算全在 Host**：`Client` 只回传 `datetime-local` / `time` 输入的本地字符串，两侧不必各写一份时区换算。
- **没有构建步骤**：Host 是原生 ESM，Client 是 `window.__ModuleLoader__.load` 工厂 + `React.createElement`。

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 插件集合：可独立安装的 bundle，首个插件为全屏启动加载动画 Startup Splash。
plugins.readme_text:
# my-plugins

> DeepSeek Harness 插件集合 · A collection of DeepSeek Harness plugins

![Startup Splash](docs/preview.svg)

每个插件都是可独立安装的 Harness bundle，统一放在 [`packages/`](packages) 下，版本、变更记录与校验流程各自独立。

## 插件列表

| 插件 | 版本 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Startup Splash](packages/startup-splash) | 1.3.0 | 全屏曲速星场、极光光晕、能量核心与 HUD 的启动加载动画 |

## 安装

1. 克隆仓库并记下路径：

   ```bash
   git clone https://github.com/wk-single/my-plugins.git
   ```

2. 在 DeepSeek Harness 中以**本地 bundle 目录**安装插件：

   - 让 Harness 助手执行 `plugin_manager install_bundle`，目标为
     `<repo>/packages/startup-splash`；
   - 或在 Harness 的插件管理界面选择该目录（若你的版本提供本地目录安装入口）。

3. 生效后，每次打开或刷新 Web 界面都会播放启动动画。点击任意处、按 `Esc` 可跳过。

> 插件只向 `shell.overlay` 注册一个浮层，不修改 Harness 的其它行为；禁用或卸载后立即恢复。

## 目录结构

```
packages/
  startup-splash/       一个可独立安装的 Harness bundle
    package.json        dsh.bundle / dsh.client 清单
    cordis.patch.yml    Loader 行
    index.js            Host 半侧
    client.js           Client 半侧（动画与 slot 注册）
    locale/             插件管理器显示文案（en / zh）
    icon.svg            插件图标
docs/
  preview.svg           仓库头图
scripts/
  validate.mjs          清单与结构校验（与 CI 相同）
```

## 开发约定

**版本**

- 每个插件独立遵循 [SemVer](https://semver.org/)；破坏性变更升主版本。
- 发布时打 tag：`<plugin>-v<version>`，例如 `startup-splash-v1.3.0`。
- 变更写入根目录 [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)（Keep a Changelog 格式）。

**提交**

- 使用 [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/)：
  `feat(startup-splash): ...`、`fix(...)`、`docs(...)`、`chore(...)`。
- 一个提交只做一件事；提交信息用中文或英文均可，但同一仓库保持一致。

**校验**

- 本地：`npm run validate` 校验清单、导出、locale、图标与工厂 id 一致性。
- `npm run check` 会同时跑清单校验与 JS 语法检查；`scripts/validate.mjs` 可直接接入任意 CI。
- 新增插件：在 `packages/` 下新建目录，补齐清单、patch、locale 与图标，并加入上方表格。

**分支**

- `main` 保持可安装、可回滚；较大的改动走分支与 PR。
- 历史只追加不重写（不使用 force push）。

## 许可证

[Apache License 2.0](LICENSE)。Copyright 2026 wanka.

---

## English

`my-plugins` is a small collection of installable DeepSeek Harness plugins. Each directory under `packages/` is a self-contained Harness bundle with its own manifest, Loader patch, client code, locales and icon.

The first plugin, **Startup Splash**, plays a full-viewport boot sequence (warp starfield, aurora fields, energy core, HUD) whenever the Harness Web UI opens, then fades out. Click or press `Esc` to skip.

Install it by cloning this repository and adding `packages/startup-splash` as a local bundle in Harness. See the package README for details.

plugins.description: The official DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web UI, unmodified, running on HarmonyOS 2in1 / tablet inside the system ArkWeb — with the dsh Host on a real Node.js runtime embedded in the same process. No Electron, no bundled Chromium, no ArkUI rewrite of the Web UI.
plugins.readme_text:
[中文](./README_zh.md) | English # DSH Desktop · HarmonyOS Edition > The **official DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web UI, unmodified**, running on HarmonyOS 2in1 / tablet inside the system **ArkWeb** — with the dsh Host on a **real Node.js runtime embedded in the same process**. No Electron, no bundled Chromium, no ArkUI rewrite of the Web UI.

**Status** `0.1.0` — **scaffold** (`versionCode` 100). It now compiles, packages and **boots a real payload**: `assemble-payload.mjs --deploy` materializes the upstream dsh runtime (pruned from 628.6 MiB to 151 MiB, packed into a **40.4 MB** `dsh.tar.gz`), producing an **86 MB** unsigned HAP that carries the Node runtime plus the payload. On a host Node the same tree extracts in ~13 s, stages the profile, starts the Host and serves the unmodified dsh Web UI at the token URL (**HTTP 200**) with **0** unactivated profile rows. **No HarmonyOS device verification has been done** — see [Status](#status) for exactly what is proven and what is not. ## Two HarmonyOS editions HarmonyOS gets **two independent editions** of DSH Desktop; they share the same shell architecture, the same unmodified Web UI and the same data plane — the difference is **which runtime provides Node**: | | **Electron on HarmonyOS Edition** ([`dsh-desktop-hos`](../dsh-desktop-hos)) | **HarmonyOS Edition** (this repo) | |---|---|---| | Renderer | Chromium, shipped inside Electron 37 | The system **ArkWeb** — nothing bundled | | Node.js | Inside the Electron runtime (Node 22.17) | `libnode.so` started via `node::Start` in the app's own process (**v24.2.0**) | | Runtime plumbing | [`harmonypc-electron`](../harmonypc-electron) | [`ohos-node-bridge`](../ohos-node-bridge) HAR | | Upstream dsh patches | 13 (flock & hardlink fallbacks, `ctx.fs` remove / writeBytes / chmod, extra writable roots, attachment fsync, rebrand) | **0** — `ohos` profile + `@dsh-ohos/bundle` layer + audited shims | | Web server binding | `0.0.0.0:` + LAN IP with `Host`/`Origin` rewrite | `127.0.0.1:`, same-origin loopback | | Maturity | v0.2.1, device-verified on HarmonyOS 6.1.0.135 (API 24) | v0.1.0 scaffold, compiles & packages | Neither is a replacement for the other: the Electron edition buys maximum desktop fidelity at the cost of a bundled Chromium and JIT, and this edition buys a small payload and a JIT-free runtime at the cost of covering the platform gaps in the shim layer. ## How it works — one process, one origin ``` EntryAbility (ArkTS) └─ libnode.so node::Start(bootstrap.js) ← in-process Node v24.2.0 └─ extract resfile/dsh-payload → filesDir/payload (marker .ready-) └─ host.js: dsh Host (webserver + apiProxy + connection) on 127.0.0.1: └─ ready.json { schema, at, phase, port, token } └─ ArkWeb: loadUrl(ctx.connection.authenticatedUrl()) └─ the standard, unmodified dsh Web UI (same-origin HTTP + WebSocket) ``` - The **payload is `resfile`** — a real on-disk directory Node can read — holding a single deterministic `dsh.tar.gz`. **Node is the only extractor**, and extraction is idempotent through the `.ready-` marker. - **Readiness means business readiness.** `waitUntilRunning()` only proves the runtime thread is alive, so the shell polls `ready.json` (20 × 500 ms) and requires all of: `schema === 1`, an `at` no older than the launch timestamp, a terminal `phase`, and a non-empty `token`. Only then does it load the URL. - **Auth belongs to the Host.** The page loads `authenticatedUrl()` (`http://127.0.0.1:/?token=…`); the Host itself answers `303` and sets the signed cookie. The shell takes no part in authentication, never rewrites the `Host` header, and never binds `0.0.0.0`. - **Zero upstream changes**: platform differences are confined to an `ohos` profile, the `@dsh-ohos/bundle` YAML layer, and **five marked shims** (`DSH_OHOS_SHIM fs.link | fs.symlink | flock | sharp | node:sqlite`). Every upstream working tree stays pristine. ## Capabilities exposed to dsh | Capability | State | |---|---| | `runtime.facts`, `log.hilog`, `perm.check`, `perm.request`, `perm.openAppInfo`, `shell.openExternal` | ✅ implemented | | `fs.pickFolder`, `fs.pickFiles`, `fs.saveFile`, `notify.show`, `clipboard.readImage`, `clipboard.writeText`, `image.normalize`, `power.keepAwake` | ⚠️ placeholder — returns `{"ok":false,"error":"not-implemented","hint":…}` | ## Status | Area | State | |---|---| | ArkTS shell, ArkWeb host page, launch orchestration, readiness gate, diagnostics | ✅ implemented | | `ohos-node-bridge` HAR consumption, runtime provisioning (7 ELF gates + SHA-256), 44 MB HAP | ✅ verified by build | | Payload pipeline (`resfile` → self-extract), 5 shims, self-check 7/7, upstream pin check | ✅ verified on the host toolchain; profile is loaded from `/profiles/ohos` (moved out of `$DSH_HOME` so `@dsh-ohos/*` resolves) | | 8 `@dsh-ohos/*` seam plugins + shared host bridge (10 packages under `packages/*-ohos/`) | ✅ implemented (**partial**: no PTY, `notify.show` / `image.normalize` still ArkTS placeholders, approval presets disabled without a confining executor) | | Real dsh payload assembly + packaging | ✅ `--deploy` (pnpm deploy → link materialization → `@deepseek-ai` completion → non-hoisted flattening → prune → overlay → assertions); 41,331 files / 628.6 MiB → **15,192 files / 151 MiB** → `dsh.tar.gz` **40.4 MB** (`sha12 db181e3b4364`); HAP **86 MB** | | On-device verification (L1–L4, ArkWeb → `127.0.0.1`, `sh` sentinel, JIT ACL) | ⛔ not done — no device (host-Node end-to-end is green: extract → profile → `runProfile` → token URL `200`) | ## Repository layout ``` dsh-desktop-ark/ ├── AppScope/ # bundle-level config (bundleName org.fellow99.dsh.DshDesktopArk) ├── entry/ │ ├── src/main/ets/ │ │ ├── app/ # DshRuntime (launch orchestration) · Probe (liveness) │ │ ├── common/ # Constants — single source of truth for paths and budgets │ │ ├── host/ # HostCapabilities (14-entry capability surface) │ │ ├── entryability/ # EntryAbility │ │ └── pages/ # Index (the ArkWeb shell) │ ├── src/main/resources/ # resfile/dsh-payload (build output, gitignored) │ └── libs/arm64-v8a/ # provisioned .so files (binaries are never committed) ├── payload/ # bootstrap.js · host.js · lib/tar-extract.js · shims/ · selfcheck.js ├── profiles/ohos/ # dsh profile + bundle layer + .npmrc ├── packages/bundle-ohos/ # @dsh-ohos/bundle (cordis.patch.yml) ├── scripts/ # 7 scripts: HAR / runtime / payload / build / upstream pin ├── specs/ # 26 specifications (10 root files + spec/plan for 101–108) └── docs/ # engineering plan and troubleshooting notes ``` ## Build Prerequisites: DevEco **Command Line Tools** (SDK API 24), the sibling submodules `../ohos-node-bridge` and `../deepseek-harness`, and a provisioned Node runtime. ```bash # 1) bridge HAR → libs/@fellow99/node-bridge.har bash scripts/build-bridge-har.sh # 2) Node runtime → entry/libs/arm64-v8a (7 ELF gates + SHA-256) bash scripts/provision-runtime.sh # add ALLOW_MISSING=1 to build without it # 3) payload → entry/src/main/resources/resfile/dsh-payload node scripts/sync-payload.mjs node scripts/package-payload.mjs # node scripts/assemble-payload.mjs --from --apply # real payload, still dry-run by default # 4) HAP bash scripts/build-hap.sh # --release for release mode; entry/build/default/outputs/default/ # optional: prove the upstream pin is intact (tag + 8 patch ids + clean tree) node scripts/verify-upstream.mjs ``` `OHOS_CLT` overrides the Command Line Tools root

plugins.description: DSH 超大会话压缩插件：上下文实时监测（窗口×0.85）触发，分块摘要再合并，小会话仍走自带压缩
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-big-compact

**[中文](README.md) | [English](README.en.md)**

**超大会话压缩插件。** dsh 自带压缩（compaction-basic）会把要压缩的旧历史一次性塞进一个模型请求；会话涨到几 MB 之后，中转会拒绝（404 `model_not_found`），`/compact` 只剩一句 “Compaction could not produce a useful summary”。本插件在 `llm/stream` 瀑布上兜底：**只在压缩请求超过阈值时接管**，把它切成多块分别摘要、再合并成最终检查点；小会话与普通对话一律原样放行。

设计取向参考 [billion-context](https://github.com/ranxianglei/billion-context)：普通请求/小上下文不走它，只有大到本地压缩处理不了时才启用。

## 触发条件（实时监测）

1. 每次 `llm/stream` 都用 `ctx.tokenMeter.measure(session)` **实测该会话当前上下文 tokens**（上下文每轮都在变，按实测算）；
2. **窗口是动态的**：每次压缩请求先 `ctx.llm.resolveModelInfo(provider, model)` 读模型声明的 `contextWindow`（例如 profile 里写 850000 → 安全线 850000 × 0.85 = 722500）；解析失败才退回配置/500k 兜底；
3. 实测值（拿不到时退回请求体估算）> **窗口 × 0.85** 就分块；
4. 另外保留 **请求体 > 4 MB** 的字节兜底（中转请求体上限）。

上下文占到 85% 时会打一行预告：`上下文实时监测：… tokens，已达窗口 … 的 95%，下次压缩将分块`。

## 工作方式

```
dsh 压缩引擎
  └─ ctx.llm.stream({ purpose: 'compaction', messages: [系统提示, 历史…, 压缩指令] })
       └─ [本插件] 先实测上下文 / 解析窗口，再决定
            ├─ 未超线 → next()，走 dsh 自带压缩（行为不变）
            └─ 超线   → 分块模式
                 1. 历史消息按时间顺序装箱（默认 1.5 MB/块）
                 2. 每块一个小请求 → 结构化要点（默认 max_tokens 6000，3 路并发）
                 3. 各块摘要合并；合并后仍超线就再做一轮
                 4. 合并摘要 + dsh 原始压缩指令发给模型，得到最终检查点
                 5. 按 raw chunk 协议回放（text 块 + finish stop）给压缩引擎落盘
```

- 子请求的 `purpose` 是 `compaction-chunk` / `compaction-final`，不会再次触发插件（无递归）。
- **空摘要算失败**：某块返回空或少于 10 字时，自动重试并把输出预算翻倍（最多 20000 tokens），仍失败则二分再试（最多 2 层）。
- 整条链路失败时回放 `finish{kind:'error'}`，`/compact` 会照常报错并写会话日志，不会静默。

## 配置

`/root/.big-compact/config.json`（不存在时用默认值）：

| 字段 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `thresholdBytes` | 4000000 | 请求体超过该字节数才接管（字节兜底） |
| `maxContextTokens` | 0 | 0 = 按模型动态解析 `contextWindow`；>0 = 强制覆盖 |
| `contextFillRatio` | 0.85 | 实测上下文 > 模型窗口 × 该比例 就接管 |
| `chunkBytes` | 1500000 | 每块字节预算（UTF-8 字节） |
| `chunkMaxTokens` | 6000 | 每块摘要的 max_tokens（重试时翻倍，上限 20000） |
| `finalMaxTokens` | 8000 | 最终合并的 max_tokens |
| `concurrency` | 3 | 分块请求并发数 |
| `retries` | 2 | 单块失败重试次数 |
| `maxMessageChars` | 200000 | 单条消息最多保留字符数（防一个巨大工具结果吃掉整块） |
| `maxDepth` | 2 | 失败二分重试的最大深度 |
| `verbose` | true | 是否打印每块进度 |

## 日志

`/root/dsh-web.log` 里搜 `[big-compact]`：

```
[big-compact] 已启用：窗口 按模型动态解析，安全线 85%，分块 1.43 MB，并发 3
[big-compact] 上下文实时监测：6464308 tokens，已达窗口 850000 的 760%（安全线 85%），下次压缩将分块
[big-compact] 超大压缩请求（上下文 6464308 tokens（实测）> 窗口 850000 × 0.85 = 722500）→ 分块模式
[big-compact] 压缩请求 23.13 MB，切成 9 块
[big-compact] 分块 1/9 完成（1.43 MB → 3621 字）
...
[big-compact] 压缩完成：9 块，用时 96.6s，摘要 3586 字
```

## 测试

```bash
node test/unit.mjs          # 离线：分块、合并、拦截边界、空摘要重试、动态窗口、失败兜底
node test/live.mjs 12 3     # 真机联调：12 MB 合成压缩请求 → 分块 → 合并（直连中转）
```

## 安装 / 卸载

- 已注册进 `profiles/web/package.json`（依赖 + `dsh.profile.bundles`）并建立
  `node_modules/dsh-big-compact` 链接；**重启一次 web 生效**（`patchReload: startup`）。
- 卸载：从 `dependencies` 与 `dsh.profile.bundles` 删掉 `dsh-big-compact`，
  删 `node_modules/dsh-big-compact` 链接；重启 web。插件文件在 `/root/dsh-big-compact`。

## 已知限制

- 分块摘要是有损的：每块只保留要点，细节以原会话日志为准。
- 依赖中转能接受单块 1.5 MB 的请求；若某个中转更严格，把 `chunkBytes` 调小即可。
- 只处理 `purpose === 'compaction'` 的请求；普通对话不拦截。

plugins.description: Live wallpaper layer for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI — procedural presets, images, GIF and video behind a translucent shell
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-lively

Live wallpaper layer for the **DeepSeek Harness Web GUI**: an animated wallpaper
behind the interface — procedural presets, images, GIF or video — with a small
settings page to pick the look.

![Light theme preview](docs/preview-light.png)

**[▶ Watch the 47-second intro video](https://github.com/hero-jianghaojie/dsh-lively/releases/download/v0.2.1/dsh-lively-intro.mp4)** — narrated tour of the presets, custom wallpapers, playlist and controls (1080p30, Chinese narration).

## Features

- **Six procedural presets** — Flow, Aurora, Starfield, Lava, Mesh, Neon grid.
  Flow is the deliberately animated one (position + size drift); each preset has
  a dark variant for the dark palette and a bright variant for the light
  palette, so a light theme never ends up with a grey wash.
- **Custom wallpaper** — image, GIF, WebP, AVIF, MP4 or WebM, by URL or uploaded
  from disk. Uploads live under `$DSH_HOME/dsh-lively-media/` and are served by
  the plugin's own route, so they survive a reload and a restart.
- **Controls** — wallpaper strength (how much wallpaper shows through), dim,
  video softness, animation speed, a motion switch (the reduced-motion escape
  hatch), pause when the window is hidden.
- **Playlist** — rotate through any subset of the presets every 1–240 minutes,
  in order or shuffled.
- **Wallpaper library** — every uploaded file is listed in Settings, so a
  wallpaper picked last week is one click away; the host lists
  `$DSH_HOME/dsh-lively-media/` through `/dsh-lively/library`.
- **Theme aware** — the veil is keyed on `body[data-ds-dark-theme]`; the
  bright/dark preset variants are keyed on `html:has(> body[data-ds-dark-theme])`.

## Install

```sh
git clone https://github.com/hero-jianghaojie/dsh-lively.git
dsh plugin --profile desktop add ./dsh-lively
```

Then restart DSH (the sidebar's restart button, if installed) and open
**Settings → Live wallpaper**.

## How it works

- The wallpaper lives in one fixed layer at `z-index:-1` (`#dsh-lively-layer`)
  with three children: the animated **surface**, the theme-coloured **veil**
  (`strength`) and the **dim** overlay. The layer is appended to the root so it
  sits under every column.
- Why not the root element's own background? Chromium paints the root background
  into the canvas background layer; a `background-position`/`background-size`
  animation on `html` advances the animation clock but does not repaint on
  screen, so the presets looked static. An ordinary element repaints, and that
  is what the layer uses.
- The shell paints `--dsw-alias-bg-base` on the frame *and* on the centre
  column, and alphas multiply. The token is therefore fully **transparent**, so
  the layer shows through with the single veil painted once, above the surface.
- No `backdrop-filter` on the shell columns: it would make them the containing
  block for fixed-position descendants, and the sidebar's fold toggle is
  `position: fixed` — frosting the column drags that button onto the brand mark.
- Settings persist twice: `localStorage` (instant) and
  `$DSH_HOME/dsh-lively-state.json` via `/dsh-lively/state`, because the Desktop
  app's loopback port changes on every launch.

## Limitations

- A video wallpaper needs a real `<video>` element; CSS alone cannot play video.
- The softness control applies to video only — CSS cannot blur the root
  background, and blurring the columns breaks fixed-position shell chrome.
- The frame-transparency rule targets `[class$='_frame']`, which follows the
  shell's CSS-module naming.

## License

MIT

DSH Mobile — DeepSeek Harness Remote

An open-source Android companion that puts your DeepSeek Harness in your pocket.
Drive sessions, review plans and goals, answer approvals and questions, and get notified when the harness finishes — from your phone, over your network or a relay.

English · 中文 · हिन्दी · Español · Français · ไทย

DSH Mobile is an **unofficial companion app** for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (MIT). It mirrors the web GUI feature for feature and uses the harness's own visual language. Android only, Kotlin + Jetpack Compose. Its companion on the other end is [**dsh-relay**](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-relay), a harness plugin that adds the authentication layer the harness says it lacks, so this app can reach a harness with a real credential and a pinned key instead of an open port. See [Relay](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Relay). **[dshm.zyphite.com](https://dshm.zyphite.com)** is the project site: what the app is, what it looks like, and how to get it running, on one page. Drafts are kept per host and session. - Workspace panels — tabbed text, Markdown, image, PDF and isolated HTML previews; native terminal controls with a bundled xterm renderer; archived-session restore in Settings. - Message feedback — confirmed ratings and retraction, with version-conflict handling. - Slash commands and skills — typing `/` lists the session's commands and skills above the composer. The composer checks a `/` line against the session's own command catalog and runs it through the harness's command gateway. Anything the catalog does not claim is sent as a prompt, which is how skills get invoked. With the dsh-rewind plugin on the host, `/rewind` opens a picker. - Everything the GUI does — goals (phases, rounds, pause/resume/edit), plan mode and plan review, permission approvals, user questions, todo dock, subagents (catalog, follow-ups, interrupt), background jobs, workflow runs, skills, model selection, agent presets, session search, trajectory ledger, session export, message feedback. - Notifications — turn complete, goal complete or blocked, review or question waiting for you. A foreground service keeps the connection alive in the background. - Harness look — the exact DeepSeek Harness design tokens (colors, type, radii, disclosure rows, shimmer, ink buttons), with light, dark and system themes. - 11 languages — English, 中文, हिन्दी, Español, Français, العربية, বাংলা, Português, Русский, اردو, ไทย (RTL aware). ### Added in 0.15.0 - A Check now button for updates in Settings > About. The automatic check also runs again when you come back to the app after a few hours. - Workspace links in replies drawn as file and folder pills; a folder opens in Files. - A redesigned Details panel, Workspace screen and Settings, with archived sessions on a tab of their own. ### Added in 0.14.0 - A `/` menu above the composer with the session's commands and skills. - A picker for the dsh-rewind plugin's `/rewind` and `/undo` that asks for confirmation before it restores files. The transcript hides what a rewind withdrew and marks the cut. ### Added in 0.13.0 - Automation catalog, timing edits, delivery history and session shortcuts. - Plugin installation, updates, toggles, removal, progress and recovery. Create plugin stages an unsent draft with the Creator preset when the host offers it. - Timed questions, continued replies, saved answer drafts and reopenable plans. - Draft text and file, folder and session references saved across app restarts. - Model search, YAML document properties and multiline goal editing. - Reverse-proxy path support and tool argument previews while the model is writing. ## Requirements - Android 8.0+ (minSdk 26). - A running [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) at `0.2.1-alpha.2`, the protocol baseline for DSH Mobile `0.16.0`. Existing protocol fallbacks remain for `0.2.0-rc.1`, `0.1.7-rc.x` and `0.1.6-alpha.x`; new management features need host support. See [compatibility](docs/COMPATIBILITY.md) and the [0.13.0 validation status](docs/VALIDATION-0.13.0.md) for what has been checked on this baseline. ## Quick start 1. Install the latest APK from [Releases](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/releases/latest). 2. Open the app and choose how to connect.
