A host whose Schemastery predates `volatile()` (before 3.18.3) still mounts and runs this plugin — the fields simply stay ordinary values and the live config form is unavailable — because the marker is applied through a capability probe rather than assumed. `Session.append` on this line still cannot stamp the `ignorable` marker (its third argument is the surface-intent bag, and the envelope field survives for stored-log reads only), so the whole `0.2-alpha` line is pre-checked as unmarked and session-log audit stays disabled by default — `append` reads only `sourceEventSeqs`/`surfaceOp` and freezes the envelope, so it has no code path that could stamp the marker; the earlier `0.1.7-alpha` (adapted 2026-09-22), `0.1.5-rc.2` (adapted 2026-09-09) and `0.1.3-alpha` lines keep the same surface-only append signature, and every `0.2` prerelease is classified with them (a STABLE `0.2.x` release is left to the append probe, so a restored marker surface is adopted without a new plugin release). Those lines' log migrations refuse unclassified plugin events even when marked, so `strip` v1 audit rows before a `0.1.3-alpha` host opens the log and v2 audit rows before a `0.1.5-alpha` host migrates it (native v3 logs only need `repair`). | | Node | `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` | | Platforms | All (host + web settings client) | | Model | Any (deny/ask reasons surface through tool results) | ## What you get `dsh-permission-rules` puts an ordered **`allow` / `deny` / `ask`** rule list in front of every tool call on the `tools/pre-execute` waterfall — deterministic, instant, auditable, and written by you in plain YAML: - **`deny`** blocks the call; the rule's `reason` becomes the model-visible error. - **`ask`** rides the official approval seam (mount `dsh-auto-review` for a second-model answerer, or a human answers; with neither, the harness fails closed). - **`allow`** (and no-match) strictly delegates via `next()` — downstream listeners are never short-circuited. Every hit **and** every passthrough is audit-logged as a `permissionRules/decision` session event (log-only — nothing extra is injected into the model context). - **Rich matching** — tool-name globs (including `mcp__*`), agent-identity selectors (`main` / `subagent` / `preset:*`), argument key/value globs **or** regexes (with `!pattern` negation and an `absent` key dimension), workspace-relative path globs at **any nesting depth**, `when` host conditions (env vars, platform), and **shell command decomposition** (`argv`: command word, argument tokens, pipeline signature) for token-precise command matching. - **Built-in high-risk baseline** — a shipped deny/ask ruleset (destructive commands, privilege escalation, download-and-execute, sensitive paths) enabled by default and appended after user rules so a nearer user rule can override it; toggle with `builtin.enabled`. - **Hierarchical rule files** — optional `searchUp` merges every `.dsh/rules.yaml` from the session cwd to the filesystem root, nearest first. - **Dry-run rollout** — `enforce: false` audits what the policy *would* do while passing every call through. - **Hot reload** — Chokidar watch with debounce; a broken edit keeps the previous rules, never crashes. On a WSL host, or for a rule file under `/mnt/`, the watch switches to polling because native change events are unreliable there. - **Fail loud** — invalid YAML, unknown actions/fields, bad globs/regexes, backtracking-prone patterns, or more than `maxRules` rules fail the load. ## Rule syntax ```yaml # /.dsh/rules.yaml rules: - match: { tools: [bash, pwsh], params: { command: "git push*" }, paths: ["**/secrets/**"] } action: deny reason: "No pushes from protected paths" - match: { tools: [edit, write] } action: ask reason: "File writes need confirmation" ``` - **Match dimensions** — `tools` (globs, incl. `mcp__*`), `agents` (`main` / `subagent` / `preset:`; unknown identity never matches — fail closed), `params` (key/value globs or regexes, `!pattern` negation, `absent` key dimension), `paths` (workspace-relative globs extracted at any nesting depth), `when` (`env` var globs/regexes + a closed `platform` list), and `network` (`domains` / `ips` / `ports` / `schemes` — globs, wildcards, CIDRs, port ranges). - **Actions** — `allow` / `deny` / `ask`, evaluated in file order, first match wins. - **Rule metadata** — `enabled: false` (visible but inert), `description`, `tags`; unknown fields fail the load. - **Schema**

plugins.description: Provider-aware DeepSeek peak/off-peak badge for DSH. 在输入框工具栏显示 DeepSeek 峰谷时段，只在选中的模型属于 DeepSeek provider 时出现。
plugins.readme_text:
# DeepSeek 峰谷提示（dsh-provider-peak）

[![test](https://github.com/moonmoonCL/dsh-provider-peak/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/moonmoonCL/dsh-provider-peak/actions/workflows/test.yml)

DSH（DeepSeek Harness）Web 插件。在会话输入框工具栏常驻一枚小徽章，显示 DeepSeek API 当前按**高峰**还是**空闲**价计费；徽章跟随当前选中的模型，只有模型属于 DeepSeek 的 provider 时才出现。

- `● 空闲`（绿点）：空闲时段，价格为高峰价的 5 折
- `● 高峰`（黄点）：高峰时段，按标准价计费
- 悬停或键盘聚焦：徽章出现底色反馈，并弹出详情浮层（当前模型、距下次切换多久、切换时刻、计费规则、节假日数据覆盖年份）
- 选中 Xiaomi 等其他 provider：徽章自动隐藏
- 模型信息尚未解析或加载失败：灰色 `未知`
- 中英双语，跟随界面语言；零依赖、免构建，装上即用

## 安装

### 插件页（推荐）

1. 打开 DSH Web。
2. 进入 **设置 → 插件**，在安装框粘贴仓库地址：

   ```text
   https://github.com/moonmoonCL/dsh-provider-peak
   ```

3. 安装后刷新页面。

### 命令行

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add https://github.com/moonmoonCL/dsh-provider-peak
```

`desktop` 配置档由 Electron 独占，只能走界面。安装后刷新页面。

### 本地开发

```sh
git clone https://github.com/moonmoonCL/dsh-provider-peak
dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-provider-peak
```

目录安装是 `link:`，改完 `client.js` 刷新页面即可，不必重装。

## 峰谷规则

| 时段 | 北京时间 | 价格 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 高峰 | 周一至周五 09:00–12:00、14:00–18:00（不含中国法定节假日） | 标准价 |
| 空闲 | 其余全部时间，含周末与法定节假日全天 | 高峰价的 50% |

规则与价格以 [DeepSeek 官方价格页](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/zh-cn/quick_start/pricing) 为准（核对于 2026-10-18）。

## 哪些 provider 会显示

| 选中的 provider | 徽章 |
| --- | --- |
| `deepseek-official` / `deepseek-account`（内置 DeepSeek） | `高峰` / `空闲` |
| 名称为 `DeepSeek` 的 provider（如 pi-ai 里配置、指向 api.deepseek.com 的 `deepseek` 路由） | `高峰` / `空闲` |
| 其他 provider（`xiaomi-token-plan-cn`、名称不是 DeepSeek 的第三方中转等） | 隐藏 |
| 模型信息尚未解析 / 加载失败 | `未知` |

判定逻辑在 `client.js` 的 `DEEPSEEK_PROVIDER_IDS` 与 `DEEPSEEK_PROVIDER_NAME`。

## 法定节假日

内置 2026 年国务院办公厅公布的 7 段假期（元旦、春节、清明、劳动节、端午、中秋、国庆），落在工作日的假期会让当天全天空闲。2027 年安排通常在 2026 年 11 月公布，届时更新 `client.js`：

```js
const HOLIDAY_RANGES = [/* ... */];
const HOLIDAY_COVERAGE = '2026';
```

节假日数据未覆盖的年份仍按“周一至周五 + 两个高峰窗口”判断，不会报错，只是不识别新年份的假期。

## 自定义

| 想改什么 | 位置 |
| --- | --- |
| provider 白名单 | `client.js` 的 `DEEPSEEK_PROVIDER_IDS` / `DEEPSEEK_PROVIDER_NAME` |
| 高峰窗口 | `client.js` 的 `PEAK_WINDOWS` |
| 节假日 | `client.js` 的 `HOLIDAY_RANGES` / `HOLIDAY_COVERAGE` |
| 文案 | `client.js` 的 `DICT`（zh / en）；插件卡标题在 `locale/*.json` |

修改后刷新页面（目录安装）或重新安装（GitHub 安装）。

## 结构

| 文件 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `client.js` | 全部浏览器端逻辑：槽位注册、locale 文案、选中模型读取、峰谷计算与徽章渲染 |
| `index.js` | Host 端空插件（渲染全部在 Client） |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | 安装时插入的插件行 |
| `locale/{zh,en}.json` | 插件管理页的标题与描述 |
| `test/policy.test.mjs` | 峰谷与 provider 判定的单元测试 |
| `docs/verification.md` | 验证记录与限制 |
| `icon.svg` | 插件图标 |

## 开发与测试

```sh
node --check client.js
npm test
```

测试使用 `node:test`，从 `client.js` 的 `// --- policy logic` 标记块中取出纯函数执行，不依赖浏览器。

## 兼容性

- 在 DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` 上开发与验证。
- 使用 Harness 自带能力：`conversation.input.left` 槽位、`ctx.modelDirectories` 服务、`ctx.locale`、`--dsw-alias-*` 主题 token。
- 只引用主题 token，深浅色主题都跟随宿主；没有引用任何 Harness Client 包。
- DSH 若调整槽位名、模型目录服务或 locale API，需要跟着更新。

## 验证状态

见 [docs/verification.md](docs/verification.md)：逻辑单测、目录安装与 GitHub 安装、实时槽位注册均已覆盖；视觉外观在无浏览器控制的环境下未截图验证。

## License

[MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.description: 小蓝桌宠：DeepSeek Harness 侧栏任务伙伴插件，支持连贯点击动画、任务提醒与独立外观设置
plugins.readme_text:
# 小蓝桌宠 · DeepSeek Harness 侧栏插件 v0.2.1

沿用已认可的蓝发女仆与几何纸片风格。小蓝位于侧栏工作区列表下方的空白处，跟随真实会话状态：待机、思考、执行工具、等待确认、本轮结束和异常。

本地插件，无 npm 运行依赖、无需构建。适配本机 DeepSeek Harness `0.2.0-rc.2`。聊天框和输入框使用原生布局；人物和设置仅由本插件管理。

## 使用

- 点击人物，轮流播放打招呼、开心点头与好奇回应三段完整动画；动作结束后恢复真实任务状态。
- 连点最多排一个后续动作，当前动作会自然演完。连续密集点击不会积压长队列。
- 拖动人物，在侧栏空白处移动。聚焦人物后，方向键可微调位置，Enter / Space 可触发互动。
- 点击状态或短句，返回对应任务会话；后台会话需要确认时优先提示。
- 点击侧栏底部的 **DeepSeek 图标**，打开设置。图标直接使用 DSH 自带的 `FishLogo`，与侧栏品牌标记一致。也可从 **设置 → 小蓝桌宠** 进入。
- 设置中可调整人物大小、不透明度、动效、安静模式、短句与任务提醒标记。
- 收起人物后保留 DeepSeek 入口。侧栏列表占满、窗口变矮或侧栏折叠时，人物自动避让；空间恢复后重新显示。
- 设置中的六个动作可随时预览；8 秒后自动恢复真实状态。预览不产生任务提醒。

默认大小为 148 px（图片宽度），不透明度为 100%；可调范围为 100–220 px、25–100%。实际大小自动适应空白高度。拖动位置保存在当前设备，并随窗口尺寸重新计算。

**安静模式**停止动画与闲聊短句，保留必要的状态及提醒标记。系统“减少动态效果”只暂停自动呼吸、眨眼等待机循环和装饰纸片；主动点击仍会播放有限时长的人物动作。窗口不可见时暂停所有动画。

v0.2.1 修复了 Windows 关闭界面动画时“短句变化、人物不动”的问题。v0.2.0 将系统减少动态效果同时作为点击动画的禁止条件，即使插件的“启用动效”已打开也不会播放。现在自动动效与主动点击分别处理，无需更改 Windows 设置。

## 点击互动

| 动作 | 连贯过程 | 时长 |
|---|---|---|
| 打招呼 | 回应 → 眨眼 → 抬手 → 来回挥手 → 放下手 → 微笑 → 恢复 | 3.20 秒 |
| 开心点头 | 回应 → 闭眼微笑 → 轻轻点头 → 睁眼 → 恢复 | 2.34 秒 |
| 好奇回应 | 倾身听你 → 眨眼 → 举手回应 → 微笑 → 恢复 | 3.06 秒 |

六张同位置、同尺寸的透明关键姿势配合短过渡与轻微缓动，每段都有开始和收尾。人物外形、服装与几何纸片画风保持一致。等待确认、任务异常或断线时，互动及后续队列会让位于真实任务提示。拖动不会触发点击动画。

关闭“启用动效”后仍可显示简短回应；安静模式同时关闭闲聊。升级沿用原有设置存储键，大小、透明度、位置和开关可以继续使用。

以下为已安装插件的实际页面录制，仅截取人物和底部入口：

![三种点击互动](docs/interaction-preview.gif)

## 状态和提醒

任务状态来自 DSH 的 `sessions.list`、`uiSession.sessionStatus` 与当前会话事件源：

| 状态 | 表现 |
|---|---|
| 待机 | 轻微呼吸，间歇眨眼 |
| 思考 | 小幅歪头，几何纸片缓慢浮起 |
| 执行工具 | 轻微起伏，纸片环绕 |
| 等待确认 | 一次短动作，提示“这里需要你确认” |
| 本轮结束 | 点头、举手打招呼，纸片短暂散开 |
| 异常 | 微微歪头，提示本次任务有问题 |

本轮结束使用真实运行状态的结束信号，稳定 700 ms 后提醒；手动停止也可能触发“本轮结束”，因此不宣称任务成功。正在等待确认或遇到错误时不会显示结束庆祝。刷新和重新连接会重新建立基线，避免补发旧任务的结束提醒。

全局状态覆盖当前窗口已加载的会话；当前会话可进一步区分思考与工具执行。未打开的后台会话显示通用执行状态。

提醒仅显示在 DSH 窗口中，没有声音或额外 Windows 通知。设置面板保留本次打开期间最近 12 条提醒，点击可返回会话。不会自动确认授权、回答问题、发送消息或调用模型。

## 安装与卸载

本地安装，在 PowerShell 运行：

```powershell
& "E:\DSH-DeskTop\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd" plugin --profile desktop add "E:\OpencodeProject\Project\DSH-Plugin\dsh-sidebar-pet"
```

本机已安装为本地链接，并已将当前运行的桌宠服务热更新至 v0.2.1，无需重装或重启 DSH。若桌面窗口仍显示旧效果，按 **Ctrl+R** 刷新。ZIP 使用者先解压整个文件夹，再将末尾路径替换为解压目录。保留插件目录，以便宿主提供图片。其他环境升级已经缓存的服务端模块时，可以在无任务运行期间重新启动 DSH。

卸载：

```powershell
& "E:\DSH-DeskTop\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd" plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-sidebar-pet
```

## 素材与维护

`assets/idle.png` 为已认可的半身稿；原有 `blink.png` 与 `wave.png` 保留。本次使用内置 `image_gen` 生图工具，以原图为编辑目标，新增 `lift.png`（抬手中间姿势）、`wave-in.png`（挥手另一端）和 `smile.png`（闭眼微笑）。六张图片均为 1024 × 1536 的透明 RGBA PNG，随插件本地提供。

完整提示词见 `assets/idle-prompt.txt`、`assets/action-prompts.txt` 与本次的 [interaction-prompts.txt](assets/interaction-prompts.txt)。运行期间不调用生图或模型服务。DeepSeek 入口使用原生矢量组件。

![人物与 DeepSeek 入口](docs/sidebar-detail.png)

验证覆盖状态、动画队列、图片服务和已安装页面。v0.2.1 增加“系统关闭动画、真实任务状态、不切换待机预览”的回归检查，直接以鼠标坐标点击人物，确认三段动作都切换到可见姿势并自然收尾；同时检查待机循环和装饰纸片仍暂停。检查也覆盖连点衔接、原生 Logo 路径、键盘、安静模式、任务提示、断线、拖动、设置持久化、列表避让、聊天布局和卸载。验证记录保存在 `docs/`；没有发送测试消息。动画预览为 v0.2.0 已安装页面录制，人物素材和动作脚本在此次修复中保持一致。

插件使用 `shell.overlay` 获取生命周期，通过侧栏 CSS 模块语义后缀定位空白区域；设置页和 DeepSeek 按钮使用原生插槽。动画仅在阶段切换时更新，不持续执行逐帧 JavaScript 循环。卸载清理人物、样式、设置入口、监听器与计时器。

设置保存在设备 `localStorage`，不会写入会话文件；提醒仅驻留内存。插件不修改其他插件源码、DSH 安装文件或聊天布局。

开发检查（Node.js 22 或更新）：

```powershell
npm run check
npm test
npm run verify
npm run preview
node tools/browser-check.mjs --fixtures
node tools/browser-check.mjs --installed
```

`verify` 需要本机 DSH 已启动、插件已安装。浏览器检查使用临时 Chrome 上下文；仅该临时浏览器关闭本地网络检查，以便连接本机 DSH，不调整正常 Chrome 或 DSH 的设置。浏览器工具需要本机 Codex 随附的 Playwright，可通过 `DSH_PET_NODE_MODULES` 指定其他本地模块目录。

`--fixtures` 在独立浏览器页面里使用与 DSH 同形状的临时任务来源验证动作和提醒；不发送测试消息、不执行真实任务，不改服务器会话。普通和 `--installed` 检查使用真实服务读取和原生界面。

诊断入口：`window.__dshSidebarPet.inspect()`，其中 `motion` 显示系统动效偏好、窗口可见性、自动动画状态及点击受限原因。可用 `.update({quiet:true})`、`.reset()` 和 `.openSettings()`；诊断不会输出认证信息或会话正文。

plugins.description: DSH plugin — free OpenCode Zen models for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). Free LLM API, no API key needed. 在 DSH 中使用 OpenCode Zen 免费模型，无需 API key
plugins.readme_text:
# opencode2dsh **Free OpenCode Zen models, natively inside DSH (DeepSeek Harness).** No API key. No registration. No extra process. [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@opencode2dsh%2Fdsh-plugin)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin) [![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/@opencode2dsh%2Fdsh-plugin)](https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh/blob/master/LICENSE) [![node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%E2%89%A520-brightgreen)](https://nodejs.org) [![DeepSeek Harness](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-plugin-blue)](https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh) English | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)
--- opencode2dsh registers a native DSH `LlmAdapter` that streams directly from [OpenCode Zen](https://opencode.ai/zen)'s **anonymous free lane** — the same models OpenCode's own CLI uses without an account, served to your DSH model picker as a regular provider called `opencode2dsh`. Requests leave your machine looking exactly like traffic from the OpenCode CLI (same user agent, same correlation headers), and the model catalog stays fresh through a three-tier fallback chain. There is nothing to log into and nothing to host. ## Highlights - **Zero credential, zero setup** — the anonymous lane needs no key; install, restart, chat - **Native adapter, no sidecar** — one npm package, no child process, no binary, no local port (the legacy Go sidecar is not part of the published package; see `legacy/`) - **CLI-identical disguise** — requests carry the OpenCode CLI user agent and its session/request/project header set, derived per conversation - **Selectable thinking levels** — reasoning-capable free models expose an effort picker in DSH's model selector (declared ladders where the model metadata provides them, Off/Minimal/Low/Medium/High otherwise); Responses-only `muse-spark-*` models expose only upstream-supported effort levels, and no selection keeps the provider default - **Image input where it is declared** — image attachments are accepted for every model whose [models.dev](https://models.dev) entry lists `image` in `modalities.input`, and refused for the ones that declare `text` only; models.dev being silent falls back to the live-verified vision family - **Live catalog with a fallback chain** — live upstream list ∩ free-by-metadata, falling back to offline cache and a verified static list - **Self-healing** — fast startup retries, periodic refresh, and a written health snapshot for diagnostics - **Proper error surfaces** — upstream failures (rate limit, auth, timeout, transport) arrive in DSH as classified finish reasons, and retries stay owned by DSH ## Install **From the plugin market** (recommended, once this repo is listed there): in DSH open **Settings → Plugin Market**, search `opencode2dsh`, one-click install. **From npm**: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add @opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin ``` **From source** (build the tarball yourself): ```sh git clone https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh.git cd opencode2dsh/packages/plugin pnpm install && pnpm pack dsh plugin --profile web add ./opencode2dsh-dsh-plugin-.tgz ``` **Verify**: restart `dsh web`, open the model picker, and pick a model from the **opencode2dsh** group. Requires DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 0.1.7 or newer with a web profile (the IP 池 settings page rides the 0.1.7 Plugins page contract); Node.js ≥ 20 (already present if DSH runs); outbound HTTPS to `opencode.ai` and `models.dev`. ## Configuration Defaults work out of the box. Override via the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`: ```yaml - id: opencode2dsh name: '@opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin' config: mode: adapter # adapter (default) | sidecar providerId: opencode2dsh refreshSeconds: 300 # catalog refresh cadence ``` | Option | Default | Description | | --- | --- | --- | | `mode` | `adapter` | `adapter`: native LlmAdapter streaming straight from Zen. `sidecar`: legacy local-agent mode, not bundled — build the agent from `legacy/agent` and pass `agentPath`. | | `providerId` | `opencode2dsh` | Provider name shown in DSH. | | `refreshSeconds` | `300` | Live catalog refresh interval. Pricing metadata refreshes every 24 h. | | `agentPath` | auto-resolved | Sidecar only: path to the agent binary. | | `agentArgs` | — | Sidecar only: extra CLI args for the agent. | | `restartDelayMs` / `restartMaxDelayMs` / `maxConsecutiveCrashes` | `1000` / `60000` / `5` | Sidecar only: restart backoff and circuit breaker. | | `firstEventMs` / `bodyIdleMs` / `responsesBodyIdleMs` | `30000` / `120000` / `300000` | Adapter only, plugin 0.3.7+: stream-liveness watchdogs, in ms (integers from `1` to `600000`). Time to the first stream event, mid-response body silence, and the body-idle floor for Responses models (`muse-spark-*`). Increase `firstEventMs` for slow cold starts. Unset keeps the defaults; restart DSH after editing. | ## How it works ``` DSH session │ harness chunks (block-start / text-delta / usage / finish …) ▼ ZenAdapter (registered LlmAdapter) │ pi-ai openai-completions stream (chat models) │ pi-ai openai-responses stream (`muse-spark-*`, Responses-only on Zen) ▼ https://opencode.ai/zen/v1 ← Authorization: Bearer public with CLI-identical headers: user-agent: opencode/… x-opencode-client, x-opencode-session, x-session-affinity, X-Session-Id, x-opencode-request, x-opencode-project ``` - **Session correlation** — session/project ids are SHA-256 derived from the conversation's first user turn (stable per conversation, non-reversible), and each request gets a fresh random id, mirroring the CLI. - **Catalog fallback chain** — S1: live `GET /v1/models`; S2: models.dev pricing metadata decides "free"; S3: a compile-time verified static list. A disk cache (~7-day TTL) covers upstream outages. - **Resilience** — the adapter registers immediately at startup; if the first catalog fetch races your network (VPN/TUN reconnects, DNS), the plugin retries on a short cadence (~1 min) before settling into the periodic refresh. - **Sidecar mode** (`mode: sidecar`, legacy) — spawns a local Go agent (a single-tenant port of [opencode2api](https://github.com/jasonxu114514/opencode2api)) on `127.0.0.1:`, token-authenticated, and registers a standard `llm-pi-ai` route. **Not part of the published package**; build it from `legacy/agent` (`go build ./cmd/agent`) and point `agentPath` at the binary. ## Health & troubleshooting The plugin writes a health snapshot after every refresh round: ``` ~/.opencode2dsh/adapter-status.json ``` ```json { "status": "ready", "total": 64, "exposed": 9, "lastError": "", "writtenAt": "2026-08-29T07:01:54.915Z" } ``` | Symptom | Likely cause & fix | | --- | --- | | `403 FreeTierError` / "OpenCode's free tier can only be used from within OpenCode" | The upstream restricts free-tier clients. The plugin preserves the explanation instead of reporting an invalid API key. Use the supported OpenCode client or an official API service. | | Boot screen shows `Failed to load plugins … list slot "plugins.item" requires options.id`, or the IP 池 entry has no configuration page | Your DSH predates the 0.1.7 Plugins page contract. Upgrade DSH to 0.1.7 (latest recommended). On 0.1.6 and older the page never mounts (it is gated on `configForms.whileServed`) — model routing is unaffected. | | DSH 0.1.7/0.2 cannot start after plugin installation (`pending … settingsScope`) | Upgrade the plugin to 0.3.5. On DSH 0.2, configure IP pooling through the installed opencode2dsh row on the Plugins page. | | Only 3 models | Startup fetch raced your network; retries land within ~1 min. Check `adapter-status.json` for `lastError`. | | `lastError: "fetch failed"` persisting | Outbound HTTPS to `opencode.ai` blocked; check proxy/VPN rules. | | Rate-limit errors in chat (`429 … Endpoint is unavailable`) | The anonymous lane is quota-per-IP and free models are contended. Since the fix for [#51](https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh/issues/51) the plugin's provider retry policy rides out 429 bursts silently (8 retries, ~1s→20s backoff, ≈90s worst case per step) instead of sur

plugins.description: DSH plugin that cuts the prompt payload re-sent every request: slims oversized MCP tool JSON Schemas, attributes tool-result volume, and shows the token cost in a settings page.
plugins.readme_text:
# Cache Saver

[![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![dsh](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-0.2.x-5b6ee1)](#install)
[![build](https://img.shields.io/badge/build-none-success)](package.json)

**English** · [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

A host + client bundle for DeepSeek Harness. Every request re-sends the whole
prompt prefix — tool JSON Schemas included. This plugin shrinks the oversized
ones (dispatch untouched) and then **shows you where the re-sent context goes**,
in a settings page.

Measured on a real profile — a fresh session's first request:

| | tools | prompt tokens |
|---|---|---|
| plugin off | 269 | **270,767** |
| plugin on | 270 | **69,559** (−74.3 %) |

Same tools, same calls. Only the manual got smaller.

## Install

Close DeepSeek Harness first (it holds the `desktop` profile), then one command:

```bat
"<install dir>\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd" plugin --profile desktop add github:ium9khbep8834-maker/dsh-cache-saver
```

Or with npm — one command, then add `"@local/dsh-cache-saver"` to `dsh.profile.bundles`
in `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/package.json` (npm cannot know about DSH bundles):

```bash
npm install github:ium9khbep8834-maker/dsh-cache-saver
```

Restart (or reload the page) once — the client half is imported at boot — then
open **Settings → Cache saver**. Other profiles: same command with
`--profile web` / `--profile dsh-tui` (plain `dsh`, no `.cmd`).

## What it does

### 1. Schema slimming — the same tools, a smaller manual

On a fresh agent the plugin copies each tool definition into that agent's scope
and replaces only `description` / `parameters`. `execute`, `output.render`,
timeout and safety flags are inherited, so dispatch is unchanged; DeepSeek
Harness does not validate arguments (the MCP server still does), so nothing is
rejected. Eight frequently used `rea` tools are on a `keepFull` allowlist.

Typical result with the default config: **158 tools, 740,692 → 121,190 chars
(−83.6 %)**, with the five monster schemas cut by 91–99 %
(`compare_web_captures`: 155,623 → 1,392). Add `mcp__github__` to
`shadowPrefixes` and it becomes 182 tools, 776,706 → 143,679.

### 2. Cost attribution — where the re-sent context actually goes

It records every tool result (chars → tokens, duplicates, errors) and every
billed step's `usage`, then derives the numbers that matter:

```
prompt       = input + cacheRead + cacheWrite
new content  = input + cacheWrite            ← paid at full price
equivalent   = 0.1 × cacheRead + new content ← comparable across requests
```

It also classifies the current context (user / assistant / tool call / tool
result / reasoning) by character share, so "history is the biggest line item" is
a measurement, not a guess.

### 3. A settings page

**Settings → Cache saver** shows cost per request, cache hit rate, new paid
content, tool-result volume, the schema savings table, per-session stats,
recommendations and a recent-events timeline. Data comes from
`GET /api/cache-saver/status` (same origin, read-only).

## Config

Put overrides in `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/cordis.patch.yml` (the durable layer):

```yaml
- id: cache-saver
  name: '@local/dsh-cache-saver'
  config:
    shadowPrefixes: ['mcp__rea__', 'mcp__github__']
    maxSchemaChars: 800
```

| key | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `shadowPrefixes` | `['mcp__rea__']` | tool-name prefixes to slim |
| `keepFull` | 8 core `rea` readers | never slimmed |
| `maxSchemaChars` | `800` | target size per schema |
| `maxDescriptionChars` | `260` | target size per description |
| `bigResultTokens` | `6000` | "big result" threshold |
| `maxStepSamples` | `60` | step samples kept per agent |
| `dryRun` | `false` | measure only, do not shadow |

Fine-tuning: `minChars 700`, `maxDepth 3`, `topDescriptionChars 140`,
`nestedDescriptionChars 60`, `descriptionDepth 1`, `maxBranches 4`.

## Why not just raise the cache hit rate?

Because hit rate and spending move in opposite directions here. A hit rate of
99 % means almost every token is a cheap cache read — but the *denominator* is
whatever you keep re-sending. Deleting 136 K stable characters lowers the
ceiling while genuinely cutting the bill. Track **equivalent tokens**, not the
ratio.

## Safety and limits

- Dispatch, arguments and results are untouched; only the model-facing schema
  copy shrinks.
- Rare deep parameters can be folded away — add that tool to `keepFull`, or set
  `dryRun: true` to turn the whole thing off.
- v0.3.1 still ships one payload measurement caveat: tool-result volume is
  attributed by `chars / 4`, while step costs use the provider's real `usage`.

## Development

```bash
npm test        # unit + client checks, no harness needed
npm run check   # syntax check
```

## License

MIT

plugins.description: Clamp every image sent to the model to a maximum side length (default 2000px) so Claude's many-image limit is never exceeded.
plugins.readme_text:
# dshx-image-clamp

> Downscales every image sent to the model so its long edge is at most 2000px (and under a byte budget), avoiding Claude's many-image limit that otherwise breaks the whole session.

Claude 在一次请求里图片超过 20 张时，任何一张边长超过 2000px 就会整条请求被拒。DSH 的附件归一化只限制总像素，单边仍可能超过 2000（例如 2730×1536），之后每一轮都会重放这张图，整个会话就卡死了。

本插件包装 `attachments.readImage`，在图片发给任何 provider 之前**实时**缩小到长边 ≤ `maxSide`，并压到单张 `maxBytes` 以内。磁盘上的原图不改动，停用插件即完全还原。

## 配置（`cordis.patch.yml`）

| 字段 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `maxSide` | `2000` | 长边上限（像素） |
| `maxBytes` | `184320` | 单张编码后字节上限（180 KB） |

依赖宿主已有的 `sharp`（DSH 自带）；找不到时插件会记录警告并不做处理。

## 安装

```sh
# Web profile
dsh plugin --profile web add github:callaumyan-design/dshx-image-clamp
# Desktop（用 DSH Desktop 自带的 dsh 命令，先从托盘完全退出 Desktop）
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:callaumyan-design/dshx-image-clamp
```

安装后重启 DSH。卸载：`dsh plugin --profile <profile> remove dshx-image-clamp`。

## 兼容性

在 DeepSeek Harness 0.2.0-rc.2（desktop / web profile）上开发和使用。纯 JavaScript，无构建步骤，无安装脚本。

## License

MIT

plugins.description: Device pairing, scoped authorization and message transport for the DS Bot native mobile client. An independent DSH plugin.
plugins.readme_text:
# DS Bot Mobile Bridge 原生 App 与现有 DS Bot 团队之间的设备认证和消息传输插件。

[English](README.en.md) · [文档](docs/README.md) · [安装与配置](docs/configuration.md) · [开发](docs/development.md) · [下载](https://github.com/MuQY1818/ds-bot-mobile-bridge/releases) · [反馈](https://github.com/MuQY1818/ds-bot-mobile-bridge/issues)
DS Bot Mobile Bridge 是安装在电脑 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（DSH）中的独立插件，为 [DS Bot Mobile App](https://github.com/MuQY1818/ds-bot-mobile-app) 提供设备配对、受限授权、Bot／群文字历史、消息提交和回执。它使用现有团队的公开会话接口，无需另建团队。 当前版本为 **0.0.6 独立插件预览**，适配 DSH **0.2.1-rc.2** 与提供兼容 Bridge 接口的 DS Bot。这里维护传输服务；手机界面和电脑上的配对管理界面由 App 仓库维护。仅用手机浏览器时，请安装 [Mobile Web](https://github.com/MuQY1818/ds-bot-mobile-web)，无需 Bridge。 ## 架构 ```mermaid flowchart LR App[手机原生 App] -->|HTTPS／设备凭据| Bridge[Mobile Bridge] Owner[电脑 App 配套插件] -->|DSH 所有者认证| Bridge Bridge -->|公开会话接口| Team[现有 DS Bot 团队] ``` Bridge 与电脑管理界面独立启停。手机只能访问协商后明确支持的能力，电脑所有者负责批准与撤销设备；团队、Bot 和群会话继续由 DS Bot 管理。 ## 能力与边界 | 能力 | 行为 | | --- | --- | | 设备配对 | 请求经电脑批准后发放可撤销的设备凭据 | | 会话与历史 | 可见 Bot／群、分页文字历史、完整消息与重连状态 | | 稳定提交 | 请求标识、回执查询和冲突重试拒绝 | | 受限操作 | 按宿主声明提供模型、用量、自己的记忆、日程、队列和取消 | | 数据边界 | 明确字段投影、群会话作用域与上游已知值脱敏 | 本版不提供逐 token 事件、原生审批或密钥提交、媒体与语音传输、系统推送或群管理。完整能力取决于兼容宿主，详见[兼容说明](COMPATIBILITY.md)。 ## 安装与配对 1. **确认宿主兼容。** 现有 DS Bot 需要 `bridge.describe`、稳定 `bridge.submit` 和 `bridge.redact`。原版 npm DS Bot `0.1.7` 缺少完整接口；需要时使用 [App 发布页](https://github.com/MuQY1818/ds-bot-mobile-app/releases)明确标识的兼容包。 2. **安装 Bridge。** 从 [Bridge Releases](https://github.com/MuQY1818/ds-bot-mobile-bridge/releases) 下载 `.tgz` 插件包，在电脑的 DSH 官方插件管理器安装、启用。 3. **配置独立状态与 HTTPS。** 按[配置指南](docs/configuration.md)设置专用绝对 `home`、监听端口和已有的手机可达 HTTPS 地址。Bridge 不创建隧道、证书或公网入口。 4. **扫码并批准。** 安装 App 配套插件，从电脑 **手机访问 → App** 生成配对码；手机扫描后，在电脑核对设备名称并批准。 `.tgz` 安装在电脑上。手机需要 App 仓库提供的原生客户端；目前仍需自行构建，没有公开可直接安装的 IPA/APK。扫码不会自动得到设备权限。 ## 三个独立组件 | 仓库 | 职责 | 什么时候需要 | | --- | --- | --- | | [Mobile Web](https://github.com/MuQY1818/ds-bot-mobile-web) | 浏览器界面、会话导航、Web 登录入口 | 手机直接用浏览器访问 | | [Mobile App](https://github.com/MuQY1818/ds-bot-mobile-app) | 原生客户端、SDK、电脑配对与设备管理界面 | 使用原生 App | | **Mobile Bridge** | 设备认证、受限会话访问、HTTP／WebSocket 传输 | 原生 App 连接电脑 | ## 更新与迁移 保留原 Bridge `home`，其中保存设备与回执身份。先停用旧实例并释放端口，再用同一状态目录启用新包；不要让两个实例同时使用同一目录。停用 App 配套插件只移除管理界面；要停止设备传输，应停用 Bridge。要撤销某台手机，在电脑的已授权设备列表中撤销访问。 ## 文档与开发 | 文档 | 内容 | | --- | --- | | [安装与配置](docs/configuration.md) | 状态目录、TLS、反向代理、配对、升级 | | [所有者接口](docs/owner-api.md) | 认证载体与允许的管理命令 | | [架构](docs/architecture.md) | 服务边界与运行时结构 | | [兼容与能力](COMPATIBILITY.md) | 适配版本和未提供的功能 | | [验证范围](docs/validation.md) | 单元、隔离集成、精确包交付的证据边界 | | [开发](docs/development.md) | 独立依赖、测试、打包与 CI | | [贡献](CONTRIBUTING.md) | 提交要求与问题报告 | | [来源](docs/provenance.md) | 原仓库提交、许可与同步方式 | 开发使用 Node.js 24。可在独立 checkout 中执行 `npm ci --ignore-scripts`、`npm run test:prepare`、`npm run check` 和 `npm run test:integration`。无需 App/Web checkout、手机、真实模型密钥或用户 DSH 配置。 ## 安全与来源 配对码、完整配对资料和设备令牌只给自己的设备。反馈时使用合成数据，移除凭据、私人域名和聊天内容。漏洞处理见 [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md)。 [Apache License 2.0](LICENSE)。Bridge 运行时代码从 App 仓库的固定公开提交独立提取，原 [NOTICE](NOTICE) 与来源保留。精灵和上游 DS Bot 代码来自 Fei2411 及贡献者；开发用 SDK、mock 与兼容补丁有明确出处，且不进入插件安装包。本项目是独立社区项目，与 DeepSeek 官方无隶属关系。

plugins.description: Free, local, unlimited screenplay formatting for AI agents — open-source MCP server & DSH plugin from the Narracore toolkit (narracore.cn)
plugins.readme_text:
English | [Español](README.es.md) | [Français](README.fr.md) | [日本語](README.ja.md) | [한국어](README.ko.md) | [繁體中文](README.zh-Hant.md)

# Narracore Format **Free, local, unlimited screenplay formatting for AI agents.** An open-source MCP server (and [DSH](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin) that turns raw or loosely formatted screenplay text into professionally structured screenplay blocks and typeset plain text — **Chinese, English, or mixed — including Japanese broadcast-drama format and Chinese colon-style dialogue scripts. The layout engine picks the right track automatically: a 33-char × 38-line CJK grid or a 61 × 55 Latin grid**, the same fixed typewriter character grid as [narracore.cn](https://narracore.cn?utm_source=github-plugin). - **Free forever** — runs on your machine, no account, no key, no quota, no network calls - **Deterministic** — pure rule-based engine, no LLM inside; same input always yields the same output, byte for byte - **Agent-native** — machine-readable diagnostics, evidence-anchored scene scoring, typed-blocks chaining contract across tools Part of the [Narracore](https://narracore.cn?utm_source=github-plugin) toolkit — the long-form co-writing workbench. Looking for print-ready **PDF export** or the full story-continuity tooling? See [the ecosystem](#ecosystem) below. ## Example Rough text in — typeset screenplay out. Both directions below are real engine output.
中文（CJK 33×38 字格轨） Input — loosely formatted text, one element per line: ```text 第 1 场 内 老式放映厅 - 夜 放映机的光柱切开黑暗，尘埃在光里悬浮。 常家青坐在最后一排，手里攥着一张褪色的电影票。 常家青 （低声） 如果胶片还在，就能证明那晚的一切。 检票员从阴影里走出来，把手电筒照在票面上。 检票员 这张票，二十年前就该作废了。 常家青站起身。光柱突然熄灭。 切至黑暗 ``` Output — `plain_text` from `format_screenplay` (scene heading, action, character, parenthetical, dialogue, right-aligned transition — all on the fixed grid): ```text 第 1 场 内 老式放映厅 - 夜 放映机的光柱切开黑暗，尘埃在光里悬浮。 常家青坐在最后一排，手里攥着一张褪色的电影票。 常家青 （低声） 如果胶片还在，就能证明那晚的一切。 检票员从阴影里走出来，把手电筒照在票面上。 检票员 这张票，二十年前就该作废了。 常家青站起身。光柱突然熄灭。 切至黑暗 ```
English (Latin 61×55 grid) Input: ```text INT. PROJECTION BOOTH - NIGHT The projector beam cuts through the dark. CHANG (quietly) If the reel still exists, it proves that night was real. CUT TO BLACK. ``` Output: ```text INT. PROJECTION BOOTH - NIGHT The projector beam cuts through the dark. CHANG (quietly) If the reel still exists, it proves that night was real. CUT TO BLACK. ```
The same call also returns typed `blocks` (scene / action / character / parenthetical / dialogue / transition / shot / note), page stats, and machine-readable diagnostics — feed those blocks back to any other tool in this package for analysis or conversion. ## Install ### DSH (DeepSeek Harness) — primary channel ```sh dsh plugin add narracore-format ``` That's it. Your agent gets five tools under the `mcp__narracore__*` namespace. ### Any MCP client (Claude Code, Cursor, …) The package is a standard stdio MCP server, so any MCP client can run it directly: ```jsonc // Claude Code: claude mcp add narracore-format -- npx -y narracore-format@latest // Cursor / generic MCP config: { "mcpServers": { "narracore-format": { "command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "narracore-format@latest"] } } } ``` Requires Node ≥ 22. ## Tools (5) | Tool | What it does | | --- | --- | | `format_screenplay` | Parse screenplay text (or typed blocks) into 8 semantic block types, typeset plain text, page stats, and diagnostics. `output="validate_only"` checks structure without formatting. | | `analyze_screenplay` | Deterministic statistics: scene list with structured headings (number / location / time of day / INT-EXT), per-scene word count, dialogue ratio, action density, character share table. | | `diagnose_scenes` | Scene-level "shootability" diagnosis: the agent cites evidence per scene, the tool validates it verbatim and computes exact 0–100 scores (severity-weighted coverage, BigInt arithmetic — never fakes a score). | | `convert_fountain` | Convert between Narracore typed blocks and [Fountain](https://fountain.io), the plain-text screenplay interchange format. | | `about_narracore` | Ecosystem overview — what else Narracore offers. | **Chaining contract:** to run another tool on the same screenplay, pass back the `blocks` you received (`input_format="blocks"`), not the formatted plain text — blocks parse deterministically; text re-parses. ## Ecosystem - **[narracore.cn](https://narracore.cn?utm_source=github-plugin)** — the full long-form co-writing workbench this toolkit comes from: screenplay and story writing with the same typesetting, plus story-window continuity tooling that goes beyond a local formatter. - **[narracore.app](https://narracore.app?utm_source=github-plugin)** — the hosted MCP service built on the same pipeline, adding a print-ready **PDF export** with embedded fonts (cover page, running headers, signed download links). You can buy N uses of the formatting service there if you want the PDF pipeline without installing anything. ## Engine provenance The layout engine in `src/format/` is the same single source of truth used by narracore.cn. It is ported verbatim from the Narracore codebase (provenance hashes in [`src/format/README.md`](src/format/README.md)), and **snapshot tests pin it byte-for-byte** — green snapshot tests are the machine proof that this package lays out text identically to the narracore.cn web app. The analysis layer (`src/analysis/`) is a TS port of the Narracore analyzer, locked by golden tests generated from the original implementation. ## Development ```sh npm install npm test # 162 tests: snapshots, golden samples, tool layer, stdio e2e, billing-free guard npm run build # esbuild single-file bundle → dist/index.js npm start # run the stdio server ``` Guard test: the package must stay free of any billing / license / payment code — `test/tools/guard.test.ts` fails if such references appear in `src/`. ## License [MIT](LICENSE). The layout engine is © Narracore; see the provenance notes above.

plugins.description: Traditional Chinese (繁體中文) language pack for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): registers a zh-Hant locale and 2,699 generated dictionaries across every namespace the web GUI uses
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-zh-hant

繁體中文 language pack for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
(DSH). It adds a third language to the web GUI — `zh-Hant` — next to the shipped
`zh` (Simplified) and `en`, and puts it in **Settings → General → Language**.

![Settings panel in Traditional Chinese](screenshots/zh-hant-settings.png)

Nothing in DSH is patched, no bundle is forked, and no other plugin is modified.
The locale service in `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-locale` is explicitly extensible,
so Traditional Chinese is a plugin: it registers one language definition and one
dictionary per namespace, and the running app picks both up immediately.

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin add dsh-zh-hant            # from npm
dsh plugin add file:./plugins/dsh-zh-hant   # from a local checkout
```

Then choose **繁體中文** in Settings → General → 語言.

**The `dsh web` host must be running with the plugin already installed.** A
server started *before* `dsh plugin add` keeps serving the client module graph it
built at boot, so the language does not appear until it is restarted. If the
Plugins panel lists the plugin but the Language menu does not, that is why.

## What it covers

62 namespaces, 2,699 keys, ~90 KB — every dictionary the installed web GUI
registers, including the experimental features and the third-party plugins that
opt into `ctx.locale`.

| | |
|---|---|
| Settings | 設定 · 通用設定 · 模型 · 外觀 · 字號大小 · 快捷鍵 … |
| Conversation | 發送 · 插話發送 · 排隊發送 · 停止生成 · 軌跡 · 差異 |
| Sidebar | 摺疊側邊欄 · 新建會話 · 封存 · 刪除會話 · 工作區 |
| Files / preview | 檔案預覽 · 影像預覽 · PDF 預覽 · 沒有可預覽的檔案類型 |
| Plugins, schedules, agents | 外掛 · 提醒 · 子代理 · 預設權限 · 軌跡檢視 |

## What it does not cover

This is a language pack for DSH's **own** interface. It deliberately does not
reach into anything else:

- **Other plugins' hardcoded copy.** `dshmarket` never calls `ctx.locale`, so its
  panel title stays 「插件市场」. Editing that plugin's source is not this
  package's business — a plugin that wants Traditional Chinese registers its own
  dictionaries.
- **Copy captured outside the dictionary** — plugin titles from package
  manifests (`ctx.locale.resolveText`), command descriptions read once at
  registration time.
- **Model output, file contents, and anything the user typed.**

## How the dictionaries are built

The web GUI has ~2,700 keys and DeepSeek ships new ones every release, so the
dictionary is generated from the `zh` values the **installed** build already
contains, never hand-maintained:

```
scripts/extract-locales.mjs   read every ctx.locale.register() call site out of
                              the installed client bundles (shorthand consts,
                              esbuild-renamed consts, object spread and all)
        │
        ▼
scripts/build-dictionaries.mjs  OpenCC cn → tw → twp, per value
        │
        ▼
lib/client.js                 src/client.js with the literal spliced in
```

Rebuild after a DSH upgrade:

```bash
npm install                      # opencc-js, build-time only
npm run build                    # → lib/client.js
npm test                         # behaviour + conversion checks
```

`npm run build:tw` and `npm run build:t` produce the character-only variants if
you prefer 設置/文件 to 設定/檔案.

Two details that are easy to get wrong:

- **A single `cn → twp` pass is not a fixed point.** `STPhrases` rewrites 发送 to
  發送 and `TWPhrases` then finds nothing Simplified left, so 待发送附件 comes out
  as 待發送附件 and only becomes 待傳送附件 on a *second* pass. Running
  `cn → tw` to completion and applying the variant pass afterwards is both more
  idiomatic and idempotent.
- **`fallback` is `zh`, not `en`.** A key this pack does not cover falls back to
  Simplified rather than English, which is the right failure mode for a
  Traditional reader — and it means a namespace added by a future release
  degrades instead of breaking.

## Tests

`npm test` checks the registration contract (one language, one dictionary per
namespace, the three-argument register form), that a `zh-Hant` id already owned
by another pack is a warning rather than a boot failure, that the key set matches
the installed bundles exactly, and that **no Simplified-only character survives**
the conversion.

## License

MIT

plugins.description: Composer-dock widget for DeepSeek Harness: account balance + session token usage.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-balance-usage-widget

A tiny composer-dock widget for **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)**. It shows your DeepSeek account balance and the current session's token usage in one line:

```
¥12.34 · 12.3K tok
```

Hover for the breakdown: topped-up balance, granted balance, uncached input, cache reads, cache writes, output tokens and cache-hit rate.

> Community plugin. Not affiliated with or endorsed by DeepSeek.

## 中文说明

在 DSH 输入框下方的状态行显示“账户余额 + 本会话 token 用量”。

- 左边：DeepSeek 账号的充值余额（多币种用 `/` 分隔；低于 0.01 显示 `<0.01`）。
- 右边：本会话累计 token（未命中输入 + 缓存命中 + 缓存写入 + 输出）。
- 悬停：充值余额、赠金余额、本会话 token 分项和缓存命中率。
- 未登录或余额查询失败时显示 `余额 --`，token 仍正常显示。

### 安装

从 npm 安装（`desktop` profile 由桌面端独占管理时，请在界面里安装）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-balance-usage-widget
```

或在 **侧栏 → 插件 → 添加插件** 中填写包名 `dsh-balance-usage-widget`，安装后重启 DSH。

本地开发时可在安装对话框里粘贴本目录的绝对路径。

### 隐私与边界

- 余额通过 DSH 客户端已有的 `ctx.remote.account.getBalance` 读取，与 **设置 → 账号** 同源；只读，不写文件。
- Token 来自 DSH 的 `tokenUsage` 会话投影，与“性能与用量 → 详细”同源。
- 不发起额外网络请求、不读取会话正文、不写任何文件。
- 余额每 60 秒刷新一次，页面重新可见时也会刷新。

## How it works

- Host half: an empty bundle patch that inserts one row.
- Client half: a browser module that registers a `conversation.composer.dock` entry.
  - balance: `ctx.remote.account.getBalance({ version, locale, timezoneOffsetSeconds })`
  - tokens: `useProjection('tokenUsage')`
- No build step; `client.js` is the published browser artifact.

## Compatibility

- DSH Web / Desktop `0.2.x` (`dsh.client` bundle).
- Balance requires a DeepSeek account login. API-key-only setups show `余额 --`, because the built-in account service does not expose balance for API keys.

## Development

```bash
# local install into a throwaway profile
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add /absolute/path/to/dsh-balance-usage-widget
```

The package is plain ESM plus one browser module; there is nothing to compile.

## License

MIT. See [LICENSE](LICENSE).

plugins.description: make little work.Personal task board plugin for the DSH Web GUI: calendar, daily checklist, week/day timeline, AI task extraction.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-task-board · 个人任务管理 DSH Web GUI 的个人任务管理面板：双月日历、日常清单、每天工作视图与可拖拽的 24 小时时间轴，并支持用自然语言让 AI 提取任务。

## 功能 - **双月日历**：连续两个月网格；每个长期任务按起止日期画成一条彩色时间条，当天的定时任务也会作为单日条画在对应日期上（长期任务优先排布，每周最多显示 5 行，点「还有 N 项」可展开显示全部；日常任务不显示在日历上）。跨周自动分段；双击长期任务线条进入拖动模式（拖线身移动日期、拖两端改长度）；已度过的日期段用浅灰雾面 + 细斜纹 + 白色毛玻璃描边标出；单击任一条线可查看该任务的子任务。 - **日常任务**：每天重复的习惯清单，圆角方块勾选框（完成时绿色实心 + 白色对勾）；可增删改。 - **每天工作**：按钮切换两种视图。 - **任务列表**：周一至周日 7 个竖列，左右翻页切换周；已过去日期背景为 `#E5ECFD`；只列非日常任务（定时任务与跨天长期任务），每行带完成勾选框。 - **具体当天**：左侧「当天日常」与「当天任务」两个清单，右侧 24 小时纵向时间轴；方块可拖动移动、拖上下边缘改起止（15 分钟吸附），双击时间轴空白处快速新建；点方块可编辑。 - **AI 提取**：页面顶部输入一段中文安排（例如「下周一至周五完成季度报告；每天锻炼 30 分钟；今天 14:00-15:30 开例会」），点击提取后调用当前默认模型解析为可编辑的任务草案，确认后写入日历 / 日常清单 / 当天安排。模型不可用、超时或返回格式异常时自动降级为本地规则解析，并给出提示。 - **子任务**：长期任务和当天定时任务都可以带**有序子任务**；AI 提取时缩进行会自动归到上一行任务名下。选中日历上的任务可查看其子任务，周视图显示子任务数量；子任务只能在「具体当天」页增删改，顺序固定、不支持拖动重排。 - **持久化**：改动自动保存到 `/task-board/data.json`；写入前做字段校验与原子重命名，读取失败时暂停自动保存以免覆盖原文件。 ## 安装 插件需要 DSH `>= 0.2.1-rc.2`。任选一种： ```sh # 从 npm 安装（发布后可用） dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-task-board # 或直接从 GitHub 安装 dsh plugin --profile web add github:GinoXiang/dsh-task-board ``` 安装后重启 DSH 或刷新 Web GUI，侧边栏会出现「任务」图标，点开即进入任务面板。 ## 数据与权限 - 只读写 `/task-board/data.json` 一个 JSON 文件（默认 `~/.dsh/task-board/data.json`）；卸载插件不会删除该文件。 - AI 提取只在点击「AI 提取」时调用一次当前配置的默认模型，不会后台自动请求；不发送文件内容，只发送输入框里的文本。 - Host 端提供三个本地 HTTP 接口（`/task-board/load`、`/task-board/save`、`/task-board/extract`），仅接受回环地址与同源请求，只支持 POST，请求体上限 2 MB。 - 无第三方运行时依赖；客户端使用 DSH Web GUI 自带的 React 与主题 token。 ## 开发 ``` index.js Host 半：三个本地接口、JSON 存储、LLM 提取 + 本地降级解析 client.js Client 半：侧边栏图标与整页 UI（plain JS，无需构建） cordis.patch.yml 插件插入补丁 locale/en.json 插件显示名与描述（英文） locale/zh.json 插件显示名与描述（中文） icon.svg 插件图标 ``` 修改 `client.js` 或 `index.js` 后，在插件管理中禁用再启用该 bundle 即可让客户端半重新加载。 ## License MIT --- --- # dsh-task-board · English A personal task board for the DSH Web GUI: a two-month calendar, a daily checklist, week and day work views with a draggable 24-hour timeline, and AI extraction of tasks from natural language. ## Features - **Two-month calendar** — every long-term task is drawn as a colored timeline bar across its date range, and a timed day task is drawn as a single-day bar on its date (long-term tasks pack first, five lanes per week row with an expand button to show every task; recurring daily tasks are not drawn on the calendar). Bars are split per week, double-clicking a long-term bar enters drag mode (move the body, drag either end to resize), and days before today are rendered as a hazy gray band with fine diagonal hatching and a white glass-like outline. Selecting any bar shows that task's subtasks. - **Daily tasks** — recurring daily habits in a rounded-square checkbox list (green filled with a white check when done); add, rename and delete. - **Daily work, two views** — a seven-column week list (Monday to Sunday, page between weeks, past days tinted `#E5ECFD`, completion checkboxes for timed tasks and long-term projects) and a specific-day view with the day's daily tasks, the day's tasks, and a 24-hour timeline whose blocks move by dragging and resize by dragging their edges (15-minute snapping, double-click empty space to add). - **AI extraction** — paste a Chinese schedule into the top bar, click extract, review the editable task drafts, then confirm to write them into the calendar, the daily checklist or a day plan. When the default model is unavailable, times out, or returns malformed output, a local rule-based parser takes over with a notice. - **Subtasks** — long-term tasks and timed day tasks can carry ordered subtasks; indented lines in an extracted outline become subtasks of the task above them. Selecting a task on the calendar shows its subtasks and the week view shows a subtask count; subtasks are added, renamed, checked and deleted only on the specific-day page, in their stored order (no drag reordering). - **Persistence** — autosave to `/task-board/data.json` with validation and atomic writes; autosave pauses if the file cannot be read, so a corrupt file is never overwritten. ## Install ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-task-board # or dsh plugin --profile web add github:GinoXiang/dsh-task-board ``` Requires DSH `>= 0.2.1-rc.2`. Restart DSH or refresh the Web GUI after installing; a "任务" (Tasks) icon appears in the sidebar. ## Data and permissions - Reads and writes only `/task-board/data.json` (default `~/.dsh/task-board/data.json`). - The default model is called once per explicit AI-extract click; nothing is fetched in the background and no file content is sent. - Three local HTTP endpoints (`/task-board/load`, `/task-board/save`, `/task-board/extract`) accept loopback, same-origin POST requests only, with a 2 MB body cap. - No third-party runtime dependencies; the client uses the React instance and theme tokens provided by the DSH Web GUI. ## License MIT --- ## 吉祥物 / Mascot

> 仅供图一乐，与插件功能无关。/ Just for fun; not related to the plugin itself.

plugins.description: 归档工作台（DeepSeek Harness 插件）：在侧边栏会话菜单中永久删除会话，并提供归档会话面板，可一键恢复或删除已归档会话。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-archive-workbench

**归档工作台** — DeepSeek Harness 的会话删除 + 归档管理插件。

**中文** | [English](README.en.md)

DeepSeek Harness 官方只能**归档**会话（隐藏，不删盘），也没有一个方便的地方查看已归档的会话。这个插件补上这两块：

1. **永久删除会话** —— 侧边栏会话行的「...」菜单里多一项「删除会话」，真正删掉磁盘上的日志，而不是只隐藏。
2. **归档会话面板** —— 侧边栏底部多一个归档图标，点开是一整页已归档会话列表，每行可**恢复归档**或**删除**。

---

## 功能

### 1. 会话菜单：删除会话

在任一会话行的「...」菜单最下方（`复制 Session ID` 之后，带分隔线）：

> 置顶 → 重命名 → 分叉 → 归档 → 复制 Session ID → **删除会话**

点击后弹出确认框，确认即永久删除：

- 删除该会话**自己的**日志目录（`~/.dsh/sessions/<项目>/<会话ID>/`）
- 清理它的投影缓存（`~/.dsh/storages/session_projcache/sessions/<会话ID>.json`）
- 把该 id 从归档/置顶集合里移除（避免重启后出现"幽灵行"）
- 通知前端**立即移除该行**（无需刷新页面）

**已归档的会话同样支持** —— 菜单项不区分状态。

### 2. 归档会话面板

侧边栏底部图标栏（与「插件」「定时」并排）多一个**归档图标**，点开后在主区域显示整页列表：

```
已归档会话  2
归档的会话会显示在这里，可随时恢复或删除。

┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ 会话标题                              [恢复归档] [删除]   │
│ session-cf676d08-1890-427e-aa64-34a910d31600            │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

- 每行显示**标题 + 原始会话 ID**（取不到标题时显示「未命名」）
- **恢复归档**：调官方 `unarchiveSession`，该行立即消失，会话回到原工作区位置
- **删除**：复用同一个确认框，永久删除
- 顺序：**最近归档的在最上**
- 空状态：「暂无已归档会话」

> 顺便说明：官方其实也有查看归档会话的入口（侧边栏顶部「视图选项」→ 全部对话（显示已归档）），但入口较深，且那里没有恢复/删除按钮 —— 恢复还得回到会话行的「...」菜单。本面板把这两件事集中到一个地方。

---

## 安装

**方式一：插件市场**（推荐）

在 DeepSeek Harness 里打开 设置 → 插件，搜索 `dsh-archive-workbench`。

**方式二：命令行**

```bash
dsh plugin add dsh-archive-workbench
```

**方式三：从 GitHub 直接安装**

```bash
dsh plugin add https://github.com/CHYMZXS/dsh-archive-workbench
```

**方式四：本地开发目录**

```bash
dsh plugin add /path/to/dsh-archive-workbench
```

安装后**重启一次 DeepSeek Harness**（插件含 Host 端代码，首次安装需要重启生效）。

---

## 已知限制

### 正在运行的会话（重要）

DeepSeek Harness **没有**任何公开 API 能让一个会话从内存中退出。因此对于**本次运行中打开过、还驻留在内存里**的会话，删除文件不够 —— 它可能立刻把日志重新写回来。

插件的处理方式是：

1. 先调用官方 `archiveSession({ stopActivity: true })`，停掉它正在跑的工作并封住后续写入
2. 等它空闲（最多 8 秒）
3. 再删文件
4. 删完**反复复查**（最多 6 次）确认文件没有重新出现

如果文件仍然被重建，插件会**明确报错**（而不是假装成功）：

> the session is still resident in this application and keeps recreating its log; restart the application and delete it again

**建议**：如果要删的是"当前正在用/刚用过"的会话，**先重启一次应用再删** —— 重启后它变成冷会话，删除是干净的。

### 附件不会被删除

`~/.dsh/attachments/` 里的图片/附件**不会**被删除。它们按内容哈希全局共享，多个会话可能引用同一个对象 —— 按会话去删会破坏其他会话。

### 子智能体会话

子智能体（subagent）产生的会话**不会**出现在侧边栏，因此无法从 UI 删除。这是官方行为。

---

## 工作原理

插件完全建立在官方扩展点上，**不修改官方任何一行代码**：

| 部分 | 用到的官方扩展点 |
|---|---|
| 删除菜单项 | `sidebar.workspaces.session.menu.item` 槽位（官方为插件预留，order 500） |
| 确认弹窗 | `shell.overlay` 槽位 + 官方 `Modal` / `Button` 组件 |
| 归档面板图标 | `sidebar.panellist` 槽位（order 20） |
| 归档面板页面 | `main` 键值槽位（key = `dsh-archive-workbench-archived`） |
| 删除动作 | Host 端 `ctx.webServer.register()` 注册私有路由；客户端 `fetch` 调用 |
| 前端移除行 | 发官方 `api-session/removed` 事件（在官方转发白名单内） |
| 恢复归档 | 官方 `uiWorkspace.unarchiveSession()` |
| 清理投影缓存 | 官方 `storageDomain` 的 `table.delete()` |

删除逻辑在 Host 端（`index.js`），UI 在客户端（`client.js`），通过一条私有 HTTP 路由通信。

---

## 开发

```bash
git clone https://github.com/CHYMZXS/dsh-archive-workbench
cd dsh-archive-workbench
dsh plugin add .
```

改完 `client.js` 会自动热重载；改 `index.js`（Host 端）需要重启应用。

---

## License

MIT

plugins.description: Native Rapid-MLX provider for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — dsh reads model facts from the server instead of your settings.yaml.
plugins.readme_text:
# @raullenchai/dsh-provider

A native [Rapid-MLX](https://github.com/raullenchai/Rapid-MLX) provider for
[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) — so `dsh`
gets its model facts from the server instead of from whatever you typed into
`settings.yaml`.

[![CI](https://github.com/raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

> **Status: published to npm** as
> [`@raullenchai/dsh-provider`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@raullenchai/dsh-provider).
> The end-to-end `dsh` run in [Verified](#verified) was on an M3 Ultra against
> `dsh 0.1.0-rc.7`; `dsh 0.1.0-rc.8` is API-compatible — the `LlmAdapter`
> contract is byte-identical and the only changes are additive — and the
> adapter is re-verified against rc.8 at the protocol and unit-test level.
> DSH is still a developer preview that moves fast, so treat this as tracking
> a moving target, not a frozen compatibility promise.

## What it does for you

DSH can already talk to a local Rapid-MLX server through its generic
`openai-completions` provider. That route works — but it knows nothing about
your model beyond what you hand-wrote:

```yaml
# what the generic route makes you maintain, by hand, per model
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    rapid-mlx:
      baseURL: http://localhost:8000/v1
      defaultContextWindow: 262144      # you looked this up. is it still right?
      models:
        - id: qwen3.6-35b-8bit
          contextWindow: 262144
          reasoningEfforts: {off: none, low: low, medium: medium, high: high}
```

Rapid-MLX's `/v1/models` already publishes all of that and more. This adapter
reads it, so:

**1. Nothing to hand-write, and nothing to re-write when you switch models.**
Swap what `rapid-mlx serve` is running and `dsh` follows. No re-running setup,
no stale numbers.

**2. The reasoning control tells the truth.** Rapid-MLX reports whether a model
actually has a reasoning parser. A model that can't reason no longer shows an
off/low/medium/high selector that does nothing.

**3. Compaction is timed with the capacity that actually fits this Mac, not a
number that drifted.** This is the one that quietly costs you.
`dsh-compaction-basic` asks the provider for the route's capacity and compacts
at `thresholdRatio × capacity` (0.8 by default). The provider prefers the
server's **`max_model_len`** — Rapid-MLX's memory-fitted ceiling (what fits in
unified memory: weights + KV cache), in the vLLM/SGLang-standard field — over
the native `context_window`, and falls back to `context_window` on an older
server that doesn't report it. So compaction is timed to what the machine can
actually hold, not the model's advertised window (which it may not have room
for) and not a hand-written number copied from another model.

## Install

Needs Node ≥ 22.15 (dsh imports Node's Zstd stream API without declaring it)
and a running Rapid-MLX server.

```sh
# From npm:
dsh plugin --profile web add @raullenchai/dsh-provider

# …or straight from source — the package ships plain JS with no build step:
dsh plugin --profile web add github:raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider

export RAPID_MLX_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8000/v1     # optional; this is the default
dsh web
```

Then point the agent at the route:

```yaml
# $DSH_HOME/settings.yaml
agent-default-model:
  provider: rapid-mlx
  model: qwen3.6-35b-8bit
```

Verified: that command installs and activates as a profile layer against
`dsh 0.1.0-rc.7`. To hack on it locally instead, see
[Local development](#local-development).

## Model management (v0.2.0)

Beyond the provider route, the plugin registers five tools and a `/rapid-mlx`
command so the agent can see and manage models without leaving the session.
The split follows which surface actually owns each fact: served-model facts
come from the structured HTTP `/v1/models`; the download cache and pull/remove
are CLI-only, so those — and only those — shell out to `rapid-mlx` through the
harness subprocess seam.

| Tool | Source | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `rapid_mlx_serving` | HTTP `/v1/models` | The model(s) served right now, deduped, with context window, reasoning/tool parsers, MoE/hybrid, and modalities. |
| `rapid_mlx_cached` | `rapid-mlx models --cached` | Downloaded models and their on-disk size. |
| `rapid_mlx_pull` | `rapid-mlx pull <name>` | Download a model (alias or HF repo id). Cancellable; no fixed deadline. |
| `rapid_mlx_remove` | `rapid-mlx rm -y <name>` | Delete a cached model to free disk. |
| `rapid_mlx_health` | HTTP + `rapid-mlx --version` | API up? CLI reachable? Reported as two independent facts. |

`/rapid-mlx` prints a one-shot overview: health, the served model and its facts,
and total cache disk usage.

The CLI is resolved from the `cliCommand` config (default `rapid-mlx` on
`PATH`, or `$RAPID_MLX_CLI`); set it to an absolute path if the binary is not on
the harness's `PATH`. `rapid_mlx_pull`/`rapid_mlx_remove` are the only tools
that change anything on disk, and they run non-interactively (`rm` is forced
with `-y` because the subprocess seam ignores stdin).

## Verified

Against `dsh 0.1.0-rc.7` on an M3 Ultra:

- Installs and **activates as a profile layer** (no "declares no `dsh.bundle`"
  warning; the entry shows up in `dsh --profile headless --dump-config`).
- Registers the `rapid-mlx` route with `ctx.llm` and serves real queries.
- Plain chat, a single tool call, and the multi-step bug-fix task that gates
  Rapid-MLX releases — the last one fixed the bug and made the target repo's own
  test pass, verified independently, in 36 s on `qwen3.6-35b-8bit`.

## Not done yet

Being explicit, because the point of the adapter is to *use* what the server
says and some of it is still only read:

- `recommended_sampling` — should be applied automatically per model.
- `tool_call_parser` — should let `dsh` fail fast on a model that cannot emit
  `tool_calls`, instead of looping.
- `is_hybrid` / `is_moe` / `capabilities` — read, not yet acted on.
- **Memory-aware capacity.** Today `resolveModel()` reports the model's
  *advertised* context window. On a Mac the real ceiling is unified memory, and
  reporting that instead is the biggest remaining win — it needs Rapid-MLX to
  expose a usable-capacity figure first.
- Images are not carried through `stream()` — but they now **refuse** with
  `LlmError(..., 'UNSUPPORTED')` rather than being dropped, per the cookbook.
  Text, reasoning and tool calls are carried.
- The route is registered as `rapid-mlx`. If your `settings.yaml` also declares
  a `rapid-mlx` provider under `llm-pi-ai`, the two compete for one route name
  (`registerAdapter` owns provider exclusivity). Use one or rename ours.

## Conformance with the official adapter contract

Built against
[`docs/cookbook/adding-an-llm-adapter.md`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/main/docs/cookbook/adding-an-llm-adapter.md)
and its "protocol obligations" section. Each item has a test:

| Obligation | How it is met |
|---|---|
| `usage` before `finish`, nothing after `finish` | usage is buffered and flushed at end-of-stream, so a trailing usage-only chunk cannot reorder it |
| Tool-call `arguments` are raw JSON strings end to end | fragments stream as `argumentsDelta` and reassemble unparsed |
| Block indexes in first-seen order, reused per block | verified across a reasoning-then-text response |
| Errors take exactly two sanctioned paths | transport/protocol failures **throw** `LlmError` with a stable code; nothing ends the stream quietly |
| Honor `options.signal` | passed to `fetch` and to the SSE reader; an `AbortError` is re-thrown unchanged, not reclassified |
| A field the provider cannot honor throws `UNSUPPORTED` | image content refuses instead of being narrowed away |
| Config is a schemastery schema with env fallback | `export const Config`, fed from `cordis.patch.yml` via `!!js process.env.RAPID_MLX_BASE_URL` |

`finish.replayState` is not emitted: Rapid-MLX needs no native response ids
or signatures on follow-up calls, so there is nothing lossless to project.

## Three things worth knowing before you edit this

Each of these cost real

plugins.description: DSH 输入框提示词增强插件：点一下 ✨ 把草稿改写成更清晰、更具体的指令
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-enhance-prompt

给 [DSH（DeepSeek Harness）](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) 输入框加一个 ✨ 按钮：把随手写的草稿，一键改写成结构清晰、约束明确的提示词。

> DSH Desktop / dsh web 的插件，`dsh.bundle` 形态，可直接用 `dsh plugin add` 或插件市场安装。

---

## 它解决什么问题

你写下的往往不是提示词，而是一句念头——「帮我写个脚本批量重命名文件」「这个报错怎么修」。模型拿到这句话，只能自己猜你要什么系统、什么规则、什么边界，猜错就得来回好几轮。

这个插件在发送之前插一步：读你输入框里的草稿，交给 LLM 做**一次单轮改写**，把意图展开成可执行的约束，然后写回输入框。你可以先看一眼，不满意就改，满意再发。

它**只改写，不执行**——不回答问题、不调用工具、不建会话、不写历史。改写发生在你自己的模型路由上，用的是 DSH 原生的 `ctx.llm.stream()`。

## 效果

输入（13 字）：

```
帮我写个脚本批量重命名文件
```

点击 ✨ 后（203 字）：

```
请帮我写一个用于批量重命名文件的脚本。为准确实现，请先向我确认：使用的操作系统和可运行的脚本环境；
目标文件夹路径及是否处理子文件夹；要匹配的文件类型或文件名规则；具体重命名规则（如查找替换、
添加前后缀、顺序编号、日期、大小写转换等）；是否保留扩展名；重名冲突如何处理；是否需要预览、
确认、备份或撤销。请根据确认结果提供完整脚本、使用说明和示例，并默认先执行预览模式，列出将要
改名的文件及前后名称，避免误改。
```

## 特性

- **工具栏一键触发**：纯图标按钮（28×28），挂在输入框工具栏麦克风左侧，不占额外空间
- **单轮、无工具**：走 `ctx.llm.stream()`，`tools` 天然为空，安全边界由 API 本身保证
- **不污染历史**：不建会话、不写对话记录，只是一次文本改写
- **跟随语言**：中文进中文出，英文进英文出，不做语言标签
- **写回有兜底**：`execCommand('insertText')` → 派发 `input` 事件 → 复制到剪贴板，逐级降级
- **消耗可见**：右键按钮看累计输入/输出 token、调用次数、失败次数
- **模型可配**：默认跟随当前会话的模型选择，也可以在配置里写死

## 安装

### 通过插件市场

DSH 里打开 **设置 → 插件市场**，搜索 `dsh-enhance-prompt`，点安装。

### 手动安装

1. 把仓库克隆或解压到 `%APPDATA%\dsh-desktop\harness\plugins\dsh-enhance-prompt`
2. 在 `profiles/web/package.json` 的 `dependencies` 里加：

   ```json
   "dsh-enhance-prompt": "link:../../plugins/dsh-enhance-prompt"
   ```

3. 在同一个文件的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 数组里加 `"dsh-enhance-prompt"`
4. 运行 `harness\.desktop-bin\pnpm.cmd install`
5. 重启 DSH

卸载反向操作：从 `dsh.profile.bundles` 和 `dependencies` 里移除，跑一次 `pnpm install`，重启，删目录。

## 配置

配置写在 `cordis.patch.yml` 的 `config` 下：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: enhance-prompt
      name: 'dsh-enhance-prompt'
      config:
        provider: ''
        model: ''
        maxTokens: 2048
        timeoutMs: 60000
        maxInputChars: 5000
```

| 字段 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `provider` | 空 | 模型 provider；留空则跟随当前会话的模型选择 |
| `model` | 空 | 模型名；留空同上 |
| `maxTokens` | `2048` | 单次改写输出上限 |
| `timeoutMs` | `60000` | 请求超时 |
| `maxInputChars` | `5000` | 草稿长度上限，超过直接拒绝，不浪费一次调用 |

`provider` / `model` 的解析顺序是：请求体 → 当前会话选择 → 配置。两者都解析不出来时接口返回 `code: no_model`，不会带着空模型名去请求。

## 工作原理

```
浏览器端 lib/client.js                宿主端 lib/index.js
─────────────────────                ────────────────────
MutationObserver 找输入框
   ↓
在工具栏插入 ✨ 按钮
   ↓  点击
读 editor.innerText
   ↓
POST /enhance-prompt  ───────────────▶  校验长度 / 解析 provider+model
{ text }                                    ↓
                                       ctx.llm.stream() 单轮，无工具
                                            ↓
                                       拼装 text block，去掉包裹引号
                                            ↓
                                       记 token 账 → stats.json
   ◀──────────────────────────────────  { success, text, tokens }
   ↓
写回输入框（三级降级）
```

宿主端注册的是 `webServer` 上的精确路由 `POST /enhance-prompt`，同时 `GET` 返回累计统计。

## 提示词设计

改写用的系统提示词刻意做窄：

```
- Do not answer the request; only rewrite it.
- Do not invent technologies, tools, or facts.
- Reply in the input's language, with no labels.
- Chinese output: 200-350 characters. English: 300-450 characters.
- Output only the rewritten prompt.
```

窄是有原因的：一旦允许它「顺手回答」，它就会开始编造你没提过的技术栈和事实，改写结果反而比原稿更偏。字数区间是为了让输出足够具体、又不至于膨胀成一篇需求文档。

## 已知限制

- **DOM 注入**：按钮靠 `[contenteditable="true"]` 和工具栏按钮的相对位置定位。上游改版可能让选择器失配，届时按钮不出现（不会报错）。
- **写回依赖 `execCommand`**：这个 API 已废弃但仍是目前唯一能可靠触发 React 受控输入更新的路径；失败时降级到事件派发，再失败复制到剪贴板并提示。
- **统计是本地文件**：`stats.json` 写在插件目录下，不参与云端计量，口径只覆盖本插件的增强调用。
- **一次一段**：只处理输入框当前草稿，不处理选中片段。

## 开发

仓库没有构建步骤，`lib/` 下的文件就是产物：

- `lib/index.js` — 宿主端（ESM，依赖 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm` 的 `BlockAssembler` / `createUserMessage`）
- `lib/client.js` — 浏览器端（`window.__ModuleLoader__.load` 模块包装）
- `cordis.patch.yml` — bundle patch，注册插件条目

改完重启 DSH 或等 HMR 重新组合即可。

## License

[MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.description: 把侧边栏左上角的全局面板条目折叠成一行，并可勾选「只显示哪几个」。手机端与桌面端同一套规则。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-sidebar-panels-fold

Sidebar **global-panel row** presentation patch for DeepSeek Harness.
把侧边栏左上角的全局面板条目折叠成一行，并可勾选「只显示哪几个」。手机端与桌面端同一套规则。

- 不改核心、不改其它插件：始终通过 slot 数据与 DOM 属性工作，不注册、不覆盖任何 slot。
- 只控制**显示**：被收起的条目仍然注册、仍然可以按 id 选中，插件功能完全不变。

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin add github:xintingcui/dsh-sidebar-panels-fold
```

或在插件市场的 UI / 界面增强分类里直接装。仓库是纯 JS，无构建步骤、无运行时依赖。

## 为什么需要

宿主 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar` 的渲染是：

```
div.root
├─ button.newSession
├─ nav.panelList          ← 全局面板条目（flex:none，撑住下方区域）
├─ div.regionArea         ← 工作区/会话区（flex:1, overflow:hidden）
└─ div.footArea
```

`nav.panelList` 是 `flex:none`，条目越多它越高，`regionArea` 就被压得越小 ——
手机上抽屉本身很矮，条目一多直接把工作区挤没了。桌面端条目数一样，只是相对没那么明显。

## 工作机制

1. **数据面** `ctx.slots.entriesOfSlot('sidebar.panellist')` 读权威清单
   `[{ id, order, label }]`（label 支持 thunk，跟随语言）。
2. **定位面** `findNav()` 三级策略，见下表。
3. **呈现面** 给每个行 `<button>` 打 `data-dsh-pf-row` / `data-dsh-pf-id` /
   `data-dsh-pf-shown="0|1"`，本插件自己的 `<style>` 用
   `[data-dsh-pf-row][data-dsh-pf-shown="0"]{display:none!important}` 收起。
4. **交互面** 在 `nav` 末尾挂一个自有触发器（`data-dsh-pf-trigger`），点开是自建弹层：
   全部显示 / 全部收起 / 恢复默认 / 逐项勾选。选择存 `localStorage`。
5. **守护面** `MutationObserver`（React 重渲染会抹掉属性）+ `ResizeObserver` +
   `matchMedia`：手机抽屉↔桌面常驻列、宽态↔56px 轨道、语言切换、面板动态注册后都会重新收敛。

## 定位策略（选择器会随构建变化，属性不会）

| 级别 | 依据 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| L1 | `nav[data-dsh-pf-nav]` | 本插件自己打的标记，命中即复用 |
| L2 | `nav` 的直接子 `<button>` 的 `aria-label` ∩ 槽位 label 集合 | 分数最高者胜；label 来自同一份槽位数据，天然跟随语言 |
| L3 | 结构兜底 | 父级 `flex` 且 `flex-direction:column`、自身 ≥2 个直接 button 子节点、且存在 `overflow:hidden` 的兄弟 → 唯一命中才采用 |

**不使用任何 CSS Module 哈希类名**（如 `hHd-Xa_panelList`）：那是构建产物，随时会变。

## 策略与默认值

自动模式（未做显式选择时）保留前 N 条：

| 形态 | 判定 | 保留 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 轨道（rail） | `nav` 宽度 ≤ 72px | 3 |
| 窄屏 | `matchMedia('(max-width: 1023px)')` 命中 | 2 |
| 宽屏 | 其余 | 4 |

当前正在使用的面板（`aria-current="page"`）**永远可见**，避免「面板在用、行却不见了」。

## 存储

`localStorage['dsh.sidebar-panels-fold.v1'] = { pinned: string[] | null, showAll: boolean }`

- `pinned: null` → 自动模式
- `pinned: string[]` → 只显示这些 id
- `showAll: true` → 全部显示

读失败（隐私模式/脏数据）一律回落默认，不影响页面。

## 降级

- 4 秒内找不到 `nav`：不隐藏任何条目（页面行为 = 原样），期间低频重试。
- 超过宽限期仍找不到：`console.warn` 一次，说明「折叠能力暂不可用，其余不受影响」。
- `localStorage` 不可用：选择只在本次会话生效。

## 卸载

移除触发器/弹层/`<style>`，并摘掉所有 `data-dsh-pf-*` 属性 —— 侧边栏回到宿主原样。

## 自检

```bash
node smoke-test.mjs     # 最小 DOM 桩下的 17 项断言（不依赖浏览器）
```

## 目录

```
package.json        dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client（platform:web, immediately:true）
cordis.patch.yml    插入一条 Loader 条目
index.js            宿主半边（空实现，满足装载契约）
client.js           全部逻辑（浏览器半边）
locale/{zh,en}.json 插件列表里的标题/描述
icon.svg            插件图标
smoke-test.mjs      开发期自检，不随插件发布
```

plugins.description: GPT娘额度挂件 by Tokyo — Codex quota monitoring, editable replies and an original draggable mascot for DSH.
plugins.readme_text:
# GPT娘额度挂件

Tokyo · 1.5.1 · MIT 代码 / Tokyo 授权立绘 / CC0 音效与回复 · `dsh-gpt-niang-quota`

DSH 聊天界面的纯 DOM 陪伴挂件：角色默认位于输入框左侧，可拖动、缩放，点击切换回复气泡与 Codex 额度卡片。额度展示套餐、剩余比例与北京时间重置点，以 Codex 实际返回窗口为准。

![Tokyo 原创陪伴角色](assets/niang.png)

公开版使用 Tokyo 创作并授权随插件公开分发的龙娘立绘；合成音效与 12 句原创回复保持不变。不包含个人账户数据、真实额度截图或原应用提取的音效与语录库。

## 安装

发布并上架后，在 DSH 插件市场搜索包名，通过标准 bundle 安装并启用。也可交由 DSH 的插件管理工具安装：

```text
plugin_manager { action: "install_bundle", target: "dsh-gpt-niang-quota" }
```

启动型 profile 安装后重启 DSH。无需本地安装脚本，也无需手工编辑 profile。需要支持 `webServer`、`webserver/index-inject` 或 `tapIndex` 的 DSH 版本；聊天输入框 DOM 变化可能影响挂载与定位。

## 使用与设置

- 拖动角色移动；悬停显示缩小、放大、音效、刷新与设置按钮。Shift / Ctrl / ⌘ 加滚轮也可缩放。位置与缩放在当前浏览器中记忆。
- 单击角色在回复与额度之间切换，点击回复气泡换一句，点击空白或 Esc 收起。浏览器音频策略可能需要先进行一次用户交互；音效资源缺失时使用合成提示音。
- **设置 → 额度监控**：开启／关闭监控、控制额度角标、设置刷新间隔（15～3600 秒，默认 60 秒）。点击“保存”应用。关闭后停止新的自动查询，已在途请求仍可能完成。
- **手动程序路径**：自动检测失败时，填写运行 DSH 的机器上的 Codex 可执行文件绝对路径，单独点击“保存路径并检测”；留空保存恢复自动检测。“重新检测”仅确认文件，“刷新额度”验证登录与额度接口。手动路径失效时不会回退到其他程序。
- **设置 → 回复信息**：每行一句，直接增删改；保存后仅使用编辑框内容，留空即不显示回复。最多保存 200 句，每句 500 字；“恢复内置回复”填回发行包提供的回复，随后点击“保存”。发行包内置 12 句原创回复。

后台成功查询缓存 60 秒，即使前端间隔更短也可能得到缓存；“刷新”绕过缓存，同时进行的请求会合并。默认缩放 0.65、音量 0.4，通用提示语为“休息一下，再继续吧。”。

## 平台与账号边界

先在 Codex 中使用 ChatGPT 账号登录，并安装提供 `app-server --stdio` 的 Codex CLI／客户端。API Key 登录不提供订阅额度；不同账户或版本可能没有可展示窗口。

- macOS：检测 Codex.app、用户 daemon、PATH、Homebrew 与常见用户 bin。
- Windows：检测原生 `codex.exe`、用户 daemon、npm 原生包和可访问的 WindowsApps 布局；`.cmd` / `.bat` / `.ps1` 只用于解析固定 npm 原生路径，不通过 shell 执行。受保护目录或特殊安装位置可使用手动路径。
- Linux：检测用户 daemon、PATH 与常见用户／系统 bin。

路径发现含 x64／arm64 分支和平台虚拟文件系统测试，但不代表所有平台已完成真机验收。WSL、容器与远程 DSH 分别使用各自运行环境；浏览器所在电脑的 Codex 登录不会自动转移到 DSH 服务端。

## 隐私与本地存储

插件通过本地子进程发送 `initialize`、`account/read`（`refreshToken: false`）与 `account/rateLimits/read`，另发送初始化通知，不创建对话或请求模型生成。Codex 自身可能连接其官方服务；插件没有独立遥测或第三方上传端点。

插件不主动写入账户邮箱、账户 ID 或凭据，额度接口仅返回套餐、登录类型、额度窗口和查询状态，缓存保存在进程内存。手动程序路径保存在当前 DSH profile 的插件状态中，并通过受宿主访问控制保护的检测接口返回给设置页；本地路径仍属于隐私信息。客户端偏好、自定义回复与位置保存在当前站点的 localStorage（`dgn-cfg`、`dgn-pos`），不会由插件上传至服务端。卸载插件不会自动清除这些浏览器偏好或路径设置。

## 开发、许可与发行资源

```bash
npm run check
npm test
# 可选：Chrome 路径由 CHROME_PATH 指定；Node.js 需支持全局 WebSocket
npm run test:browser
```

源码沿用本地 gptniang-dsh，并参考 GPTNiangMac / Local GPT Niang Widget 与 dsh-whale-widget 的实现思路。保留原代码 MIT 署名；完整条款见 [LICENSE](./LICENSE)。该条款不将原应用角色、美术、音效或语录重新授权为 MIT。

龙娘立绘及衍生图标版权归 Tokyo，已授权随本插件、GitHub 仓库、npm 包和市场分发；保留署名与许可说明，不等于将立绘作为 CC0 素材或单独出售。合成提示音、回复文字采用 CC0 1.0，详见 [素材许可](assets/LICENSE.txt)。1.5.0 的占位 SVG 已替换，不是当前立绘的源图。回复格式为 `{ "quotes": [{ "text": "原创回复", "weight": 1 }] }`。

首次市场收录需目录维护者审核；公开仓库、npm 发布和目录收录是分别完成的步骤。

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件：对话标题工具，支持当前会话命名和历史会话重命名
plugins.readme_text:
# 对话标题工具 · DSH 插件

**插件类型：DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件。**

给 DeepSeek Harness 的模型侧工具：把对话命名成 `MMDD|类型|主题`。

| 工具 | 作用 | 底层路径 |
|---|---|---|
| `set_session_title(title, force?)` | 命名**当前**对话 | `ctx.sessionTitle.rename(session, title)`，直接写日志 |
| `rename_conversation(session_id, title, force?)` | 重命名**任意已有**对话（含已关闭的历史对话） | `ctx.sessionController.rename`，即 Web 侧栏改名同一条路径（会解析/恢复目标会话） |

两者的共同规则：

- 写入的是 `user` 来源的 `session/title` 事件，因此标题被「钉住」：harness 的自动标题（first-prompt provider）被取代，之后的用户消息也不会再自动改名。
- 格式校验 `^\d{4}\|(功能|设计|修复|优化|发布|探索|文档|研究)\|[^|]+$`，报错时附上规范说明。
- **字节上限预检**：上限从部署里挂载的标题服务读取（`ctx.get("sessionTitle").config.maxTitleBytes`）。超限会直接报错并给出实际字节数，避免被服务静默截断；`force: true` 表示"照写不误"，此时接受服务的安全截断。
- `force: true` 同时绕过格式与长度校验，只在用户明确要求非规范标题时使用。
- 子代理调用 `set_session_title` 时，若能取到存活 agent 注册表（`ctx.get("agents")`，惰性），会沿会话血缘上溯到仍然存活的父会话，改的是人在看的那个对话。

## 测试

```sh
node --import ./test/setup-stub.mjs --test ./test/title-tools.test.mjs   # 或 pnpm test
```

15 条用例覆盖：注册、当前会话改名、任意会话改名、格式拒绝、`force` 旁路、空标题、无 agent、子代理上溯、无存活父会话、字节上限（取自服务 / 回退默认）、控制器缺失、以及规则函数本身。测试通过 `test/setup-stub.mjs` 把 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` 指向桩模块，因此不需要 harness 安装即可运行。

> 桩只透传定义对象；真实 `defineTool` 的 schema 转换由"启动验证"覆盖（见下）。

## 实现要点（踩过的坑）

- `inject` 只能列 **profile 根作用域** 存在的服务。本插件用 `["tools", "sessionTitle"]`。
  早期版本把 `agents` 也写进 `inject`，而该服务在 preset 作用域里才组装，profile 层插件永远等不到它、`apply` 从不执行，工具也就永远不注册。agent 注册表改为在 `execute` 里惰性取用。
- 安装形态必须是 **真实包目录**：`link:`（软链到工作区）在运行中的进程里不会成为包解析拦截层；用 tarball 安装进 profile 的 `node_modules` 才可靠（与 dshmarket 等一致）。
- 替换已安装的包后热更 **不会** 换掉进程里已缓存的模块代：必须重启 Harness 才会加载新代码。

## 运行时已知边界

- **热更不 import 新模块**：profile 配置重载只重新应用 patch，不会 import 新插入行的模块（新文件的新 URL 也不行）——新工具一律等一次重启。
- `rename_conversation` 对**正被另一个进程持有的活跃会话**会被拒绝（`already owned by an active write handle`）：这种对话在 Web 侧栏改名，或让那个对话自己的 agent 调 `set_session_title`（同进程即可）。
- **子代理会话**（`parentSession` 血缘、侧栏隐藏）被服务层拒绝（`owned by subagent routing`），属设计内行为。
- 跨进程只追加标题事件时，磁盘投影缓存（`storages/session_projcache/sessions/<id>.json`）不一定刷新；同进程改名会自动刷新。

## 安装 / 升级

```sh
# 1. 在包目录打包
cd <repo>/dsh-tool-set-session-title
mkdir -p ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/vendor
pnpm pack --pack-destination ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/vendor     # 产出 <name>-<version>.tgz

# 2. 在 profile 目录安装（相对路径，保持 profile 自包含）
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop
pnpm add ./vendor/dsh-tool-set-session-title-<version>.tgz

# 3. 首次安装还要把包名追加进 package.json 的 dsh.profile.bundles

# 4. 重启 Harness 让新模块代生效
```

说明：`dsh plugin --profile desktop ...` 被 CLI 显式拒绝（desktop profile 由 Electron 应用独占管理），所以走 pnpm；Web 侧栏 **插件 → 添加插件** 也接受本地绝对路径/压缩包，但要注意 `link:` 形态的坑（见上）。

自包含校验：`pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` 在 profile 目录应当直接 `Already up to date`（已验证）。

## 验证

- 会话里让模型调用两个工具，标题应立刻变成新值，且此后不再被自动标题覆盖。
- 侧栏 **插件** 页能看到组合包 `dsh-tool-set-session-title`。
- 启动验证（schema 转换等只有真实运行才能覆盖）：复制 profile 到隔离的 `DSH_HOME`，用 `--profile <副本> --no-open --port 0` 起一次性实例，确认工具注册且行为正确，再销毁。

## 卸载

```sh
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop
pnpm remove dsh-tool-set-session-title
# 并从 package.json 的 dsh.profile.bundles 移除该名字
```

然后重启。

## 结构

| 文件 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `package.json` | 组合包清单，声明 `dsh.bundle.patch`，`version` 与 `scripts.test` |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | profile 层两行插入（全局工具层） |
| `index.js` | `set_session_title` |
| `rename.js` | `rename_conversation` |
| `title-rule.js` | 纯规则：格式、字节上限、错误文案（无 harness 依赖，便于单测） |
| `test/` | 单测与 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` 桩（不随包发布） |
| `locale/{en,zh}.json` | 插件页展示用的标题与描述 |
| `dsh-tool-set-session-title-0.1.4.tgz` | 构建产物（已装进 profile `vendor/`） |

plugins.description: Native Rapid-MLX provider for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — dsh reads model facts from the server instead of your settings.yaml.
plugins.readme_text:
# @raullenchai/dsh-provider

A native [Rapid-MLX](https://github.com/raullenchai/Rapid-MLX) provider for
[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) — so `dsh`
gets its model facts from the server instead of from whatever you typed into
`settings.yaml`.

[![CI](https://github.com/raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

> **Status: published to npm** as
> [`@raullenchai/dsh-provider`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@raullenchai/dsh-provider).
> The end-to-end `dsh` run in [Verified](#verified) was on an M3 Ultra against
> `dsh 0.1.0-rc.7`; `dsh 0.1.0-rc.8` is API-compatible — the `LlmAdapter`
> contract is byte-identical and the only changes are additive — and the
> adapter is re-verified against rc.8 at the protocol and unit-test level.
> DSH is still a developer preview that moves fast, so treat this as tracking
> a moving target, not a frozen compatibility promise.

## What it does for you

DSH can already talk to a local Rapid-MLX server through its generic
`openai-completions` provider. That route works — but it knows nothing about
your model beyond what you hand-wrote:

```yaml
# what the generic route makes you maintain, by hand, per model
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    rapid-mlx:
      baseURL: http://localhost:8000/v1
      defaultContextWindow: 262144      # you looked this up. is it still right?
      models:
        - id: qwen3.6-35b-8bit
          contextWindow: 262144
          reasoningEfforts: {off: none, low: low, medium: medium, high: high}
```

Rapid-MLX's `/v1/models` already publishes all of that and more. This adapter
reads it, so:

**1. Nothing to hand-write, and nothing to re-write when you switch models.**
Swap what `rapid-mlx serve` is running and `dsh` follows. No re-running setup,
no stale numbers.

**2. The reasoning control tells the truth.** Rapid-MLX reports whether a model
actually has a reasoning parser. A model that can't reason no longer shows an
off/low/medium/high selector that does nothing.

**3. Compaction is timed with the capacity that actually fits this Mac, not a
number that drifted.** This is the one that quietly costs you.
`dsh-compaction-basic` asks the provider for the route's capacity and compacts
at `thresholdRatio × capacity` (0.8 by default). The provider prefers the
server's **`max_model_len`** — Rapid-MLX's memory-fitted ceiling (what fits in
unified memory: weights + KV cache), in the vLLM/SGLang-standard field — over
the native `context_window`, and falls back to `context_window` on an older
server that doesn't report it. So compaction is timed to what the machine can
actually hold, not the model's advertised window (which it may not have room
for) and not a hand-written number copied from another model.

## Install

Needs Node ≥ 22.15 (dsh imports Node's Zstd stream API without declaring it)
and a running Rapid-MLX server.

```sh
# From npm:
dsh plugin --profile web add @raullenchai/dsh-provider

# …or straight from source — the package ships plain JS with no build step:
dsh plugin --profile web add github:raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider

export RAPID_MLX_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8000/v1     # optional; this is the default
dsh web
```

Then point the agent at the route:

```yaml
# $DSH_HOME/settings.yaml
agent-default-model:
  provider: rapid-mlx
  model: qwen3.6-35b-8bit
```

Verified: that command installs and activates as a profile layer against
`dsh 0.1.0-rc.7`. To hack on it locally instead, see
[Local development](#local-development).

## Model management (v0.2.0)

Beyond the provider route, the plugin registers five tools and a `/rapid-mlx`
command so the agent can see and manage models without leaving the session.
The split follows which surface actually owns each fact: served-model facts
come from the structured HTTP `/v1/models`; the download cache and pull/remove
are CLI-only, so those — and only those — shell out to `rapid-mlx` through the
harness subprocess seam.

| Tool | Source | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `rapid_mlx_serving` | HTTP `/v1/models` | The model(s) served right now, deduped, with context window, reasoning/tool parsers, MoE/hybrid, and modalities. |
| `rapid_mlx_cached` | `rapid-mlx models --cached` | Downloaded models and their on-disk size. |
| `rapid_mlx_pull` | `rapid-mlx pull <name>` | Download a model (alias or HF repo id). Cancellable; no fixed deadline. |
| `rapid_mlx_remove` | `rapid-mlx rm -y <name>` | Delete a cached model to free disk. |
| `rapid_mlx_health` | HTTP + `rapid-mlx --version` | API up? CLI reachable? Reported as two independent facts. |

`/rapid-mlx` prints a one-shot overview: health, the served model and its facts,
and total cache disk usage.

The CLI is resolved from the `cliCommand` config (default `rapid-mlx` on
`PATH`, or `$RAPID_MLX_CLI`); set it to an absolute path if the binary is not on
the harness's `PATH`. `rapid_mlx_pull`/`rapid_mlx_remove` are the only tools
that change anything on disk, and they run non-interactively (`rm` is forced
with `-y` because the subprocess seam ignores stdin).

## Verified

Against `dsh 0.1.0-rc.7` on an M3 Ultra:

- Installs and **activates as a profile layer** (no "declares no `dsh.bundle`"
  warning; the entry shows up in `dsh --profile headless --dump-config`).
- Registers the `rapid-mlx` route with `ctx.llm` and serves real queries.
- Plain chat, a single tool call, and the multi-step bug-fix task that gates
  Rapid-MLX releases — the last one fixed the bug and made the target repo's own
  test pass, verified independently, in 36 s on `qwen3.6-35b-8bit`.

## Not done yet

Being explicit, because the point of the adapter is to *use* what the server
says and some of it is still only read:

- `recommended_sampling` — should be applied automatically per model.
- `tool_call_parser` — should let `dsh` fail fast on a model that cannot emit
  `tool_calls`, instead of looping.
- `is_hybrid` / `is_moe` / `capabilities` — read, not yet acted on.
- **Memory-aware capacity.** Today `resolveModel()` reports the model's
  *advertised* context window. On a Mac the real ceiling is unified memory, and
  reporting that instead is the biggest remaining win — it needs Rapid-MLX to
  expose a usable-capacity figure first.
- Images are not carried through `stream()` — but they now **refuse** with
  `LlmError(..., 'UNSUPPORTED')` rather than being dropped, per the cookbook.
  Text, reasoning and tool calls are carried.
- The route is registered as `rapid-mlx`. If your `settings.yaml` also declares
  a `rapid-mlx` provider under `llm-pi-ai`, the two compete for one route name
  (`registerAdapter` owns provider exclusivity). Use one or rename ours.

## Conformance with the official adapter contract

Built against
[`docs/cookbook/adding-an-llm-adapter.md`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/main/docs/cookbook/adding-an-llm-adapter.md)
and its "protocol obligations" section. Each item has a test:

| Obligation | How it is met |
|---|---|
| `usage` before `finish`, nothing after `finish` | usage is buffered and flushed at end-of-stream, so a trailing usage-only chunk cannot reorder it |
| Tool-call `arguments` are raw JSON strings end to end | fragments stream as `argumentsDelta` and reassemble unparsed |
| Block indexes in first-seen order, reused per block | verified across a reasoning-then-text response |
| Errors take exactly two sanctioned paths | transport/protocol failures **throw** `LlmError` with a stable code; nothing ends the stream quietly |
| Honor `options.signal` | passed to `fetch` and to the SSE reader; an `AbortError` is re-thrown unchanged, not reclassified |
| A field the provider cannot honor throws `UNSUPPORTED` | image content refuses instead of being narrowed away |
| Config is a schemastery schema with env fallback | `export const Config`, fed from `cordis.patch.yml` via `!!js process.env.RAPID_MLX_BASE_URL` |

`finish.replayState` is not emitted: Rapid-MLX needs no native response ids
or signatures on follow-up calls, so there is nothing lossless to project.

## Three things worth knowing before you edit this
